locationsMap.name: Hazarsusim
locationsMap.title: Chronicles form of the Simeonite town [Hazarsusah](location-id://f2184b23-3963-4b1a-a9f9-e2d3ef5e91f2)
locationsMap.description: Hazarsusim is the form used in Chronicles for the Simeonite town called [Hazarsusah](location-id://f2184b23-3963-4b1a-a9f9-e2d3ef5e91f2) in [Joshua](book-key://JOS); the name probably means village of horses, but its site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Hazazontamar
locationsMap.title: old name of [Engedi](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000070) on the western shore of the Dead Sea
locationsMap.description: Hazazontamar was the place reached by [Chedorlaomer](name-id://ed428395-dc41-4ed2-9229-bd7abfaa930f)'s coalition after smiting the Amalekites and Amorites; Chronicles explicitly identifies Hazazontamar with [Engedi](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000070).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Ein Gedi on the western shore of the Dead Sea

locationsMap.name: Hazarhatticon
locationsMap.title: middle Hazer on Ezekiel's northern border list
locationsMap.description: Hazarhatticon, the middle Hazer, is named in Ezekiel's ideal border description near [Hauran](location-id://adf65748-6c3d-4222-bac5-56b92ab561e7) and the border of [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061); the exact settlement is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Hazeroth
locationsMap.title: [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210) wilderness encampment where [Miriam](name-id://a4c1c942-2737-4847-b6bf-9401d1dff9c3) and [Aaron](name-id://03e737be-a164-4fe2-bd83-b19b217959dc) opposed [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73)
locationsMap.description: Hazeroth was an Israelite encampment after Kibroth-hattaavah, remembered as the place where [Miriam](name-id://a4c1c942-2737-4847-b6bf-9401d1dff9c3) and [Aaron](name-id://03e737be-a164-4fe2-bd83-b19b217959dc) spoke against [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) before the journey continued toward the wilderness of [Paran](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000177); proposed [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210) identifications remain uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often proposed near Ain Hudherah in the Sinai Peninsula, but not securely identified

locationsMap.name: Hazor
locationsMap.title: major fortified city of northern [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)
locationsMap.description: Hazor was the chief city of northern [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) under [Jabin](name-id://bdf10225-441a-4ddf-a400-bc72cb46bb4c), burned by [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816), later associated with [Sisera](name-id://23741267-e00a-4bad-9d7f-f66e9d398d4f)'s king Jabin, fortified by [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f), and captured by [Tiglath-pileser](name-id://2db142f3-68a9-4a69-9853-b95e20811302); this record is for the northern Hazor identified with Tel Hazor, not the separate southern or Benjaminite Hazor entries.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Hazor in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Hazor Hadattah
locationsMap.title: new Hazor in the southern towns of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Hazor Hadattah, meaning new Hazor, was a southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town listed in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15); it is distinct from northern [Hazor](location-id://913fe6c4-c9d7-41b6-b74a-da1b7354f163), but its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Helbah
locationsMap.title: Asherite town whose inhabitants were not driven out
locationsMap.description: Helbah was one of the towns in [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797)'s territory whose inhabitants Asher did not drive out in [Judges 1](chapter-key://JDG 1); the site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Helbon
locationsMap.title: Syrian wine-producing village traded by [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061)
locationsMap.description: Helbon was known for wine in Ezekiel's lament over [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226), where [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) traded wine of Helbon and white wool; it is commonly identified with Halbun north of Damascus.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Halbun north of Damascus, Syria

locationsMap.name: Heleph
locationsMap.title: [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) boundary place named near Allon to Zaanannim
locationsMap.description: Heleph was a point on [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s border in [Joshua 19](chapter-key://JOS 19), named with Allon to Zaanannim and Adami; its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Helkath
locationsMap.title: Asherite town given to the Gershonite Levites
locationsMap.description: Helkath was a town in [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797)'s inheritance and later one of the Levitical cities given to the Gershonites; its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Helkathhazzurim
locationsMap.title: field near [Gibeon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000088) named after [Abner](name-id://3ce44295-3e16-47da-9037-8888f703aae7) and [Joab](name-id://12ff519a-1af6-4374-bf58-09dbfb159d43)'s deadly contest
locationsMap.description: Helkathhazzurim, the field of sharp swords or strong men, was the place by the pool of [Gibeon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000088) where twelve men of [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) and twelve servants of [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) killed one another in the contest between [Abner](name-id://3ce44295-3e16-47da-9037-8888f703aae7) and [Joab](name-id://12ff519a-1af6-4374-bf58-09dbfb159d43).

locationsMap.name: Hena
locationsMap.title: Assyrian-conquered city named with Ivah and [Sepharvaim](location-id://07367cdc-d637-4d9c-81ba-1cf670b97a38)
locationsMap.description: Hena was one of the places the Assyrian spokesman named to mock trust in the LORD, alongside [Arpad](location-id://d7b0d901-69c5-4e01-aa01-b20679e872eb), [Sepharvaim](location-id://07367cdc-d637-4d9c-81ba-1cf670b97a38), Ivah, and other conquered cities; its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Hepher
locationsMap.title: Canaanite royal city and Solomonic district west of the hill country
locationsMap.description: Hepher was a Canaanite royal city defeated by [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816) and later the center of a district under [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s administration; its precise site is debated.

locationsMap.name: Hermon
locationsMap.title: snow-capped mountain at Israel's northern frontier
locationsMap.description: Hermon was the high mountain on Israel's northern edge, also called [Sirion](location-id://8b635dfc-29b6-4627-a841-edb745dc2c52) and Shenir by neighboring peoples, and appears in boundary notices, poetry, and imagery of blessing.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Hermon on the Lebanon-Syria border region

locationsMap.name: Heshbon
locationsMap.title: Amorite and Moabite city east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987)
locationsMap.description: Heshbon was the city of [Sihon](name-id://7aefa340-c02e-4e80-9ce5-24d4215f6341) king of the Amorites, later connected with [Reuben](name-id://93b5d553-bee9-4897-a61d-2a5878e1c10b), [Gad](name-id://b68edd6a-6aea-4f9f-8c99-684d9a6f7a8b), the Levites, [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153), and prophetic judgments; it is commonly identified with Tell Hisban in Jordan.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell Hisban near modern Hisban, Jordan

locationsMap.name: Heshmon
locationsMap.title: Negeb town in the southern inheritance of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Heshmon was a town listed in the southern district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s inheritance in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15); the site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Hethlon
locationsMap.title: northern boundary way named in Ezekiel's land description
locationsMap.description: Hethlon was a place or route on Ezekiel's ideal northern boundary, named as the line went toward [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62) and [Zedad](location-id://04ea07ad-63fa-4f49-8c4d-fa36cd9c4744); the precise location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Hezron
locationsMap.title: southern border point of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) between [Kadesh-barnea](location-id://42017171-050f-4b41-bdae-3081853e3e98) and Adar
locationsMap.description: Hezron in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15) was a point on [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s southern boundary, reached after [Kadesh-barnea](location-id://42017171-050f-4b41-bdae-3081853e3e98) and before Adar and Karkaa; it is a place-name here, distinct from personal names called Hezron, and its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Hierapolis
locationsMap.title: Phrygian city near Colossae and [Laodicea](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000131)
locationsMap.description: Hierapolis was a city in the Lycus Valley of Phrygia, named by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) with [Laodicea](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000131) and Colossae as places where [Epaphras](name-id://db78c000-542c-45d0-b6d9-f9e3ecc0bc56) labored for the churches.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Hierapolis at Pamukkale, Denizli Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Hilen
locationsMap.title: Chronicles form of a Levitical city in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Hilen was a city with suburbs given to the Kohathite Levites in the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) list of [1 Chronicles](book-key://1CH); it is often correlated with [Holon](location-id://66c46109-e7e8-4636-a0d8-d0eefcdad397) in [Joshua](book-key://JOS), but the precise site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Hill of Moreh
locationsMap.title: hill by the valley north of [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s camp
locationsMap.description: The hill of Moreh was the hill on the north side of the valley from [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s camp at the well of [Harod](location-id://9b78ee52-fbae-49b4-b934-15f90c074456), distinct from the plain of Moreh near Shechem.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often identified with Jebel Dahi / Little Hermon in the Jezreel Valley

locationsMap.name: Hobah
locationsMap.title: place north of [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) reached by [Abram](name-id://bf42c58c-045a-4131-b8ee-55e7c707040a)'s pursuit
locationsMap.description: Hobah was the place on the left hand of [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) to which [Abram](name-id://bf42c58c-045a-4131-b8ee-55e7c707040a) pursued [Chedorlaomer](name-id://ed428395-dc41-4ed2-9229-bd7abfaa930f)'s coalition after rescuing [Lot](name-id://6100a889-934d-48cf-9f71-f36e524c7766); no secure modern identification is known.

locationsMap.name: Holon
locationsMap.title: hill-country town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) given to the Levites
locationsMap.description: Holon was a town in the hill country of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and one of the cities given to the Kohathite Levites; this record keeps the Judahite Holon distinct from the Moabite Holon named in [Jeremiah](book-key://JER).

locationsMap.name: Holy Place
locationsMap.title: outer sanctuary room of the tabernacle and temple
locationsMap.description: The Holy Place was the sanctuary space before the inner oracle or most holy place, used in descriptions of [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s temple, later temple service, Ezekiel's temple vision, and the tabernacle in [Hebrews](book-key://HEB).

locationsMap.name: Horhagidgad
locationsMap.title: Israelite wilderness encampment between Bene-jaakan and [Jotbathah](location-id://72a38431-42c2-4ad8-8b90-0cf5eec8f457)
locationsMap.description: Horhagidgad was a station on Israel's wilderness route in [Numbers 33](chapter-key://NUM 33), reached after Bene-jaakan and followed by [Jotbathah](location-id://72a38431-42c2-4ad8-8b90-0cf5eec8f457); its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Horeb
locationsMap.title: mountain of God associated with [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210) and the covenant
locationsMap.description: Horeb is the mountain of God where [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) encountered the burning bush, Israel received the covenant, water came from the rock, and [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652) later journeyed; it is closely associated with [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210), though the exact modern mountain remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally associated with Jebel Musa in the Sinai Peninsula, though the identification is debated

locationsMap.name: Horem
locationsMap.title: fortified town in the inheritance of [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)
locationsMap.description: Horem was one of the fenced cities listed in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s inheritance; Scripture gives no further details, and the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Hormah
locationsMap.title: southern city formerly called [Zephath](location-id://99c5fe36-d621-45da-85dc-5725046f868d) and devoted to destruction
locationsMap.description: Hormah was a city in the Negeb associated with Israel's failed attack after Kadesh, later victory over [Arad](location-id://8ff2eef5-63cb-4e00-b463-fc226a98cfda), and the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)-[Simeon](name-id://cca9437f-0046-4dd6-a7eb-45ac460a161a) conquest of [Zephath](location-id://99c5fe36-d621-45da-85dc-5725046f868d), which was renamed Hormah; its exact site remains debated.

locationsMap.name: Horonaim
locationsMap.title: Moabite town or descent named in judgment oracles
locationsMap.description: Horonaim was a Moabite place named in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA) and [Jeremiah](book-key://JER), associated with the way down and the cry of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)'s destruction; its precise site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Horse Gate
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) gate near the temple and king's house
locationsMap.description: The Horse Gate was a gate of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) repaired by priests in [Nehemiah](book-key://NEH) and named in Jeremiah's description of the city's future holy area; it lay near the temple and royal precincts.

locationsMap.name: Hosah
locationsMap.title: [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797) border town near the Tyrian coast
locationsMap.description: Hosah was a border place in [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797)'s allotment named as the line went toward the fortified city of [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226) and [Achzib](location-id://e5e9c33d-ae22-45e9-ba4b-06feba9c92ad); its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: House of the Forest of Lebanon
locationsMap.title: [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s cedar-pillared royal building and armory
locationsMap.description: The House of the Forest of Lebanon was [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s large cedar-pillared royal building in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), later used to store golden shields and vessels and recalled as the house of the forest in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA).

locationsMap.name: House of the Forest
locationsMap.title: shortened reference to [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s [House of the Forest of Lebanon](location-id://99f34882-38b6-4f10-9702-9914e2127f6c)
locationsMap.description: The House of the Forest in [Isaiah 22](chapter-key://ISA 22) refers to the armory or royal storehouse known from Kings as the [House of the Forest of Lebanon](location-id://99f34882-38b6-4f10-9702-9914e2127f6c) in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).

locationsMap.name: Hukkok
locationsMap.title: [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) boundary town near [Aznoth-tabor](location-id://38b911e4-4a7d-4da9-9f52-584608630651)
locationsMap.description: Hukkok was a town on the border of [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) as the boundary turned from [Aznoth-tabor](location-id://38b911e4-4a7d-4da9-9f52-584608630651); it is commonly associated with Huqoq in Lower [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Huqoq in Lower Galilee, Israel

locationsMap.name: Hukok
locationsMap.title: Chronicles form of an Asherite Levitical city, likely [Helkath](location-id://98dbbcc8-86a4-4c79-a8c6-eaf1d34d0cc2)
locationsMap.description: Hukok appears in Chronicles among the Levitical cities of [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797) and corresponds to the city called [Helkath](location-id://98dbbcc8-86a4-4c79-a8c6-eaf1d34d0cc2) in Joshua's parallel list; the precise site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Humtah
locationsMap.title: hill-country town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed with [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103) and [Zior](location-id://544f51ae-638f-4128-b99f-d7489a6782ba)
locationsMap.description: Humtah was a town in the hill-country district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), listed near [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103) and [Zior](location-id://544f51ae-638f-4128-b99f-d7489a6782ba) in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15); no secure modern identification is known.

locationsMap.name: Israel
locationsMap.title: biblical land and kingdom of Israel in the southern Levant
locationsMap.description: Israel is used geographically for the land inhabited by the covenant people, for the united monarchy, and especially for the northern kingdom after the division from [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119); its exact extent varies by period and context.

locationsMap.name: India
locationsMap.title: eastern limit of [Ahasuerus](name-id://4e3fa3e8-8ef1-4420-b3b4-b1d14692516e)'s Persian empire in [Esther](book-key://EST)
locationsMap.description: India is named in [Esther](book-key://EST) as the eastern end of [Ahasuerus](name-id://4e3fa3e8-8ef1-4420-b3b4-b1d14692516e)'s empire, which stretched from India to [Ethiopia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000077) over 127 provinces; the biblical reference points to the Indian frontier of the Persian imperial world rather than a single city.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Indian subcontinent at the eastern edge of the Persian imperial sphere

locationsMap.name: Ibleam
locationsMap.title: Manassite city near [Megiddo](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000148) not fully occupied by Israel
locationsMap.description: Ibleam was a city assigned to [Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe) within the broader northern hill-country region, whose inhabitants were not driven out; Ahaziah was later wounded near the ascent of [Gur](location-id://e130c357-8e41-4a67-ba7e-899108fb75de) by Ibleam during [Jehu](name-id://f3fdd9d6-b20c-4fd4-80a5-63258fba4c9f)'s revolt.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Khirbet Bel'ameh near Jenin in the northern West Bank

locationsMap.name: Iconium
locationsMap.title: Lycaonian city where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13) preached
locationsMap.description: Iconium was an inland city of Asia Minor where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13) preached in the synagogue, faced opposition, and later revisited believers; it is identified with modern Konya in Turkey.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Konya, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Idalah
locationsMap.title: Zebulun town listed near Bethlehem and Chisloth-tabor
locationsMap.description: Idalah was a town in Zebulun's inheritance in [Joshua 19](chapter-key://JOS 19); Scripture gives no further details, and no secure modern identification is known.

locationsMap.name: Iim
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town listed with Moladah and Shema
locationsMap.description: Iim was a town in the southern district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s inheritance in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15); it should be distinguished from the wilderness station Iim of Moab, and its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Ijon
locationsMap.title: northern city of [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) captured by Syrian and Assyrian kings
locationsMap.description: Ijon was a northern city in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a), captured by [Ben-hadad](name-id://042b2016-9f44-4949-87b9-822f8ef6f55a) of Syria in Asa's day and later by [Tiglath-pileser](name-id://2db142f3-68a9-4a69-9853-b95e20811302) of [Assyria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000023); it is commonly associated with the Marj Ayun area near the northern border of Israel.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell Dibbin in the Marj Ayun basin of southern Lebanon

locationsMap.name: Illyricum
locationsMap.title: Roman Balkan region marking the reach of [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ministry
locationsMap.description: Illyricum was the Roman region along the eastern Adriatic that [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) names as the western edge of the area through which he had fully preached the gospel from [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) round about.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The eastern Adriatic and western Balkan region of the Roman Empire

locationsMap.name: Immer
locationsMap.title: Babylonian locality named among returnees of uncertain genealogy
locationsMap.description: Immer appears with Tel-melah, Tel-harsa, Cherub, and Addan as one of the places from which some postexilic returnees came, though they could not show their father's house; it is distinct from the priestly family named Immer and has no secure modern identification.

locationsMap.name: Irshemesh
locationsMap.title: city of the sun in [Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd), identified with [Beth-shemesh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000037)
locationsMap.description: Irshemesh, meaning city of the sun, was a town in the inheritance of [Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd) and is generally identified with [Beth-shemesh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000037) in the Sorek Valley.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Beth Shemesh near modern Beit Shemesh, Israel

locationsMap.name: Irpeel
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite town listed near Chephirah and Mozah
locationsMap.description: Irpeel was a town in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s inheritance in [Joshua 18](chapter-key://JOS 18); the biblical notice is brief and no secure modern identification is known.

locationsMap.name: Italy
locationsMap.title: Roman homeland and destination of [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s voyage
locationsMap.description: Italy was the Roman peninsula to which [Aquila](name-id://f158d69a-9f7b-452c-851e-fdb5680cf09b) returned after Claudius expelled Jews from [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b) and to which [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) was sent as a prisoner; [Hebrews](book-key://HEB) also sends greetings from those of Italy.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Italy, especially Roman Italy with Rome as its capital

locationsMap.name: Ithnan
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town listed with Kedesh and Hazor
locationsMap.description: Ithnan was a town in the southern district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) named in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15); no secure modern identification is known.

locationsMap.name: Ituraea
locationsMap.title: northern tetrarchy region named with [Trachonitis](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000224) under Philip
locationsMap.description: Ituraea was a region north of [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080) named in [Luke](book-key://LUK) as part of Philip's tetrarchy with [Trachonitis](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000224) during the ministry of John the Baptist and [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Iturean region around the Lebanon and Anti-Lebanon borderlands, north of Galilee

locationsMap.name: Ijeabarim
locationsMap.title: wilderness encampment by [Abarim](location-id://69302e1c-c9d3-4416-8732-643fd7f51064) on the border of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)
locationsMap.description: Ijeabarim was an Israelite encampment in the wilderness facing [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) toward the sunrising, after Oboth and before the route moved toward Dibon-gad; its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Ittahkazin
locationsMap.title: Zebulun boundary point of uncertain site
locationsMap.description: Ittahkazin is named in [Joshua 19:13](verse-key://JOS 19:13) on the border of Zebulun between Gittah-hepher and Rimmon; its site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Issachar
locationsMap.title: tribal territory in the [Valley of Jezreel](location-id://d6d31048-592b-4c0c-93fb-ead8077b750b) below [Mount Tabor](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000160)
locationsMap.description: Issachar was the tribal territory allotted to the descendants of [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9)’s son [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) as the fourth lot, covering the eastern [Valley of Jezreel](location-id://d6d31048-592b-4c0c-93fb-ead8077b750b) and the slopes below [Mount Tabor](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000160) with the town of [Jezreel](location-id://01fb54a8-39da-4de4-9ba9-6c91d7efff5b). Its princes went down into the valley with [Deborah](name-id://3fec4843-1e2e-4781-a8e7-f7aa0d955f5e) and [Barak](name-id://e0bf01a1-7132-4645-8497-385aa029c28d), and its men were remembered as those who had understanding of the times.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: the eastern Jezreel Valley and the hills south of Mount Tabor in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Jabbok
locationsMap.title: transjordan river where [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) crossed and wrestled near [Peniel](location-id://00326a98-afe3-48a8-ad4e-b5ff69a319f0)
locationsMap.description: The Jabbok was a river east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) that marked territory between [Ammon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010) and the Amorites and was crossed by [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) before his encounter at [Peniel](location-id://00326a98-afe3-48a8-ad4e-b5ff69a319f0); it is identified with the Zarqa River in Jordan.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Zarqa River in Jordan

locationsMap.name: Jarmuth
locationsMap.title: royal Canaanite city in the Shephelah of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Jarmuth was a Canaanite royal city whose king [Piram](name-id://f3390fed-895b-4814-8ffc-4f8e9607591e) joined the coalition against [Gibeon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000088); it was later listed among [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s lowland towns and among postexilic settlements, and is usually identified with Tel Yarmuth.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Yarmuth near Beit Shemesh, Israel

locationsMap.name: Jeshanah
locationsMap.title: Ephraimite town captured by [Abijah](name-id://d8aba678-e5c1-4266-897a-cf7193ccdff3) from [Jeroboam](name-id://44442ff1-d137-4b0c-b117-4ccacc9df7f1)
locationsMap.description: Jeshanah was one of the towns [Abijah](name-id://d8aba678-e5c1-4266-897a-cf7193ccdff3) king of Judah took from [Jeroboam](name-id://44442ff1-d137-4b0c-b117-4ccacc9df7f1) of Israel, along with [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) and Ephrain; it is often associated with a site north of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), though the exact identification remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Jericho
locationsMap.title: ancient city by the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) associated with Israel's entry into [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)
locationsMap.description: Jericho was the city by the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) opposite the plains of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) where Israel crossed into [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045), conquered the walled city under [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816), and where later biblical narratives locate prophets, exiles, and [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab)' ministry near the road to [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jericho in the Jordan Valley, West Bank

locationsMap.name: Jerusalem
locationsMap.title: central biblical city of [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c), the temple, and later Jewish and Christian history
locationsMap.description: Jerusalem was the Jebusite city taken by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c), the capital of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), the site of [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s temple and later Second Temple worship, the focus of prophetic hope and lament, and the city where many New Testament events occurred.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Judah
locationsMap.title: southern tribal territory and later kingdom centered on [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: Judah was the tribal territory allotted in southern [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) and later the southern kingdom centered on [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) after the united monarchy divided from Israel.

locationsMap.name: Jabesh
locationsMap.title: short form of [Jabeshgilead](location-id://2db7fb30-f1f8-431c-9a97-e990b3df80d6) in [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) narratives
locationsMap.description: Jabesh is the shortened form of [Jabeshgilead](location-id://2db7fb30-f1f8-431c-9a97-e990b3df80d6), the Gileadite city rescued by [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) from the Ammonites and later known for recovering Saul's body from [Beth-shan](location-id://7b0f49d3-4da0-488e-ac64-672963954344).

locationsMap.name: Jabeshgilead
locationsMap.title: Gileadite city rescued by [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) and later loyal to his memory
locationsMap.description: Jabeshgilead was a city east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) in [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089), remembered for the Benjaminite wives taken in [Judges](book-key://JDG), [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)'s rescue from [Nahash](name-id://5553db50-fbbc-4fac-ae98-9eb436c82c8e) the Ammonite, and the recovery and burial of Saul's bones.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often proposed at Tell Abu al-Kharaz, Tell el-Maqlub, or nearby sites in Wadi Yabis, Jordan, but not securely identified

locationsMap.name: Jabez
locationsMap.title: place where families of scribes dwelt in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s genealogy
locationsMap.description: Jabez is named in Chronicles as the dwelling place of families of scribes connected with the Kenites and the house of Rechab; no secure location is known.

locationsMap.name: Jabneel
locationsMap.title: coastal boundary town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) later known as [Jabneh](location-id://b4fcb201-8cfb-467e-816d-7adabf90909c)
locationsMap.description: Jabneel was a coastal point on [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s northern boundary near [Ekron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000066) and the sea; it is generally identified with [Jabneh](location-id://b4fcb201-8cfb-467e-816d-7adabf90909c) or Yavne, the city [Uzziah](name-id://a463bd46-3fbc-418b-9809-a0f157b942ea) later captured from the Philistines.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Yavne, Israel

locationsMap.name: Jabneh
locationsMap.title: Philistine coastal city captured by [Uzziah](name-id://a463bd46-3fbc-418b-9809-a0f157b942ea)
locationsMap.description: Jabneh was the later form of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s coastal [Jabneel](location-id://0e5abfc2-66d6-4464-ae8c-cb6e6f3d5571), a Philistine city whose wall [Uzziah](name-id://a463bd46-3fbc-418b-9809-a0f157b942ea) broke down along with [Gath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000082) and [Ashdod](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000020); it is identified with Yavne.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Yavne, Israel

locationsMap.name: Jagur
locationsMap.title: southern town in the inheritance of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Jagur was a town in the southern district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) named with Kabzeel and Kinah; no secure modern identification is known.

locationsMap.name: Jahaz
locationsMap.title: Moabite plain city where Israel defeated [Sihon](name-id://7aefa340-c02e-4e80-9ce5-24d4215f6341)
locationsMap.description: Jahaz was the place where [Sihon](name-id://7aefa340-c02e-4e80-9ce5-24d4215f6341) king of the Amorites fought Israel and was defeated; it later appears as a Reubenite and Levitical city and in prophetic oracles against [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153).

locationsMap.name: Jahzah
locationsMap.title: variant form of [Jahaz](location-id://ffa0c9f8-371c-45f8-9592-9959272c1983) in Levitical and Moabite city lists
locationsMap.description: Jahzah is the form used for [Jahaz](location-id://ffa0c9f8-371c-45f8-9592-9959272c1983) in Chronicles and Jeremiah, referring to the Moabite or Reubenite city associated with [Sihon](name-id://7aefa340-c02e-4e80-9ce5-24d4215f6341)'s defeat and later Levitical allotment.

locationsMap.name: Jair
locationsMap.title: territory of Jair's towns in [Bashan](location-id://af0d12bf-aa1c-494c-9f89-8288fd65ef3d) and [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089)
locationsMap.description: Jair in [Joshua 13](chapter-key://JOS 13) refers to the towns of Jair in [Bashan](location-id://af0d12bf-aa1c-494c-9f89-8288fd65ef3d) and [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089), also called [Havothjair](location-id://a64dce00-a017-409a-932d-bb3df73a9038), rather than to a single city; the precise boundaries of the territory are uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Janoah
locationsMap.title: northern city captured by [Tiglath-pileser](name-id://2db142f3-68a9-4a69-9853-b95e20811302) in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s region
locationsMap.description: Janoah in Kings was a northern city taken by [Tiglath-pileser](name-id://2db142f3-68a9-4a69-9853-b95e20811302) along with Kedesh, [Hazor](location-id://913fe6c4-c9d7-41b6-b74a-da1b7354f163), and [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080); it is distinct from the [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) boundary town of Janoah in [Joshua](book-key://JOS).

locationsMap.name: Japhia
locationsMap.title: Zebulun border town near Chisloth-tabor and Daberath
locationsMap.description: Japhia was a town on Zebulun's boundary in [Joshua 19](chapter-key://JOS 19); it is commonly identified with Yafa an-Naseriyye near [Nazareth](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000167).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Yafa an-Naseriyye near Nazareth, Israel

locationsMap.name: Jattir
locationsMap.title: hill-country Levitical city of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) favored by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)
locationsMap.description: Jattir was a hill-country town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) given to the priests and later one of the places to which [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) sent spoil after recovering goods from the Amalekites.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Khirbet Attir in the southern Hebron hills

locationsMap.name: Javan
locationsMap.title: biblical name for the Greek or Ionian world
locationsMap.description: Javan is used in the prophets for the Greek or Ionian peoples and their lands, appearing among distant nations and among [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226)'s trading partners.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Greek and Ionian world of the eastern Mediterranean

locationsMap.name: Jazer
locationsMap.title: Gileadite city and district east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987)
locationsMap.description: Jazer was an Amorite or Gileadite city taken by Israel, allotted in [Gad](name-id://b68edd6a-6aea-4f9f-8c99-684d9a6f7a8b)'s region, given to the Levites, and remembered in Moabite judgment oracles for its vines and surrounding settlements.

locationsMap.name: Jebus
locationsMap.title: Jebusite name for [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) before [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) captured it
locationsMap.description: Jebus was the Jebusite city later called [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), named in tribal boundary lists and in the account of [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) taking the stronghold of [Zion](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000245).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Jegarsahadutha
locationsMap.title: Aramaic name for [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) and [Laban](name-id://02b09a01-9819-4182-895a-b0dda2395250)'s witness heap in [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089)
locationsMap.description: Jegarsahadutha was [Laban](name-id://02b09a01-9819-4182-895a-b0dda2395250)'s Aramaic name for the heap of stones also called [Galeed](location-id://628c5fd0-bbf3-4ac9-bc99-22b192cc00e0), raised as a witness between [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) and Laban in the hill country of [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089).

locationsMap.name: Jehovahjireh
locationsMap.title: name [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412) gave the place of [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf)'s offering in [Moriah](location-id://e9904ce3-3a6f-43fd-9eb3-57cbbb286aa2)
locationsMap.description: Jehovahjireh, spelled Jehovahjireh in the KJV, is the name [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412) called the place in the land of [Moriah](location-id://e9904ce3-3a6f-43fd-9eb3-57cbbb286aa2) where a ram was offered in [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf)'s stead, with the saying, In the mount of the LORD it shall be seen ([Genesis 22:14](verse-key://GEN 22:14)). The name echoes Abraham's earlier words that God will provide himself a lamb for a burnt offering ([Genesis 22:8](verse-key://GEN 22:8)). The particular mountain within Moriah is not identified in [Genesis](book-key://GEN), though [2 Chronicles 3:1](verse-key://2CH 3:1) later places mount Moriah at [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), where [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f) built the house of the LORD.

locationsMap.name: Jehud
locationsMap.title: Danite town preserved in the name Yehud
locationsMap.description: Jehud was a town in the inheritance of [Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd) listed with Bene-berak and [Gath-rimmon](location-id://19865740-348e-4b31-a870-24f1f6549229); its name is commonly preserved in modern Yehud.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Yehud, Israel

locationsMap.name: Jekabzeel
locationsMap.title: postexilic southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town also known as Kabzeel
locationsMap.description: Jekabzeel was a southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) settlement named in [Nehemiah](book-key://NEH) among places resettled after exile, corresponding to Kabzeel in Joshua's southern town list; its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Jeruel
locationsMap.title: wilderness area near the ascent where [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) faced [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) and [Ammon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010)
locationsMap.description: The wilderness of Jeruel was the place named in [Jahaziel](name-id://207c6465-a035-4ec8-920e-f444a4714956)'s directions to [Jehoshaphat](name-id://3a573bf3-3bda-458d-b7ac-5b2e4f3205f6), near the ascent of Ziz, where [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) would meet the invading forces from [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153), [Ammon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010), and Mount Seir; its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Jeshimon
locationsMap.title: wilderness region near [Ziph](location-id://212b3b0d-07c7-4506-99f7-2bd90c1942ce) where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) hid from [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)
locationsMap.description: Jeshimon was the wilderness or desert area near [Ziph](location-id://212b3b0d-07c7-4506-99f7-2bd90c1942ce) and [Hachilah](location-id://f99c34c2-711a-4ad1-aedf-bc98c6e6e49a) where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) hid and where the Ziphites reported him to [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb); the term may describe a desolate district rather than a single site.

locationsMap.name: Jeshua
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) settlement named among postexilic villages
locationsMap.description: Jeshua was one of the southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) settlements listed in [Nehemiah](book-key://NEH) among places inhabited after the exile; it is distinct from personal names called Jeshua and has no secure modern identification.

locationsMap.name: Jezreel
locationsMap.title: northern city and valley associated with [Ahab](name-id://a1d416c9-b053-4cff-a148-1b25f795d26c) and [Jehu](name-id://f3fdd9d6-b20c-4fd4-80a5-63258fba4c9f)
locationsMap.description: Jezreel was a city in [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) overlooking the Jezreel Valley, associated with [Ahab](name-id://a1d416c9-b053-4cff-a148-1b25f795d26c)'s palace, [Naboth](name-id://7a1e23a8-31ec-4458-ad5f-33532f7a71e8)'s vineyard, [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652), [Jehu](name-id://f3fdd9d6-b20c-4fd4-80a5-63258fba4c9f)'s revolt, and [Hosea](name-id://685d5d0f-a306-419e-8c7d-b6bf1b1db7a0)'s symbolic child; this record is distinct from the Judahite Jezreel linked with [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s family.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Jezreel near modern Jezreel/Yizre'el, Israel

locationsMap.name: Jogbehah
locationsMap.title: fortified Gadite town east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987)
locationsMap.description: Jogbehah was a town fortified by the Gadites and later a point on [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s pursuit route beyond Succoth; it is often connected with al-Jubeiha near Amman, though the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with al-Jubeiha near Amman, Jordan

locationsMap.name: Jokdeam
locationsMap.title: hill-country town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed near [Maon](location-id://5dc48c50-612b-40c8-87f0-9948dab2dc29) and [Ziph](location-id://212b3b0d-07c7-4506-99f7-2bd90c1942ce)
locationsMap.description: Jokdeam was a town in the hill country of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15), listed near [Maon](location-id://5dc48c50-612b-40c8-87f0-9948dab2dc29), [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029), [Ziph](location-id://212b3b0d-07c7-4506-99f7-2bd90c1942ce), and [Juttah](location-id://02a6a55e-a109-4093-8ec7-65c606f5cc10); no secure modern identification is known.

locationsMap.name: Jokmeam
locationsMap.title: Levitical town in [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) named in the Kohathite allotment
locationsMap.description: Jokmeam appears in Chronicles as a Levitical town in [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) given to the Kohathites; it is sometimes discussed with the related Ephraimite town-name Kibzaim, and its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Jokneam
locationsMap.title: Canaanite and Levitical city by Mount [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029)
locationsMap.description: Jokneam was a Canaanite royal city near Mount [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029), later on Zebulun's border and assigned to the Merarite Levites; it is identified with Tel Yokneam.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Yokneam near Yokneam Illit, Israel

locationsMap.name: Joktheel
locationsMap.title: name [Amaziah](name-id://9a9f6759-6d10-4eae-84bb-6036f43f1d2c) gave to captured [Sela](location-id://bb00c510-f33a-4159-93c3-890bf3ee4182) in [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064)
locationsMap.description: Joktheel was the name [Amaziah](name-id://9a9f6759-6d10-4eae-84bb-6036f43f1d2c) gave to [Sela](location-id://bb00c510-f33a-4159-93c3-890bf3ee4182) after capturing it from [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064); this is distinct from the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town of Joktheel listed in [Joshua](book-key://JOS).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Sela in Edom, near Petra, Jordan

locationsMap.name: Joppa
locationsMap.title: Mediterranean port of Jaffa used from Joshua to [Acts](book-key://ACT)
locationsMap.description: Joppa was the Mediterranean port associated with [Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd)'s border, timber shipments for the temple, [Jonah](name-id://ca68bc73-d617-4010-8c81-4cfff8cc650c)'s flight, and [Peter](name-id://2bcada1c-b00a-4214-8a2d-5a7b991f6641)'s ministry; it is the ancient city of Jaffa in Tel Aviv-Yafo.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jaffa, Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel

locationsMap.name: Jordan
locationsMap.title: short KJV form for the Jordan River
locationsMap.description: Jordan is the common biblical short form for the Jordan River, the north-south river crossed by [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9), Israel, [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652) and [Elisha](name-id://6e9af9e4-8635-4289-826f-bf6d37611683), and associated with John the Baptist's ministry.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jordan River

locationsMap.name: Jotbah
locationsMap.title: hometown of Meshullemeth in the reign of [Amon](name-id://d46db4a4-b3c7-491c-af01-87a8b0fffb0e)
locationsMap.description: Jotbah is named as the home of Haruz, father of Meshullemeth the mother of King [Amon](name-id://d46db4a4-b3c7-491c-af01-87a8b0fffb0e); it may be related to [Jotbathah](location-id://72a38431-42c2-4ad8-8b90-0cf5eec8f457), but the site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Jotbathah
locationsMap.title: wilderness encampment described as a place of brooks of water
locationsMap.description: Jotbathah was an Israelite wilderness station between [Hor-hagidgad](location-id://9abbc842-7fab-4245-8ccc-24215f315ff8) and Ebronah, remembered in [Deuteronomy](book-key://DEU) as a land of rivers or brooks of waters; it is often associated with the Yotvata area but remains uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with the Yotvata area in the southern Arabah, but not securely identified

locationsMap.name: Juttah
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) hill-country town assigned to the priests
locationsMap.description: Juttah was a hill-country town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed near [Maon](location-id://5dc48c50-612b-40c8-87f0-9948dab2dc29) and [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029) and later assigned as a priestly city; it is commonly identified with Yatta south of [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Yatta south of Hebron, West Bank

locationsMap.name: Kabzeel
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town also called Jekabzeel
locationsMap.description: Kabzeel was a town in the Negev of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and the home of [Benaiah](name-id://91de54b2-96b2-4c6d-b7f7-a5527791dec4) son of [Jehoiada](name-id://fc53f69b-d2c2-4ca9-b0ad-6a7813d40a03); after the exile it appears in [Nehemiah](book-key://NEH) under the form Jekabzeel, but its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Kadeshbarnea
locationsMap.title: hyphenated spelling of [Kadeshbarnea](location-id://42017171-050f-4b41-bdae-3081853e3e98) near [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)'s southern border
locationsMap.description: Kadeshbarnea is a common hyphenated form for [Kadeshbarnea](location-id://42017171-050f-4b41-bdae-3081853e3e98), the wilderness oasis from which the spies were sent and a landmark on [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)'s southern border; it is commonly identified with Tell el-Qudeirat or Ain el-Qudeirat, though details of the identification remain debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly identified with Tell el-Qudeirat / Ain el-Qudeirat in northern Sinai

locationsMap.name: Keilah
locationsMap.title: fortified town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) rescued by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)
locationsMap.description: Keilah was a town in the Shephelah of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), listed in [Joshua](book-key://JOS) and later rescued by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) from the [Philistines](name-id://35245676-ecab-4457-84b4-cc81d8d63bff) before [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) sought him there; it is commonly associated with Khirbet Qila, though the identification is not beyond dispute.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly associated with Khirbet Qila in the Hebron hills

locationsMap.name: Kadesh
locationsMap.title: wilderness oasis of Kadesh south of [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)
locationsMap.description: Kadesh was the major wilderness stopping place south of [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045), also called En-mishpat and closely associated with [Kadeshbarnea](location-id://42017171-050f-4b41-bdae-3081853e3e98); it is linked with the spies' report, [Miriam](name-id://a4c1c942-2737-4847-b6bf-9401d1dff9c3)'s death, [Meribah](location-id://dcb8b085-0b6a-4007-95ae-3b126617f544), and [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108)'s approach to [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly identified with Tell el-Qudeirat / Ain el-Qudeirat in northern Sinai

locationsMap.name: Kadeshbarnea
locationsMap.title: southern border oasis and Israelite encampment at Kadeshbarnea
locationsMap.description: Kadeshbarnea was the southern-border wilderness encampment associated with the spies, [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108)'s long stay near [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045), and boundary formulas for [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and the land of Canaan; it is commonly located at Tell el-Qudeirat / Ain el-Qudeirat.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly identified with Tell el-Qudeirat / Ain el-Qudeirat in northern Sinai

locationsMap.name: Kanah
locationsMap.title: brook of Kanah on the [Ephraim](name-id://4ad1140c-2b95-4513-bd55-ed594805df5f)-[Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe) border
locationsMap.description: The brook of Kanah marked part of the boundary between [Ephraim](name-id://4ad1140c-2b95-4513-bd55-ed594805df5f) and [Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe) before running westward toward the sea; it is commonly connected with Wadi Qanah, though the exact biblical boundary course remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly identified with Wadi Qanah in western Samaria

locationsMap.name: Karkor
locationsMap.title: Midianite camp reached by [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455) beyond Succoth
locationsMap.description: Karkor was the place where [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455) overtook [Zebah](name-id://5b286a28-586c-4773-bc78-2916a1040361) and [Zalmunna](name-id://88c87eec-2269-4fc9-a100-00483b8a4581) after pursuing the Midianites east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987); the site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Kartah
locationsMap.title: Levitical city in [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) assigned to [Merari](name-id://57093e1c-57b0-4ee4-bb65-9531a7532b73)
locationsMap.description: Kartah was one of the Zebulunite cities assigned to the Merarite Levites in [Joshua](book-key://JOS); it may be related to [Kattath](location-id://e8856fa2-a02b-48c1-95b8-5f4a1ae08435), but the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Kartan
locationsMap.title: [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) Levitical city corresponding to Kiriathaim
locationsMap.description: Kartan was a [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) city assigned to the Gershonite Levites in [Joshua](book-key://JOS); the parallel list in Chronicles appears to call the same Levitical city Kiriathaim, and its site remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Kattath
locationsMap.title: [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) town possibly related to [Kartah](location-id://f36ddbbb-3314-4eee-bb87-3a33263eed89)
locationsMap.description: Kattath was a town in [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c)'s allotment; it is often discussed with [Kartah](location-id://f36ddbbb-3314-4eee-bb87-3a33263eed89) from the Levitical city list, but the identification and exact location are uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Kedar
locationsMap.title: north Arabian Qedarite tribal territory
locationsMap.description: Kedar was the name of an Ishmaelite-descended Arab tribal confederation and its desert territory, associated in Scripture with black tents, flocks, archers, and trade from northern [Arabia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014) and the Syrian Desert.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Northern Arabian and Syrian Desert territory centered in the Wadi Sirhan and Dumat al-Jandal region

locationsMap.name: Kedemoth
locationsMap.title: Reubenite and Levitical city near the wilderness east of [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987)
locationsMap.description: Kedemoth was a Reubenite city assigned to the Merarite Levites, and the nearby wilderness was where [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) sent messengers to [Sihon](name-id://7aefa340-c02e-4e80-9ce5-24d4215f6341) king of [Heshbon](location-id://fcdae541-01d2-47f8-a663-45a2f056a250); the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Kedesh
locationsMap.title: Canaanite and Israelite city of refuge in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)
locationsMap.description: Kedesh was a Canaanite and Israelite city in Upper [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080), allotted to [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) and set apart as both a Levitical city and a city of refuge; Tiglath-pileser later captured it and deported its people.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Kedesh / Qadas in Upper Galilee near the Israel-Lebanon border

locationsMap.name: Kedeshnaphtali
locationsMap.title: [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) form of [Kedesh](location-id://1f447b5c-761c-4a77-bd5c-309916278396) associated with [Barak](name-id://e0bf01a1-7132-4645-8497-385aa029c28d)
locationsMap.description: Kedeshnaphtali is the Naphtalite form of [Kedesh](location-id://1f447b5c-761c-4a77-bd5c-309916278396), the Galilean city from which [Barak](name-id://e0bf01a1-7132-4645-8497-385aa029c28d) was summoned before the battle against [Sisera](name-id://23741267-e00a-4bad-9d7f-f66e9d398d4f); it corresponds to Tel Kedesh / Qadas in Upper [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Kedesh / Qadas in Upper Galilee near the Israel-Lebanon border

locationsMap.name: Kehelathah
locationsMap.title: Israelite wilderness encampment after [Rissah](location-id://f446aa52-2481-44b3-8ef2-3808176aa7c9)
locationsMap.description: Kehelathah was one of the wilderness stations in the itinerary of [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108), between [Rissah](location-id://f446aa52-2481-44b3-8ef2-3808176aa7c9) and mount Shapher; its precise location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Kenath
locationsMap.title: [Bashan](location-id://af0d12bf-aa1c-494c-9f89-8288fd65ef3d) city captured by [Nobah](name-id://fe72f557-9283-4917-b555-0e9f6b1f4ee4) and identified with Qanawat
locationsMap.description: Kenath was a city in [Bashan](location-id://af0d12bf-aa1c-494c-9f89-8288fd65ef3d) captured by [Nobah](name-id://fe72f557-9283-4917-b555-0e9f6b1f4ee4), who renamed it after himself; it is commonly identified with ancient Canatha, modern Qanawat in southern [Syria](location-id://f4fe75e3-4f92-4642-bf57-3d6a59931322).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Qanawat / ancient Canatha in Suwayda Governorate, Syria

locationsMap.name: Kerioth
locationsMap.title: Moabite city condemned by Jeremiah and Amos
locationsMap.description: Kerioth was a Moabite city named in prophetic judgments alongside other Moabite places; its exact site is uncertain and should not be confused with Kerioth Hezron in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119).

locationsMap.name: Kibrothhattaavah
locationsMap.title: wilderness station called the graves of lust
locationsMap.description: Kibrothhattaavah was the wilderness encampment where the Israelites buried those struck after craving flesh; it lay between [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210) and [Hazeroth](location-id://3445bd29-bbd4-4173-81af-0856a73129ec) in the itinerary, but its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Kibzaim
locationsMap.title: Ephraimite Levitical city assigned to [Kohath](name-id://bcab3b87-ef3d-4e2e-99ab-89f3c38bf19d)
locationsMap.description: Kibzaim was one of the Ephraimite cities assigned to the Kohathite Levites; it may correspond to [Jokmeam](location-id://547a7700-d3dd-4bbc-9d48-9304feab88b4) in the parallel list, but the site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Kidron
locationsMap.title: brook east of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) in the Kidron Valley
locationsMap.description: Kidron is the brook or wadi east of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), crossed by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) and [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) and used as a disposal place during temple reforms; it runs through the valley between Jerusalem and the [Mount of Olives](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000158).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Nahal Kidron / Wadi al-Joz and Wadi en-Nar east of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Kinah
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town in the Negev list
locationsMap.description: Kinah was a town listed among the southern settlements of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) near the Edomite border; its exact location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: King's Pool
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) pool near [Nehemiah](name-id://46c4c07f-dde8-4466-a278-6e40a8d3e7f1)'s inspection route
locationsMap.description: The King's Pool was a water feature near [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) on [Nehemiah](name-id://46c4c07f-dde8-4466-a278-6e40a8d3e7f1)'s nighttime inspection route between the fountain gate and the wall; it is often connected with the [Siloam](location-id://bb3b1b0e-e5ac-4f2f-854e-fdf517340d09) area, but the exact identification is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly the Pool of Siloam area in Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Kir
locationsMap.title: uncertain Aramean homeland and exile region called Kir
locationsMap.description: Kir is named as the place from which the Syrians came and to which [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) was exiled, and it appears with [Elam](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000067) in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA); its exact location is uncertain and should be distinguished from Kir of Moab / [Kirhareseth](location-id://85eac34b-ec54-4eb2-8ed6-49e666133726).

locationsMap.name: Kirhareseth
locationsMap.title: Moabite stronghold also called Kir of Moab
locationsMap.description: Kirhareseth, also called Kir-heres and Kir of Moab, was a major Moabite stronghold attacked in [Elisha](name-id://6e9af9e4-8635-4289-826f-bf6d37611683)'s day and lamented by the prophets; it is commonly identified with Kerak in Jordan.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Kerak / Al-Karak in Jordan

locationsMap.name: Kirjatharba
locationsMap.title: old name of [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103) in the hill country of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Kirjatharba was the earlier name of [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103), associated with [Arba](name-id://39be2398-22cb-4e9f-bc11-44b33d861665) and the Anakim; it is named in patriarchal burial narratives, Joshua's conquest traditions, and [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s town lists.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Hebron in the southern West Bank

locationsMap.name: Kirjatharim
locationsMap.title: postexilic form associated with [Kirjathjearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32)
locationsMap.description: Kirjatharim appears in Ezra's return list and is generally understood as a form of [Kirjathjearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32); the underlying site is commonly placed near Abu Ghosh or Deir el-Azar, though the precise identification is debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Abu Ghosh or nearby Deir el-Azar west of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Kirjathbaal
locationsMap.title: older Baal-name for [Kirjathjearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32)
locationsMap.description: Kirjathbaal was an older name for [Kirjathjearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32), also called [Baalah](location-id://1270f089-9927-4cf3-9e69-d552f1c4fdb3), on the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)-[Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) border; the site is commonly associated with the Abu Ghosh or Deir el-Azar area west of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Abu Ghosh or nearby Deir el-Azar west of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Kirjathhuzoth
locationsMap.title: Moabite place where [Balak](name-id://0cd1bb26-6e42-4461-ba13-77438e916c1f) met [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c)
locationsMap.description: Kirjathhuzoth was the place to which [Balak](name-id://0cd1bb26-6e42-4461-ba13-77438e916c1f) brought [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c) before offering oxen and sheep; it lay in [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153), but its exact site is not known.

locationsMap.name: Kirjathjearim
locationsMap.title: Gibeonite city where the ark stayed before [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)
locationsMap.description: Kirjathjearim was a Gibeonite city on the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)-[Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) border, also called [Kirjathbaal](location-id://6a7c3af7-0c2d-498a-a40b-8b11c0e9398d) and [Baalah](location-id://1270f089-9927-4cf3-9e69-d552f1c4fdb3), where the ark stayed in [Abinadab](name-id://9b70a51f-d1cb-45af-9619-65c616e1d8a5)'s house before [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) brought it toward [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Abu Ghosh or nearby Deir el-Azar west of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Kirjathsannah
locationsMap.title: alternate name of [Debir](location-id://4fa90dfe-b09a-4872-8ba1-3cfadf500c44) in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Kirjathsannah is the name used in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15) for the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) hill-country city also called [Debir](location-id://4fa90dfe-b09a-4872-8ba1-3cfadf500c44) and [Kirjathsepher](location-id://bb909fa5-a83b-42b1-bbc2-3000b754f92b); it is commonly associated with Khirbet Rabud, though the identification remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly associated with Khirbet Rabud southwest of Hebron, though older proposals differ

locationsMap.name: Kirjathsepher
locationsMap.title: alternate name of [Debir](location-id://4fa90dfe-b09a-4872-8ba1-3cfadf500c44) captured by [Othniel](name-id://05427ab6-5c60-4277-bc79-556cb2bbbd31)
locationsMap.description: Kirjathsepher was the older name of [Debir](location-id://4fa90dfe-b09a-4872-8ba1-3cfadf500c44) in the hill country of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), captured by [Othniel](name-id://05427ab6-5c60-4277-bc79-556cb2bbbd31) after [Caleb](name-id://2e9a92f4-f47e-4243-b5d1-5c0f7d746456) offered [Achsah](name-id://ef6fbeab-3593-41c7-83db-7ad59314b730) as wife to the conqueror; the site is commonly associated with Khirbet Rabud but remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly associated with Khirbet Rabud southwest of Hebron, though older proposals differ

locationsMap.name: Kiriathaim
locationsMap.title: Moabite city rebuilt by [Reuben](name-id://82279de3-ec8f-482d-a58d-119054ecb790) and later judged by prophets
locationsMap.description: Kiriathaim was a city east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) rebuilt by the children of [Reuben](name-id://82279de3-ec8f-482d-a58d-119054ecb790) and later named among Moabite cities in prophetic judgment; it is distinct from the [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) Levitical city called Kiriathaim in Chronicles.

locationsMap.name: Kishion
locationsMap.title: [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) city assigned to the Gershonites
locationsMap.description: Kishion was a town in [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) and a Levitical city assigned to the Gershonites; it is probably related to the Kishon/Kedesh textual variants in the Levitical city lists, and the site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Kishon
locationsMap.title: river of the [Jezreel](location-id://01fb54a8-39da-4de4-9ba9-6c91d7efff5b) Valley and [Mount Carmel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000154)
locationsMap.description: Kishon is the river or torrent associated with [Deborah](name-id://3fec4843-1e2e-4781-a8e7-f7aa0d955f5e) and [Barak](name-id://e0bf01a1-7132-4645-8497-385aa029c28d)'s victory over [Sisera](name-id://23741267-e00a-4bad-9d7f-f66e9d398d4f) and [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652)'s slaughter of [Baal](name-id://9f84fefd-7d37-4c14-a6f4-54a6d108db37)'s prophets near [Carmel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000154); it drains the [Jezreel](location-id://01fb54a8-39da-4de4-9ba9-6c91d7efff5b) Valley toward the Mediterranean.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Nahal Kishon in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Kitron
locationsMap.title: [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) city whose inhabitants were not driven out
locationsMap.description: Kitron was a Canaanite city in [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c)'s territory whose inhabitants Zebulun did not drive out; it may be related to [Kattath](location-id://e8856fa2-a02b-48c1-95b8-5f4a1ae08435), but the identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Kittim
locationsMap.title: [Cyprus](location-id://cddb5c4a-d659-447d-b7bd-cd2aee99dde2) and the western maritime lands called Chittim in the KJV
locationsMap.description: Kittim, Chittim in the KJV, originally points to Kition on [Cyprus](location-id://cddb5c4a-d659-447d-b7bd-cd2aee99dde2) and then broadly to Cyprus, Mediterranean islands, and western maritime powers; [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c) and [Daniel](name-id://2694d04f-5604-41a4-a5f6-31f3a7ef2d99) use it in this wider seafaring sense.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Cyprus, especially ancient Kition at modern Larnaca, with broader western maritime usage

locationsMap.name: Koa
locationsMap.title: uncertain eastern people or region named with [Pekod](location-id://861cd54c-6e72-43c3-9161-c36ba0a43037) and Shoa
locationsMap.description: Koa appears in [Ezekiel](book-key://EZK) with [Pekod](location-id://861cd54c-6e72-43c3-9161-c36ba0a43037), Shoa, and Assyrian-linked Babylonians; many identify it with Qutu or Gutium in the Zagros region, but the location remains uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly the Qutu/Gutium region in or near the Zagros, but uncertain

locationsMap.name: Lachish
locationsMap.title: fortified Shephelah city besieged by [Assyria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000023) and [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70)
locationsMap.description: Lachish was a major fortified city in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s lowland Shephelah, conquered in [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s campaign, fortified under Judah's kings, and later besieged by [Sennacherib](name-id://ba936e10-4238-4f16-bed8-eb31811cc5e5) and by Babylonian forces before [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) fell.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Lachish, also Tell ed-Duweir, in southern Israel

locationsMap.name: Laish
locationsMap.title: northern Sidonian city captured by Danites and renamed [Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd)
locationsMap.description: Laish was a quiet northern city with Sidonian connections that the Danites captured and renamed [Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd); it is the same site represented by the later biblical city Dan.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Dan, also Tell el-Qadi, in northern Israel near the Lebanon border

locationsMap.name: Land of Ham
locationsMap.title: poetic biblical name for [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065) in the [Psalms](book-key://PSA)
locationsMap.description: The land of Ham is the [Psalms](book-key://PSA)' poetic name for [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065), recalling Israel's sojourn there and God's wonders before the exodus; it is distinct from the place called [Ham](location-id://f37c7ce4-d9c3-4497-b3b1-dd499e2c4909) in [Genesis 14](chapter-key://GEN 14).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Egypt

locationsMap.name: Laodicea
locationsMap.title: Lycus Valley city addressed in [Colossians](book-key://COL) and [Revelation](book-key://REV)
locationsMap.description: Laodicea was a city in the Lycus Valley of Asia Minor near Colossae and [Hierapolis](location-id://aadabddf-e233-4782-9ffb-2e32d951c6e1), known in the New Testament from [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s letters and as one of the seven churches addressed in [Revelation](book-key://REV).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Laodicea on the Lycus near Denizli, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Lebanon
locationsMap.title: mountain and forested region north of [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108) famed for cedars
locationsMap.description: Lebanon in the Bible refers especially to the mountain and forested region north of [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108), famed for its cedars, used in boundary descriptions, royal building projects, poetry, and prophetic imagery.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Lebanon and the Lebanon mountain range

locationsMap.name: Lehi
locationsMap.title: place near Philistine territory where [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648) fought
locationsMap.description: Lehi was the place where [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) delivered [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648) to the Philistines and where Samson struck them with a jawbone, leading to the names [Ramath-lehi](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000191) and [En-hakkore](location-id://a5c92e19-24bb-44dc-a494-897c9a592a89); its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Lycia
locationsMap.title: southwestern Anatolian region on [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s voyage to [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b)
locationsMap.description: Lycia was the southwestern Anatolian region where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ship came to [Myra](location-id://c19fde22-547b-4542-adfd-66d13e15a5ea) during the voyage toward [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Lycia in southwestern Turkey

locationsMap.name: Lystra
locationsMap.title: Lycaonian city visited by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13)
locationsMap.description: Lystra was a city in [Lycaonia](location-id://5c29ab23-6d76-4fdf-be3b-4e2335bf187f) where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) healed a lame man, was stoned, later returned to strengthen disciples, and where [Timothy](name-id://46f00a24-cd01-4046-8e65-5e9144e66f50) was known among believers.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually identified near Klistra south of Konya, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Laban
locationsMap.title: unidentified place in the [Deuteronomy](book-key://DEU) wilderness setting
locationsMap.description: Laban appears in [Deuteronomy 1:1](verse-key://DEU 1:1) among places used to describe where [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) spoke beyond [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) in the wilderness; it is distinct from the person [Laban](name-id://02b09a01-9819-4182-895a-b0dda2395250) and has no secure modern identification.

locationsMap.name: Lahmam
locationsMap.title: lowland town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed near [Cabbon](location-id://24d76427-5960-4a69-b8f7-e01e0f00e432) and Kitlish
locationsMap.description: Lahmam was a town in the Shephelah district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed with [Cabbon](location-id://24d76427-5960-4a69-b8f7-e01e0f00e432), Kitlish, and [Gederoth](location-id://256b200f-89b4-4dd9-9640-79d3cb479554); its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Lasea
locationsMap.title: Cretan town near [Fair Havens](location-id://3bf42f08-064f-42ed-983b-c1044d9ee00b) on [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s voyage
locationsMap.description: Lasea was a town on [Crete](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000055) near [Fair Havens](location-id://3bf42f08-064f-42ed-983b-c1044d9ee00b), named in the account of [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s voyage to [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b) as the ship coasted along the south side of the island.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Ruins near Kaloi Limenes on the south coast of Crete

locationsMap.name: Lasha
locationsMap.title: uncertain Canaanite border point near the cities of the plain
locationsMap.description: Lasha was a boundary point in the table of nations marking the Canaanite border toward [Sodom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000212), [Gomorrah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000091), [Admah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003), and [Zeboim](location-id://1eb9376e-c266-4c4c-aa0a-e162ffd566db); proposals such as Callirrhoe east of the Dead Sea remain uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Lasharon
locationsMap.title: Canaanite royal city or district associated with [Sharon](location-id://e4a0da39-dd21-4734-890d-67d9359b8119)
locationsMap.description: Lasharon appears in [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s list of defeated kings; it may refer to a place in the [Sharon](location-id://e4a0da39-dd21-4734-890d-67d9359b8119) plain or to the king of Sharon, but the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Lebaoth
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town related to [Bethlebaoth](location-id://8287c858-fd35-44ba-8816-9f4ff916903a)
locationsMap.description: Lebaoth was a southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15), probably the same place or closely related to [Beth-lebaoth](location-id://8287c858-fd35-44ba-8816-9f4ff916903a) in Simeon's later town list; its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Lebonah
locationsMap.title: village north of [Shiloh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000203) on the road to [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201)
