locationsMap.description: Lebonah was a landmark village north of [Shiloh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000203) on the road going up from [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) to [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201), used to locate the vineyards where the daughters of Shiloh danced.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Al-Lubban ash-Sharqiya north of Shiloh

locationsMap.name: Leshem
locationsMap.title: northern city captured by Dan and renamed [Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd)
locationsMap.description: Leshem is the Joshua form of the northern city captured by the tribe of Dan and renamed [Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd), corresponding to [Laish](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000130) in [Judges 18](chapter-key://JDG 18).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Dan, also Tell el-Qadi, in northern Israel near the Lebanon border

locationsMap.name: Libnah
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) city conquered by [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816) and assigned to the priests
locationsMap.description: Libnah was a royal city in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s Shephelah, conquered in [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s southern campaign, assigned to the priests, later involved in Judah's political history, and named during Assyrian pressure on [Hezekiah](name-id://9854b257-50aa-4284-8f7b-84351d2b226f); this record is distinct from the wilderness station named Libnah.

locationsMap.name: Libya
locationsMap.title: North African region west of [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065) near [Cyrene](location-id://e1c99b43-6f7c-400b-a80c-1cc5f9f00761)
locationsMap.description: Libya in the Bible refers to the North African region west of [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065), including the parts about [Cyrene](location-id://e1c99b43-6f7c-400b-a80c-1cc5f9f00761) whose Jews were present at Pentecost.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Libya and adjacent North African territory west of Egypt

locationsMap.name: Lodebar
locationsMap.title: Gileadite town associated with [Machir](name-id://3e8718ae-295d-4964-bf4a-05ab30d7d74a) and [Mephibosheth](name-id://e74004fb-835d-40d8-9213-97860046982c)
locationsMap.description: Lodebar was an east-Jordan town where [Machir](name-id://3e8718ae-295d-4964-bf4a-05ab30d7d74a) son of [Ammiel](name-id://6f86090a-2d50-41f0-af84-d89d273b83b4) sheltered [Mephibosheth](name-id://e74004fb-835d-40d8-9213-97860046982c) and later aided [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c); [Amos](name-id://9e47ac42-242b-4fcc-9977-9bc195ad5a10) also uses the name in judgment speech, probably with wordplay, and the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Lod
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite town later known in Greek as [Lydda](location-id://8d32e0bd-538e-497c-a459-c4425bcc3a7d)
locationsMap.description: Lod was a town built or restored by Benjaminite families and later resettled by returning exiles; in the New Testament period the same site appears under the Greek name [Lydda](location-id://8d32e0bd-538e-497c-a459-c4425bcc3a7d).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Lod, Israel

locationsMap.name: Lud
locationsMap.title: distant bow-bearing nation or region in prophetic lists
locationsMap.description: Lud appears in prophetic lists among distant peoples and military allies, often connected with bowmen; it is commonly associated with Lydia or related western peoples, though the exact geographic reference is debated.

locationsMap.name: Luhith
locationsMap.title: ascent on [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)'s road of flight and lament
locationsMap.description: Luhith appears in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA) and [Jeremiah](book-key://JER) as the ascent of Luhith, part of the route of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)'s weeping and flight toward [Horonaim](location-id://ac671de1-f274-4b3c-a454-f5d6afbd6a33); its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Luz
locationsMap.title: earlier name of [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) in the hill country
locationsMap.description: Luz was the earlier name of [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032), the hill-country town where [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) named the place Bethel after his vision; this record is distinct from the later city called Luz in the land of the Hittites.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Beitin in the central West Bank

locationsMap.name: Lycaonia
locationsMap.title: south-central Anatolian region containing [Lystra](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000137) and [Derbe](location-id://e9d87a53-d807-4848-a41e-f8fb60bab6fc)
locationsMap.description: Lycaonia was the inland Anatolian region where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13) fled to [Lystra](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000137) and [Derbe](location-id://e9d87a53-d807-4848-a41e-f8fb60bab6fc) after opposition in [Iconium](location-id://e2e9f5a1-b479-4460-b43d-0c1ca9b14846).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: South-central Anatolia around Konya and Karaman, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Lydda
locationsMap.title: New Testament form of [Lod](location-id://3489d177-3d3f-42b0-91da-f3ce024c9316) where [Peter](name-id://2bcada1c-b00a-4214-8a2d-5a7b991f6641) healed [Aeneas](name-id://caa4f1bf-23eb-43c0-a5b0-b977b7691ca4)
locationsMap.description: Lydda was the Greek New Testament name for [Lod](location-id://3489d177-3d3f-42b0-91da-f3ce024c9316), where [Peter](name-id://2bcada1c-b00a-4214-8a2d-5a7b991f6641) visited the saints and healed [Aeneas](name-id://caa4f1bf-23eb-43c0-a5b0-b977b7691ca4); the event became known in Lydda and nearby Saron.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Lod, Israel

locationsMap.name: Macedonia
locationsMap.title: Roman province in northern [Greece](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000094) visited by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)
locationsMap.description: Macedonia was the Roman province north of [Achaia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002) where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) was called in a vision and later ministered in cities such as [Philippi](location-id://b9e3c9b4-d890-4ba6-b440-1d71b3ff8143), [Thessalonica](location-id://b6bc0597-c58a-450e-8681-3c7e39704491), and [Berea](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000029).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The historical region of Macedonia in northern Greece and adjacent Balkans

locationsMap.name: Marah
locationsMap.title: bitter-water wilderness station after the [Red Sea](location-id://26deae24-2471-47c1-8280-28e380224f20) crossing
locationsMap.description: Marah was the wilderness station where Israel found bitter water after crossing the [Red Sea](location-id://26deae24-2471-47c1-8280-28e380224f20) and the LORD made the waters sweet before they moved toward [Elim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000068).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often proposed near Ain Hawarah in the western Sinai, though the identification is uncertain

locationsMap.name: Mareshah
locationsMap.title: lowland city of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) identified with Tel Maresha
locationsMap.description: Mareshah was a city in the lowland of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), fortified by [Rehoboam](name-id://68d5eac0-52b9-4b0b-b484-8c7b5c3b8971) and later associated with [Asa](name-id://f5d139c3-aaad-4422-87a8-6b31e0fbc485)'s victory over [Zerah](name-id://5a52b3ea-ca2b-4221-8273-db2b558771af) and Micah's oracle against the towns of Judah.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Maresha in Beit Guvrin-Maresha National Park, Israel

locationsMap.name: Media
locationsMap.title: ancient Median region east of [Mesopotamia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000151)
locationsMap.description: Media was the land of the Medes, paired with [Persia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000181) in [Esther](book-key://EST) and [Daniel](book-key://DAN) and named by the prophets as an eastern power involved in judgment on [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Northwestern Iran, especially the region around ancient Ecbatana / Hamadan

locationsMap.name: Megiddo
locationsMap.title: strategic Canaanite city in the Jezreel Valley
locationsMap.description: Megiddo was a major fortified city controlling routes through the Jezreel Valley, named in Israel's allotments, [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s building works, [Josiah](name-id://60cb7338-d759-439a-8ad6-ecccf0f9d30a)'s death, and [Zechariah](name-id://88259e4e-cf3c-4a25-95d6-e97ebb74f825)'s mourning image.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Megiddo in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Memphis
locationsMap.title: ancient Egyptian capital called Noph in the KJV
locationsMap.description: Memphis, the ancient Egyptian capital near the Nile, appears in the KJV chiefly under the name Noph in prophetic judgments against [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Memphis / Mit Rahina near Cairo, Egypt

locationsMap.name: Mesopotamia
locationsMap.title: land between the rivers in the Fertile Crescent
locationsMap.description: Mesopotamia was the broad land between the Tigris and [Euphrates](location-id://0bdad9de-f6dc-4681-8a5a-54526382bc9f), including Aram-naharaim in patriarchal narratives and Jewish diaspora territory in [Acts](book-key://ACT).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Tigris-Euphrates region, chiefly in modern Iraq and Syria

locationsMap.name: Midian
locationsMap.title: territory of the Midianites in northwestern [Arabia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014) and the southern Levant
locationsMap.description: Midian was the territory associated with [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73)' exile, [Jethro](name-id://189a495a-77eb-474c-a77f-16ee50da6c22), and the Midianites who opposed Israel; its exact extent shifted and is not reducible to one secure point.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly placed around northwestern Arabia and adjacent southern Transjordan/Sinai zones

locationsMap.name: Moab
locationsMap.title: kingdom and plateau east of the Dead Sea
locationsMap.description: Moab was [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108)'s neighboring kingdom east of the Dead Sea, repeatedly named in wilderness narratives, Ruth, royal histories, and prophetic oracles against the Moabite land and people.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Moabite plateau in central Jordan east of the Dead Sea

locationsMap.name: Mount Carmel
locationsMap.title: coastal mountain ridge where [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652) confronted Baal's prophets
locationsMap.description: Mount Carmel is the prominent ridge near the Mediterranean coast, best known in Kings as the place where [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652) challenged the prophets of Baal.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Carmel ridge in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Mount Ephraim
locationsMap.title: central hill country associated with the tribe of [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c)
locationsMap.description: Mount Ephraim is the KJV expression for the hill country of [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) in the central highlands, used as a regional setting rather than one isolated summit.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Central hill country of Samaria / the West Bank

locationsMap.name: Mount Hermon
locationsMap.title: northern mountain marking [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108)'s highland boundary
locationsMap.description: Mount Hermon is the high mountain at [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108)'s northern frontier, associated with [Bashan](location-id://af0d12bf-aa1c-494c-9f89-8288fd65ef3d), [Lebanon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000133), and the northern limit of territories conquered east of [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Hermon / Jabal al-Shaykh on the Lebanon-Syria border region

locationsMap.name: Mount Nebo
locationsMap.title: Moabite mountain where [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) viewed [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)
locationsMap.description: Mount Nebo was the mountain in [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153), opposite [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116) and associated with [Pisgah](location-id://2f1847ff-51c6-41d4-a74b-a9a1075e7cb0), from which [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) viewed the promised land before his death.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jabal Nibu / Mount Nebo in Jordan

locationsMap.name: Mount of Olives
locationsMap.title: ridge east of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) across the [Kidron](location-id://1b95372c-c14a-4b30-a247-cad60acefe7c) Valley
locationsMap.description: The Mount of Olives is the ridge east of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), crossed by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) in grief and repeatedly associated in the Gospels with [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab)' teaching, prayer, and approach to the city.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount of Olives in Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Mount Sinai
locationsMap.title: mountain of the covenant in the wilderness
locationsMap.description: Mount Sinai was the wilderness mountain where Israel received the law and where the New Testament recalls [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73)' encounter with God, though the exact historical site remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally identified with Jebel Musa in the Sinai Peninsula

locationsMap.name: Mount Tabor
locationsMap.title: isolated Galilean mountain near the battle with [Sisera](name-id://23741267-e00a-4bad-9d7f-f66e9d398d4f)
locationsMap.description: Mount Tabor is the mountain in [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080) where [Barak](name-id://e0bf01a1-7132-4645-8497-385aa029c28d) gathered troops before the battle against [Sisera](name-id://23741267-e00a-4bad-9d7f-f66e9d398d4f) in the days of [Deborah](name-id://3fec4843-1e2e-4781-a8e7-f7aa0d955f5e).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Tabor in Lower Galilee, Israel

locationsMap.name: Mount Zemaraim
locationsMap.title: Ephraimite mountain where [Abijah](name-id://d8aba678-e5c1-4266-897a-cf7193ccdff3) addressed [Jeroboam](name-id://44442ff1-d137-4b0c-b117-4ccacc9df7f1)
locationsMap.description: Mount Zemaraim was the mountain in [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) from which King [Abijah](name-id://d8aba678-e5c1-4266-897a-cf7193ccdff3) spoke before battle with [Jeroboam](name-id://44442ff1-d137-4b0c-b117-4ccacc9df7f1); its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Mount Zion
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) mountain name for [Zion](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000245) and the LORD's dwelling
locationsMap.description: Mount Zion is the biblical mountain name attached to [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), especially the LORD's chosen dwelling and royal city, with later usage also associated with the southwestern hill of Jerusalem.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jerusalem; the biblical usage centers on Zion/Temple Mount and later tradition on the southwest hill

locationsMap.name: Mysia
locationsMap.title: northwestern Asia Minor region passed by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)
locationsMap.description: Mysia was the northwestern Asia Minor region through which [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and his companions passed before going down to [Troas](location-id://a8c09279-58fd-483a-89e8-3af948752c58) during the second missionary journey.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Northwestern Anatolia in modern Turkey

locationsMap.name: Maacah
locationsMap.title: Aramean kingdom or territory near [Hermon](location-id://9ed57141-d70e-475b-b75f-a72a0f541a48)
locationsMap.description: Maacah was a small Aramean kingdom or territory near the northern Transjordan and [Hermon](location-id://9ed57141-d70e-475b-b75f-a72a0f541a48) region, named with the Syrians who aided [Ammon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010) and in notices about Maachathites.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually placed near the southern Anti-Lebanon or Golan/Hermon region

locationsMap.name: Maarath
locationsMap.title: hill-country town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Maarath was one of the towns listed in the hill country allotment of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119); its exact archaeological identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Machpelah
locationsMap.title: cave and field bought by [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412) near [Mamre](location-id://9535f3e5-02a6-4642-b98c-cc2c6775c0df)
locationsMap.description: Machpelah was the field and cave [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412) purchased from [Ephron](name-id://0ca8d1c0-4e7b-4744-93f6-20d31d5d596d) the Hittite as a burial possession for [Sarah](name-id://3b881f0a-320a-4065-ba4e-aae92ee71d34) and later patriarchal family burials near [Mamre](location-id://9535f3e5-02a6-4642-b98c-cc2c6775c0df) and [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Cave of the Patriarchs / Tomb of the Patriarchs in Hebron

locationsMap.name: Madmannah
locationsMap.title: Negev town in the allotment of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Madmannah was a town in the Negev district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and is also connected genealogically with [Caleb](name-id://2e9a92f4-f47e-4243-b5d1-5c0f7d746456)'s descendants; its precise site remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Madmenah
locationsMap.title: place north of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) in [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b)'s invasion route
locationsMap.description: Madmenah is named in [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b)'s poetic route of an approaching invader against [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117); it was probably a small settlement near the [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)-[Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) highlands, but the site is not secure.

locationsMap.name: Madon
locationsMap.title: Canaanite royal city in northern [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)
locationsMap.description: Madon was the city of a Canaanite king allied with [Jabin](name-id://bdf10225-441a-4ddf-a400-bc72cb46bb4c) of [Hazor](location-id://913fe6c4-c9d7-41b6-b74a-da1b7354f163) against [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816); its exact location in northern [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) is debated.

locationsMap.name: Magog
locationsMap.title: land or nation associated with [Gog](name-id://86b9a74e-acde-48b6-8c38-bb32b2c3d404)
locationsMap.description: Magog appears as a land or people associated with [Gog](name-id://86b9a74e-acde-48b6-8c38-bb32b2c3d404) in [Ezekiel](book-key://EZK) and as part of the symbolic nations gathered in [Revelation](book-key://REV), so it cannot be fixed to one secure modern point.

locationsMap.name: Mahanaim
locationsMap.title: Transjordan town named for God's hosts
locationsMap.description: Mahanaim was a Transjordan town east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) associated with [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9), the Levitical allotment in Gad, [Ishbosheth](name-id://064f2127-c483-400b-95c5-e40320e81cd6)'s court, and [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s refuge during [Absalom](name-id://0e94a17b-69b1-4148-b7de-72eab8eea4cc)'s revolt.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually sought in the Jabbok/Gilead region east of Jordan, exact site uncertain

locationsMap.name: Mahanehdan
locationsMap.title: camp of Dan near [Zorah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000244) and [Eshtaol](location-id://be9e4d68-94ed-4beb-9dfb-3d4bb171cb65)
locationsMap.description: Mahanehdan, meaning the camp of Dan, lay between [Zorah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000244) and [Eshtaol](location-id://be9e4d68-94ed-4beb-9dfb-3d4bb171cb65) and later west of [Kiriath-jearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32) in the narrative of the Danite migration.

locationsMap.name: Makaz
locationsMap.title: town in one of [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s provision districts
locationsMap.description: Makaz was a place in the second administrative district of [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f), listed with [Shaalbim](location-id://4413d56c-bdd0-455a-8cbc-9f64e00baae6), [Beth-shemesh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000037), and Elon-beth-hanan; its precise site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Makheloth
locationsMap.title: wilderness station in Israel's journey list
locationsMap.description: Makheloth was one of the wilderness stations in [Numbers 33](chapter-key://NUM 33), between [Tahath](location-id://50c81a6b-7570-4d1c-9bbc-57efeca9be4f) and [Hashmonah](location-id://e5d04065-ad2b-409d-9b26-5f5d139e0ae6); its location is not securely known.

locationsMap.name: Makkedah
locationsMap.title: Canaanite city and cave site in the Shephelah
locationsMap.description: Makkedah was the city near the cave where five Amorite kings hid after [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s battle, and it became one of the conquered cities in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s lowland list; the exact site is debated.

locationsMap.name: Mamre
locationsMap.title: site near [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103) associated with [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412) and [Machpelah](location-id://8c80b25d-f83e-433c-a8f3-ba789cdc5721)
locationsMap.description: Mamre was the place near [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103) where [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412) dwelt and later a landmark for the field and cave of [Machpelah](location-id://8c80b25d-f83e-433c-a8f3-ba789cdc5721) used for the patriarchal burials.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditional site at Ramat el-Khalil near Hebron

locationsMap.name: Manahath
locationsMap.title: place connected with Benjaminite relocation
locationsMap.description: Manahath is named as a place to which Benjaminite families were removed; its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Maon
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) hill-country town and wilderness near [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s refuge
locationsMap.description: Maon was a town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s hill country, associated with the wilderness where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) hid from [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) and with [Nabal](name-id://a7a7a8cc-36dc-4b0a-a3b4-dcf2097a989a)'s estate near [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Khirbet Ma'in south of Hebron is commonly proposed

locationsMap.name: Maroth
locationsMap.title: place in Micah's oracle over [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s towns
locationsMap.description: Maroth appears in Micah's lament over towns of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), probably in the Shephelah or approach to [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), but its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Mashal
locationsMap.title: alternate form of [Mishal](location-id://9a19b7d3-a4d2-49a7-b357-4d84ac6e3b34), a Levitical city in Asher
locationsMap.description: Mashal is the Chronicles form corresponding to [Mishal](location-id://9a19b7d3-a4d2-49a7-b357-4d84ac6e3b34), a Levitical city assigned from Asher to the Gershonites; the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Masrekah
locationsMap.title: Edomite royal city of [Samlah](name-id://be8ae5e0-f653-4d72-9e32-0e35a19b5483)
locationsMap.description: Masrekah was the city of [Samlah](name-id://be8ae5e0-f653-4d72-9e32-0e35a19b5483), one of the kings who reigned in [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064) before Israel had kings; its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Massah
locationsMap.title: testing place at [Rephidim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000194) also called [Meribah](location-id://dcb8b085-0b6a-4007-95ae-3b126617f544)
locationsMap.description: Massah was the place where Israel tempted the LORD over water in the wilderness, paired with [Meribah](location-id://dcb8b085-0b6a-4007-95ae-3b126617f544) in the [Rephidim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000194) episode and recalled later as a warning.

locationsMap.name: Mattanah
locationsMap.title: wilderness station between [Beer](location-id://049ca9d3-8f2f-46bf-8af0-f4a4f51915f9) and [Nahaliel](location-id://426af838-96f4-4016-a82e-4cefeeb9f86a)
locationsMap.description: Mattanah was one of Israel's journey stations in the Transjordan approach to [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153), listed between [Beer](location-id://049ca9d3-8f2f-46bf-8af0-f4a4f51915f9) and [Nahaliel](location-id://426af838-96f4-4016-a82e-4cefeeb9f86a); the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Mejarkon
locationsMap.title: Danite border waters of the Jarkon
locationsMap.description: Mejarkon, meaning waters of Jarkon, was part of Dan's boundary list and is commonly associated with the Yarkon River area near the coastal plain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Yarkon River area near Tel Aviv, Israel

locationsMap.name: Mearah
locationsMap.title: Sidonian-area place remaining to be possessed
locationsMap.description: Mearah is listed in [Joshua](book-key://JOS) among northern lands still to be possessed, near Sidonian territory and Aphek; the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Medeba
locationsMap.title: Moabite plateau city identified with Madaba
locationsMap.description: Medeba was a city on the Moabite plateau, included in Reuben's territory and later named in Moabite oracles; it is identified with modern Madaba.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Madaba, Jordan

locationsMap.name: Mephaath
locationsMap.title: Levitical city in Reuben later named in [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)'s judgment
locationsMap.description: Mephaath was a city in Reuben assigned to the Levites and later included in Jeremiah's oracle against the cities of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153); the precise site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Merathaim
locationsMap.title: symbolic name for the rebellious land of [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70)
locationsMap.description: Merathaim in [Jeremiah 50](chapter-key://JER 50) is a symbolic or poetic name, likely meaning double rebellion, applied to the Babylonian land rather than a securely mapped town.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Babylonia, used symbolically in Jeremiah's oracle

locationsMap.name: MeribahKadesh
locationsMap.title: waters of strife at [Kadesh](location-id://501d3b61-a4e6-4e1e-82b1-f8799fb77131) in the wilderness of Zin
locationsMap.description: MeribahKadesh was the [Kadesh](location-id://501d3b61-a4e6-4e1e-82b1-f8799fb77131) water-strife site in the wilderness of Zin where [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) and [Aaron](name-id://03e737be-a164-4fe2-bd83-b19b217959dc) rebelled, later marking the southern land boundary in [Ezekiel](book-key://EZK).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Near Kadesh, commonly associated with the Tell el-Qudeirat / Ain el-Qudeirat area

locationsMap.name: Meribah
locationsMap.title: waters of strife at [Massah](location-id://044e4c2e-3d9d-44c9-95aa-e0be5cb0fd99) near [Rephidim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000194)
locationsMap.description: Meribah, paired with [Massah](location-id://044e4c2e-3d9d-44c9-95aa-e0be5cb0fd99) in [Exodus 17](chapter-key://EXO 17), was the place where Israel strove with [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) over water near [Rephidim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000194); the Kadesh episode is kept separately as [MeribahKadesh](location-id://ede02011-b03d-4721-9ea9-0e5d376a9a55).

locationsMap.name: Merom
locationsMap.title: waters in northern [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) where [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816) defeated [Jabin](name-id://bdf10225-441a-4ddf-a400-bc72cb46bb4c)'s coalition
locationsMap.description: The waters of Merom were the northern battle site where [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816) defeated the coalition led by [Jabin](name-id://bdf10225-441a-4ddf-a400-bc72cb46bb4c) of [Hazor](location-id://913fe6c4-c9d7-41b6-b74a-da1b7354f163); the site is often associated with the Hula basin but remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with the Hula basin north of the Sea of Galilee

locationsMap.name: Meroz
locationsMap.title: unidentified place cursed in [Deborah](name-id://3fec4843-1e2e-4781-a8e7-f7aa0d955f5e)'s song
locationsMap.description: Meroz was cursed in [Deborah](name-id://3fec4843-1e2e-4781-a8e7-f7aa0d955f5e)'s song because its inhabitants did not help in the battle; its exact location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Mesha
locationsMap.title: Joktanite boundary place in [Genesis](book-key://GEN)
locationsMap.description: Mesha in [Genesis 10](chapter-key://GEN 10) marks one end of the dwelling area of [Joktan](name-id://a787d465-281f-4826-be1e-4239728217bc)'s descendants toward [Sephar](location-id://fb48fb6a-b85a-4c8d-b561-55e75b89783b); it is a place-name here, not the Moabite king, and its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Meshech
locationsMap.title: Japhethite people or region often paired with [Tubal](location-id://a2dd24e0-5ecb-4776-bd32-a7b38043a5d8)
locationsMap.description: Meshech is a people or region in the far north of Israel's world, paired with [Tubal](location-id://a2dd24e0-5ecb-4776-bd32-a7b38043a5d8) in trade and prophetic oracles; no single secure modern point can be assigned.

locationsMap.name: Methegammah
locationsMap.title: Philistine place or phrase taken by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)
locationsMap.description: Methegammah in [2 Samuel 8:1](verse-key://2SA 8:1) is a difficult KJV place phrase connected with [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s victory over the Philistines, often understood in relation to [Gath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000082) or its control; the exact geography is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Michmas
locationsMap.title: postexilic spelling of [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd) in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)
locationsMap.description: Michmas is the Ezra-Nehemiah spelling of [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd), the Benjaminite town north of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) whose people returned from exile.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mukhmas in the central West Bank

locationsMap.name: Michmash
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite town and pass north of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: Michmash was a town in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) near a strategic pass, central to [Jonathan](name-id://0654ad89-fc99-484a-8771-b277e9225953)'s attack on the Philistines and later named among returned settlements and [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b)'s invasion route.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mukhmas in the central West Bank

locationsMap.name: Middin
locationsMap.title: wilderness town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) near the Dead Sea
locationsMap.description: Middin was one of the wilderness towns in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s allotment near the Dead Sea; the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Migdalel
locationsMap.title: fortified town in Naphtali's allotment
locationsMap.description: Migdalel was a fortified city in Naphtali's territory; its exact identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Migdalgad
locationsMap.title: lowland city of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Migdalgad was a city in the lowland allotment of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), listed with [Dilean](location-id://ac869c17-3d43-428f-aefc-f9c26566982f) and [Mizpeh](location-id://6281e102-ea7d-43b4-8f82-d2230c73c801); the site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Migdol
locationsMap.title: Egyptian fortress or frontier site name
locationsMap.description: Migdol means tower and names an Egyptian frontier place in the exodus itinerary and prophetic lists; the references may not all point to one securely identified site.

locationsMap.name: Migron
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite place near [Gibeah](location-id://41084ab0-6cbc-4232-a844-fb8b405d97c3) and [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd)
locationsMap.description: Migron was a place in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) associated with [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)'s position near [Gibeah](location-id://41084ab0-6cbc-4232-a844-fb8b405d97c3) and [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b)'s invasion route near [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd); the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Miletus
locationsMap.title: Ionian port city where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) met the Ephesian elders
locationsMap.description: Miletus was a port city on the western coast of Asia Minor where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) stopped and summoned the elders of [Ephesus](location-id://d0d9344d-8013-4dee-a125-bf3ca8d6810f) on his journey toward [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Miletus archaeological site near Balat, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Millo
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) fortification or terrace associated with Davidic building
locationsMap.description: The Millo was a fortification or filled terrace associated with [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s defenses and royal building works, though the precise structure remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually located in the City of David / ancient Jerusalem fortification complex

locationsMap.name: Minnith
locationsMap.title: Ammonite-area town reached by [Jephthah](name-id://a0e52599-bd88-4cc9-bf3c-5c0127087f95)
locationsMap.description: Minnith was a place reached in [Jephthah](name-id://a0e52599-bd88-4cc9-bf3c-5c0127087f95)'s victory over [Ammon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010) and later known for wheat in trade with [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226); its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Minni
locationsMap.title: northern kingdom or region summoned against [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70)
locationsMap.description: Minni was a northern land named with [Ararat](location-id://b0b0e5e2-4d25-4307-bdb4-01a5d5f02551) and Ashchenaz in Jeremiah's summons against [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70), commonly connected with the Mannaean region, but the exact limits are uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with the Mannaean region south of Lake Urmia

locationsMap.name: Mishal
locationsMap.title: Levitical city in Asher also called [Mashal](location-id://0e94f550-bc08-44db-9e3c-e968f41f43fd)
locationsMap.description: Mishal was a town in Asher's allotment and a Levitical city for the Gershonites, corresponding to the form [Mashal](location-id://0e94f550-bc08-44db-9e3c-e968f41f43fd) in Chronicles.

locationsMap.name: Misrephothmaim
locationsMap.title: northern coastal place near Sidonian territory
locationsMap.description: Misrephothmaim was a place toward which defeated northern Canaanite forces fled and later a boundary marker near Sidonian territory; its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Mitylene
locationsMap.title: city on Lesbos where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ship stopped
locationsMap.description: Mitylene was the chief city of Lesbos where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ship touched during the voyage from [Troas](location-id://a8c09279-58fd-483a-89e8-3af948752c58) toward [Miletus](location-id://2a3d81b9-2d80-47f4-ac15-1aae05193c1a).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mytilene on Lesbos, Greece

locationsMap.name: Mizpah of Benjamin
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite city and gathering place north of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: Mizpah of Benjamin was a major assembly and administrative site near [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), associated with Israel's gatherings in [Judges](book-key://JDG) and Samuel, [Asa](name-id://f5d139c3-aaad-4422-87a8-6b31e0fbc485)'s building, and [Gedaliah](name-id://4c0cd7c0-acde-4d0d-9fcb-0ce263bb46ea)'s governorship after Jerusalem fell.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly identified with Tell en-Nasbeh north of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Mizpah of Gilead
locationsMap.title: [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089) watch-place associated with [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) and [Jephthah](name-id://a0e52599-bd88-4cc9-bf3c-5c0127087f95)
locationsMap.description: Mizpah of Gilead was the Transjordan watch-place linked with [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9)'s covenant marker and [Jephthah](name-id://a0e52599-bd88-4cc9-bf3c-5c0127087f95)'s mustering and return in [Judges](book-key://JDG); its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Mizpeh of Moab
locationsMap.title: Moabite refuge where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) placed his parents
locationsMap.description: Mizpeh of Moab was the place where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) asked the king of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) to shelter his father and mother while [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) pursued him; its exact location in Moab is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Mizpeh of Judah
locationsMap.title: lowland town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s allotment
locationsMap.description: Mizpeh of Judah was a town in the Shephelah allotment of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), listed with [Dilean](location-id://ac869c17-3d43-428f-aefc-f9c26566982f) and [Joktheel](location-id://78f0de4b-50f9-4194-88b4-e8ddf2e3e59a); its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Moladah
locationsMap.title: Negev town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and Simeon
locationsMap.description: Moladah was a town in the Negev allotted to [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and later associated with Simeon, and it was occupied again after the exile; its exact site is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often identified with Tell el-Milh / Tel Malhata, though not certain

locationsMap.name: Moreshethgath
locationsMap.title: [Micah](name-id://cab2e18a-bf75-4762-a495-fb2c18d3277b)'s hometown near [Gath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000082) in the Shephelah
locationsMap.description: Moreshethgath was a town associated with the prophet [Micah](name-id://cab2e18a-bf75-4762-a495-fb2c18d3277b) and located near [Gath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000082) in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s lowland region; its exact identification is debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Tell ej-Judeideh / the Maresha area

locationsMap.name: Moriah
locationsMap.title: land or mountain associated with [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412) and the temple site
locationsMap.description: Moriah is the land named in [Genesis](book-key://GEN) for [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412)'s offering of [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf) and is later linked with [Mount Moriah](location-id://f2920de4-f723-4088-8d2b-908c6cdb3340) where [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f) built the temple, though the [Genesis](book-key://GEN) geography is debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally associated with the Temple Mount in Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Moseroth
locationsMap.title: wilderness station corresponding to Moserah
locationsMap.description: Moseroth was a wilderness station in [Numbers 33](chapter-key://NUM 33), between [Hashmonah](location-id://e5d04065-ad2b-409d-9b26-5f5d139e0ae6)/Mithkah and [Bene-jaakan](location-id://c7b0b079-e164-4592-938b-344bc88f2f06), and is commonly connected with Moserah in [Deuteronomy](book-key://DEU); the exact location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Mount Baalah
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) boundary height near Jabneel
locationsMap.description: Mount Baalah was a boundary point in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s western border near Jabneel and the sea; its exact identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Mount Ebal
locationsMap.title: covenant mountain north of [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201)
locationsMap.description: Mount Ebal was the mountain north of [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) where curses were pronounced and where [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816) built an altar after entering the land.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Ebal / Jabal Ebal near Nablus

locationsMap.name: Mount Ephron
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)-[Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) boundary area west of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: Mount Ephron or the cities of Mount Ephron belong to the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)-[Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) boundary geography near [Nephtoah](location-id://0864ddf3-9c69-415e-9168-616d4e0072fe) and [Kiriath-jearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32); the exact ridge or towns are not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Mount Gerizim
locationsMap.title: covenant mountain south of [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201)
locationsMap.description: Mount Gerizim was the mountain south of [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) where blessings were pronounced and where [Jotham](name-id://bd07614f-74ac-444c-92f6-5269ba4919d0) addressed the men of Shechem.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Gerizim / Jabal at-Tur near Nablus

locationsMap.name: Mount Gilboa
locationsMap.title: mountain range where [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) and [Jonathan](name-id://0654ad89-fc99-484a-8771-b277e9225953) fell
locationsMap.description: Mount Gilboa is the ridge where Israel was defeated by the Philistines and [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) and [Jonathan](name-id://0654ad89-fc99-484a-8771-b277e9225953) died, later lamented by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Gilboa ridge in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Mount Gilead
locationsMap.title: uncertain height named in [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s mustering story
locationsMap.description: Mount Gilead is named in [Judges](book-key://JDG) as the place from which fearful men could depart from [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s force, but its exact location is uncertain and may not be the broader trans-Jordan [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089) region.

locationsMap.name: Mount Halak
locationsMap.title: southern boundary mountain rising toward [Seir](location-id://3fc9393f-3978-40df-9a42-b7bc33401f98)
locationsMap.description: Mount Halak marked the southern reach of [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s conquests, described as the mountain that goes up to [Seir](location-id://3fc9393f-3978-40df-9a42-b7bc33401f98), but its precise modern location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Mount Heres
locationsMap.title: Amorite-held height near [Aijalon](location-id://6d63bb71-0ada-4fc1-bfdd-fe6948d7cfd4)
locationsMap.description: Mount Heres was a height in the [Aijalon](location-id://6d63bb71-0ada-4fc1-bfdd-fe6948d7cfd4) area where Amorites continued to dwell before [Joseph](name-id://207b40a3-2f5b-44bb-b90a-334cc21398b3)'s house put them under tribute.

locationsMap.name: Mount Hor
locationsMap.title: mountain near [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064) where [Aaron](name-id://03e737be-a164-4fe2-bd83-b19b217959dc) died
locationsMap.description: Mount Hor was the mountain by the border of [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064) where [Aaron](name-id://03e737be-a164-4fe2-bd83-b19b217959dc) died and Israel turned back from Edom during the wilderness journey.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally identified with Jabal Harun near Petra, Jordan

locationsMap.name: Mount Horeb
locationsMap.title: mountain of God associated with [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210)
locationsMap.description: Mount Horeb was the mountain of God where Israel stripped off ornaments after the golden calf and is closely associated with [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210) in the wilderness traditions.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally identified with Jebel Musa in the Sinai Peninsula

locationsMap.name: Mount Jearim
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) boundary mountain near [Chesalon](location-id://b8e05fb9-94f7-44dd-baa5-a9ab9e9864b7)
locationsMap.description: Mount Jearim lay on [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s northern boundary between [Mount Seir](location-id://1fc0310b-6406-44fd-af5f-6d5818c64181) and [Chesalon](location-id://b8e05fb9-94f7-44dd-baa5-a9ab9e9864b7), in the hill country near [Kirjath-jearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32), though its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Mount Lebanon
locationsMap.title: [Lebanon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000133) mountain range named in [Judges](book-key://JDG)
locationsMap.description: Mount Lebanon is the mountain range north of Israel where Hivites dwelt from Mount Baal-hermon toward the entrance of [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Lebanon range in Lebanon

locationsMap.name: Mount Moriah
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) temple mountain in Chronicles
locationsMap.description: Mount Moriah was the site in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) where [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f) built the house of the LORD, at the threshingfloor of [Ornan](name-id://c4a48566-690a-4980-92b6-912a9fac624e) the Jebusite.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Temple Mount in Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Mount Paran
locationsMap.title: poetic southern mountain associated with [Paran](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000177)
locationsMap.description: Mount Paran is named in [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73)' blessing and [Habakkuk](name-id://4446a029-c22a-4d59-b9c4-578c8409d91a)'s theophany as a southern wilderness mountain associated with [Paran](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000177), but its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Mount Perazim
locationsMap.title: prophetic allusion to the [Baal-perazim](location-id://24ae01e7-09f6-4e4b-8e90-e6d1a89dd76c) victory site
locationsMap.description: Mount Perazim is named in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA) as the place where the LORD rose up as at Perazim, an allusion to [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s victory at [Baal-perazim](location-id://24ae01e7-09f6-4e4b-8e90-e6d1a89dd76c) near [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).

locationsMap.name: Mount Seir near Kirjath-jearim
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) boundary mountain west of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: This Mount Seir was a landmark on [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s northern boundary between [Chesalon](location-id://b8e05fb9-94f7-44dd-baa5-a9ab9e9864b7) and [Mount Jearim](location-id://574a2caf-9d69-4b4a-99f4-7c5464e636db), distinct from the Edomite [Mount Seir](location-id://4c6a65f7-43e9-4112-90d9-7f95bc44bfa4) south of the Dead Sea.

locationsMap.name: Mount Seir
locationsMap.title: Edomite mountain region south of the Dead Sea
locationsMap.description: Mount Seir was the mountainous country of [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064), associated with [Esau](name-id://c4d0e1b7-7cba-49cb-80b6-e5068cfb4e2f)'s descendants and later judged in prophetic oracles against Edom.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Edomite highlands south of the Dead Sea in southern Jordan

locationsMap.name: Mount Zalmon
locationsMap.title: wooded height near [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) used by [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c)
locationsMap.description: Mount Zalmon was the wooded height from which [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c) and his men cut branches before burning the stronghold at [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201).

locationsMap.name: Mozah
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite town west of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: Mozah was a town in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s allotment, commonly connected with the Motza area west of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Motza / Tel Moza west of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Myra
locationsMap.title: Lycian port city on [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s voyage to [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b)
locationsMap.description: Myra was a city of [Lycia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000135) where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and the prisoners transferred to an Alexandrian ship sailing toward [Italy](location-id://b8999732-9bb7-4d6d-a83d-61934553aa36).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Myra near Demre, Antalya Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Mount of the Amalekites
locationsMap.title: hill country in [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) where the judge [Abdon](name-id://349c4856-c588-4d4f-8484-3d4e50ecaf95) was buried
locationsMap.description: The mount of the Amalekites was a district in the hill country of [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) where [Pirathon](location-id://2356e7e2-6d99-4736-9421-7dfdf88a085d) lay; the judge [Abdon](name-id://349c4856-c588-4d4f-8484-3d4e50ecaf95) son of [Hillel](name-id://8c441bfc-5a84-4c70-b4b7-aef4a59aec93) the Pirathonite was buried there.

locationsMap.name: Manasseh
locationsMap.title: double tribal territory of [Joseph](name-id://207b40a3-2f5b-44bb-b90a-334cc21398b3)’s firstborn on both sides of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987)
locationsMap.description: Manasseh was the territory of the descendants of [Joseph](name-id://207b40a3-2f5b-44bb-b90a-334cc21398b3)’s firstborn son [Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe), alone among the tribes in holding land on both banks of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987). The half tribe eastward took [Bashan](location-id://af0d12bf-aa1c-494c-9f89-8288fd65ef3d) and northern [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089) as far as Baalhermon, with [Golan](location-id://f9cf8545-372a-4cfc-ac9a-e4eaf8a8fb94) among its cities of refuge, while the half tribe westward held the hills about [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) together with [Megiddo](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000148) and [Bethshean](location-id://c6ddfad2-cdfa-4992-9bb8-479e7c6bc9ca) on the plain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: the northern West Bank hills together with the Golan and northern Gilead

locationsMap.name: Naarath
locationsMap.title: [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) boundary town near [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116) also called Naarah or [Naaran](location-id://913d2291-4a9b-40a7-89b3-9fdcef6b4d68)
locationsMap.description: Naarath was a boundary town of [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) near [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116) and the Jordan, appearing with related spellings Naarah and [Naaran](location-id://913d2291-4a9b-40a7-89b3-9fdcef6b4d68) in biblical place lists; its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Nahor
locationsMap.title: city of Nahor in [Mesopotamia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000151) reached by [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412)'s servant
locationsMap.description: Nahor as a place is the city of Nahor in [Mesopotamia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000151) where [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412)'s servant sought a wife for [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf); it is associated with the patriarchal Aramean region around [Haran](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000097), though the exact city site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Nazareth
locationsMap.title: Galilean hometown of [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab)
locationsMap.description: Nazareth was the Galilean town where [Mary](name-id://9fb34696-f2e0-4225-8b10-66ceaf2f44ed) lived, where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) was brought up, and the place-name behind the title Jesus of Nazareth throughout the Gospels and [Acts](book-key://ACT).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Nazareth, Israel

locationsMap.name: Nineveh
locationsMap.title: great Assyrian city addressed by [Jonah](name-id://ca68bc73-d617-4010-8c81-4cfff8cc650c) and [Nahum](name-id://8f274d13-9eda-4edd-91f9-96553eee4ae5)
locationsMap.description: Nineveh was the great Assyrian city associated with [Nimrod](name-id://80b191de-d8ed-486d-bbb5-bd36756496ac)'s early cities, [Sennacherib](name-id://ba936e10-4238-4f16-bed8-eb31811cc5e5)'s return, [Jonah](name-id://ca68bc73-d617-4010-8c81-4cfff8cc650c)'s preaching, [Nahum](name-id://8f274d13-9eda-4edd-91f9-96553eee4ae5)'s oracle, and [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab)' references to the men of Nineveh.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Nineveh mounds opposite Mosul, Iraq

locationsMap.name: Nod
locationsMap.title: land east of Eden where [Cain](name-id://c50356a4-bbd0-44c3-a6f8-185814b5ff97) dwelt
locationsMap.description: Nod was the land east of Eden where [Cain](name-id://c50356a4-bbd0-44c3-a6f8-185814b5ff97) lived after being driven from the presence of the LORD; no secure geographic identification is possible.

locationsMap.name: Naamah
locationsMap.title: lowland town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed near [Makkedah](location-id://8cb8880f-e283-419f-97ff-4ab8c6439bf0)
locationsMap.description: Naamah was a town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s Shephelah listed with [Gederoth](location-id://256b200f-89b4-4dd9-9640-79d3cb479554), [Beth-dagon](location-id://19d5c495-aed6-4b8f-b4b5-6fc05fcb5f5d), and [Makkedah](location-id://8cb8880f-e283-419f-97ff-4ab8c6439bf0); its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Naaran
locationsMap.title: eastern Ephraimite town related to [Naarath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000164)
locationsMap.description: Naaran appears in Chronicles among Ephraimite possessions eastward from [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032), probably the same place or a related spelling of [Naarath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000164); the site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Nahalal
locationsMap.title: [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) town assigned to the Merarite Levites
locationsMap.description: Nahalal, spelled Nahallal in the KJV at [Joshua 19:15](verse-key://JOS 19:15), was a town in [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c)'s inheritance later assigned to the Merarite Levites; it is probably the same place as [Nahalol](location-id://5a7691d7-7ae1-4f0d-b843-7ef411fd48bf) in [Judges](book-key://JDG), though the precise site remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Ma'lul near Nahalal, Israel

locationsMap.name: Nahaliel
locationsMap.title: wilderness station between [Mattanah](location-id://9e2f60d4-f409-4c90-941d-7d9953a47410) and [Bamoth](location-id://e40be882-693e-43c4-a8f8-7d39f0a63b8e)
locationsMap.description: Nahaliel was an Israelite wilderness station named between [Mattanah](location-id://9e2f60d4-f409-4c90-941d-7d9953a47410) and [Bamoth](location-id://e40be882-693e-43c4-a8f8-7d39f0a63b8e) in the itinerary through the Transjordan; its exact location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Nahalol
locationsMap.title: Canaanite-held [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) town, variant of [Nahalal](location-id://30f8cfe2-50f6-4391-8067-79bf119e122b)
locationsMap.description: Nahalol is the Judges spelling of [Nahalal](location-id://30f8cfe2-50f6-4391-8067-79bf119e122b), a [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) town whose Canaanite inhabitants were not driven out but became tributaries.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Ma'lul near Nahalal, Israel

locationsMap.name: Nain
locationsMap.title: Galilean village where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) raised a widow's son
locationsMap.description: Nain was the village where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) met a funeral procession and raised the widow's son, near the [Jezreel](location-id://01fb54a8-39da-4de4-9ba9-6c91d7efff5b) Valley and [Mount Tabor](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000160) area.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Nein, Israel

locationsMap.name: Naioth
locationsMap.title: prophetic dwellings at [Ramah](location-id://87bccdaa-b5c2-455b-8672-eec8740c0007) where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) fled to [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812)
locationsMap.description: Naioth in [Ramah](location-id://87bccdaa-b5c2-455b-8672-eec8740c0007) was the place where [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812) and the company of prophets stayed and where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) fled from [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb); the exact location within or near Ramah is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Neah
locationsMap.title: [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) border town between [Hannathon](location-id://a161cb9f-45ce-4517-b977-63acf6b0e42a) and Jiphthah El
locationsMap.description: Neah was a boundary point in [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c)'s inheritance, named after [Hannathon](location-id://a161cb9f-45ce-4517-b977-63acf6b0e42a) and before the valley of Jiphthah-el; its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Neapolis
locationsMap.title: Macedonian port where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) landed before [Philippi](location-id://b9e3c9b4-d890-4ba6-b440-1d71b3ff8143)
locationsMap.description: Neapolis was the port in [Macedonia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000139) where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and his companions landed after sailing from [Troas](location-id://a8c09279-58fd-483a-89e8-3af948752c58) and Samothracia before traveling inland to [Philippi](location-id://b9e3c9b4-d890-4ba6-b440-1d71b3ff8143).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Kavala, Greece

locationsMap.name: Neballat
locationsMap.title: postexilic Benjaminite town near [Lod](location-id://3489d177-3d3f-42b0-91da-f3ce024c9316) and [Ono](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000172)
locationsMap.description: Neballat was one of the towns inhabited by people of [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) after the exile, listed with [Hadid](location-id://a07fe9de-9b82-4d64-b173-cfcbd396b3f3), [Zeboim](location-id://1eb9376e-c266-4c4c-aa0a-e162ffd566db), Neballat, [Lod](location-id://3489d177-3d3f-42b0-91da-f3ce024c9316), and [Ono](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000172); it is commonly connected with Beit Nabala but the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Beit Nabala near Lod

locationsMap.name: Nebo
locationsMap.title: Moabite town rebuilt by [Reuben](name-id://93b5d553-bee9-4897-a61d-2a5878e1c10b) and named in [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) oracles
locationsMap.description: Nebo was a Transjordan town named with [Dibon](location-id://66711495-33a2-4df0-89e5-ad3a2c12c9f0) and [Baal-meon](location-id://80dc92af-b077-4672-a9eb-a7fb7620ad83), rebuilt by [Reuben](name-id://93b5d553-bee9-4897-a61d-2a5878e1c10b), associated with the Gadite/Reubenite territory, and later included in prophetic oracles against [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153); it is distinct from [Mount Nebo](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000157) and from a postexilic Judean Nebo.

locationsMap.name: Neiel
locationsMap.title: [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797) boundary town near [Bethemek](location-id://cbe1beb9-bb3e-422b-8645-bc5f3570b991) and [Cabul](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000041)
locationsMap.description: Neiel was a boundary point in [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797)'s inheritance, named near [Beth-emek](location-id://cbe1beb9-bb3e-422b-8645-bc5f3570b991), [Cabul](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000041), and the valley of Jiphthah-el; its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Nephtoah
locationsMap.title: spring or waters on the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) boundary
locationsMap.description: Nephtoah, the waters of Nephtoah, was a boundary landmark between [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) west of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117); it is commonly identified with the spring at Lifta, though the exact boundary point remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often identified with Lifta spring northwest of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Netophah
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) village associated with [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s warriors and returnees
locationsMap.description: Netophah was a village or district in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) associated with Netophathite warriors in [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s lists and with returnees from exile; it is usually placed near [Bethlehem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000034), but its exact site is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually placed near Bethlehem, possibly at Khirbet Bedd Faluh or nearby sites

locationsMap.name: New Gate
locationsMap.title: new gate of the LORD's house in [Jeremiah](book-key://JER)
locationsMap.description: The New Gate was a gate of the temple complex in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) where officials sat to hear [Jeremiah](name-id://3a62ca29-870f-4a9b-844b-887f828a0cd5) and where [Baruch](name-id://64346d13-d414-4493-9706-1417f5dfbcd7) later read Jeremiah's words from the chamber of [Gemariah](name-id://c681dad7-acde-43c9-9bb4-97d483693877).

locationsMap.name: Nezib
locationsMap.title: lowland town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed near [Keilah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000125) and [Mareshah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000146)
locationsMap.description: Nezib was a town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s Shephelah listed with [Keilah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000125), [Achzib](location-id://e5e9c33d-ae22-45e9-ba4b-06feba9c92ad), and [Mareshah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000146); it is often associated with Khirbet Beit Nesib, but the identification is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Khirbet Beit Nesib in the Judean Shephelah

locationsMap.name: Nibshan
locationsMap.title: wilderness town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) near the [Salt Sea](location-id://2882f5a5-375a-40b9-9142-55341e8b6a91)
locationsMap.description: Nibshan was a town in the wilderness district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), listed with the [City of Salt](location-id://f4b61774-6a7a-4b44-a58e-d4bf2986a8c9) and [Engedi](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000070); its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Nicopolis
locationsMap.title: city where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) planned to winter with [Titus](name-id://edebc9dd-3078-4022-b294-4ecd27682d47)
locationsMap.description: Nicopolis was the city where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) planned to winter when writing to [Titus](name-id://edebc9dd-3078-4022-b294-4ecd27682d47); it is commonly identified with Nicopolis in Epirus near Actium, though the letter does not specify which city of that name.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Nicopolis near Preveza, Greece

locationsMap.name: Nimrah
locationsMap.title: short form of [Bethnimrah](location-id://c9a05df3-f5c7-46c0-b70d-13287c2526c8) among Gadite pasture towns
locationsMap.description: Nimrah is the short form of [Beth-nimrah](location-id://c9a05df3-f5c7-46c0-b70d-13287c2526c8), a Gadite town east of the Jordan named among the pasture lands desired by [Reuben](name-id://93b5d553-bee9-4897-a61d-2a5878e1c10b) and [Gad](name-id://b68edd6a-6aea-4f9f-8c99-684d9a6f7a8b).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell Nimrin in Jordan east of the lower Jordan Valley

locationsMap.name: Nimrim
locationsMap.title: waters of Nimrim in [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)'s lament
locationsMap.description: Nimrim refers to waters in [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) that would become desolate in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA) and Jeremiah's laments; it is often associated with Wadi Numeira near the Dead Sea, but the identification is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Wadi Numeira near the southeastern Dead Sea

locationsMap.name: Nimrod
locationsMap.title: land of Nimrod in Micah's Assyrian-Babylonian geography
locationsMap.description: Nimrod is geographic in Micah's phrase the land of Nimrod, a poetic designation for [Assyria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000023) or [Mesopotamia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000151) connected with the early cities attributed to Nimrod.

locationsMap.name: Nob
locationsMap.title: priestly town near [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) destroyed by [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)
locationsMap.description: Nob was the priestly town where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) received bread and [Goliath](name-id://69bffebc-acde-4cc2-83a4-cc0533c60424)'s sword from [Ahimelech](name-id://0a84e4bc-9994-4680-84da-0204caa1a95e), later slaughtered by [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb), and also appears as a Benjaminite settlement and a point in Isaiah's march toward [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117); its exact site is disputed.

locationsMap.name: Nobah
locationsMap.title: Transjordan city Nobah renamed after capturing [Kenath](location-id://c4f8f604-2ce5-4dc2-8e4a-3db40a6bc765)
locationsMap.description: Nobah was the name given to [Kenath](location-id://c4f8f604-2ce5-4dc2-8e4a-3db40a6bc765) and its villages after Nobah captured it, and it later marks the region east of [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s pursuit route near [Jogbehah](location-id://b0810c1c-6510-49d4-831a-ce80d3e078a6); it is often connected with Qanawat, ancient Canatha, but the identification is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Qanawat, ancient Canatha, in southern Syria

locationsMap.name: Nophah
locationsMap.title: uncertain Amorite or Moabite place near [Medeba](location-id://2ffdbbae-7dcd-4a7d-9f89-da12f9e8295f)
locationsMap.description: Nophah appears in the taunt over [Heshbon](location-id://fcdae541-01d2-47f8-a663-45a2f056a250)'s downfall as the destruction reached from [Dibon](location-id://66711495-33a2-4df0-89e5-ad3a2c12c9f0) to Nophah and [Medeba](location-id://2ffdbbae-7dcd-4a7d-9f89-da12f9e8295f); the exact place is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Northern Mount Hor
locationsMap.title: uncertain northern boundary mountain near [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62)
locationsMap.description: Northern Mount Hor is the mountain named in [Numbers](book-key://NUM) as the northern border point from the [great sea](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000093) toward the entrance of [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62), distinct from [Aaron](name-id://03e737be-a164-4fe2-bd83-b19b217959dc)'s death site near [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064).

locationsMap.name: Naphtali
locationsMap.title: northernmost tribal territory west of the [Sea of Chinnereth](location-id://30d68225-3355-4ec2-9d41-8ba27a817d53)
locationsMap.description: Naphtali was the tribal territory allotted to the descendants of [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9)’s son [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) as the sixth lot, running north from the [Sea of Chinnereth](location-id://30d68225-3355-4ec2-9d41-8ba27a817d53) through the uplands that held [Kedesh](location-id://1f447b5c-761c-4a77-bd5c-309916278396) and [Hazor](location-id://913fe6c4-c9d7-41b6-b74a-da1b7354f163). [Deborah](name-id://3fec4843-1e2e-4781-a8e7-f7aa0d955f5e) called [Barak](name-id://e0bf01a1-7132-4645-8497-385aa029c28d) out of Kedeshnaphtali, and the land was among the first that [Benhadad](name-id://042b2016-9f44-4949-87b9-822f8ef6f55a) carried away when he smote the cities of the north.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: the eastern Galilee highlands north and west of the Sea of Galilee

locationsMap.name: Ono
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite town near [Lod](location-id://3489d177-3d3f-42b0-91da-f3ce024c9316) in the plain of Ono
locationsMap.description: Ono was a Benjaminite town built with [Lod](location-id://3489d177-3d3f-42b0-91da-f3ce024c9316), resettled after the exile, and named in [Nehemiah](book-key://NEH) as the plain where [Sanballat](name-id://c8743460-dc70-4ce7-885b-5e9a3555e1b6) and Geshem tried to lure [Nehemiah](name-id://46c4c07f-dde8-4466-a278-6e40a8d3e7f1) away from [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Kafr 'Ana / Kiryat Ono area near Lod in Israel

locationsMap.name: Ophir
locationsMap.title: gold-producing port or region reached by [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s fleet
locationsMap.description: Ophir was the distant port or region famous for gold, precious stones, and algum wood brought by [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s and [Hiram](name-id://26687f64-c119-4c2a-a165-293c934a08f1)'s ships; proposed identifications range across [Arabia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014), Africa, India, and Southeast Asia, so no single location is secure.

locationsMap.name: Oboth
locationsMap.title: wilderness encampment near the border of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)
locationsMap.description: Oboth was a desert camp in Israel's journey list after [Punon](location-id://b6fb6c58-a2f1-4844-bdac-b536a8a37044) and before Ije-abarim, close to the wilderness east of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153); its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Olivet
locationsMap.title: KJV name for the [Mount of Olives](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000158) east of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: Olivet is the KJV name for the [Mount of Olives](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000158) in [Luke](book-key://LUK) and [Acts](book-key://ACT), the ridge near [Bethany](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000031) and [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) taught, lodged, and from which the disciples returned after the ascension.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount of Olives in Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: On
locationsMap.title: Egyptian city of On later known as Heliopolis
locationsMap.description: On was the Egyptian city whose priestly family is connected with [Joseph](name-id://207b40a3-2f5b-44bb-b90a-334cc21398b3)'s wife [Asenath](name-id://5b1e12b5-a8fa-4b9c-9c81-c7be948fea8f); it is the lower-Egyptian city later known as Heliopolis, and Ezekiel's Aven is commonly identified with the same place.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Ancient Heliopolis at Ain Shams in Cairo, Egypt

locationsMap.name: Ophel
locationsMap.title: fortified hill or quarter on [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s eastern ridge
locationsMap.description: Ophel was the fortified hill or raised quarter of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) south of the temple area, strengthened by [Jotham](name-id://1e806dc7-5286-4eb8-a698-8e11bc343b1b) and [Manasseh](name-id://cb3e0962-0140-4360-8730-0cc3c09a21da) and inhabited by the Nethinim in [Nehemiah](book-key://NEH); the exact limits of the area remain debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Ophel / City of David area south of the Temple Mount in Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Ophni
locationsMap.title: town in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s allotment
locationsMap.description: Ophni was a town in the allotment of [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef), listed with [Chephar-ammoni](location-id://b9fd3221-af2a-4d7f-b70a-aae9470fb516) and [Geba](location-id://b070825c-868d-4992-a20c-b187b9380c70); Jifna northwest of [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) has been proposed, but the identification is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly Jifna northwest of Bethel

locationsMap.name: Ophrah of Benjamin
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite town near [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) and the land of [Shual](location-id://9e8bbf1c-fd5f-4b20-bd4f-04b8c6d41b92)
locationsMap.description: Ophrah of Benjamin was a town in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s allotment and the destination of one Philistine raiding company from [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd); it is often connected with Ephron near [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) and possibly et-Taiyibeh.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly et-Taiyibeh northeast of Bethel

locationsMap.name: Ophrah of the Abiezrites
locationsMap.title: Manassite town of [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455) and [Joash](name-id://d309a5e8-c8f5-423b-929a-3e30dd8c64bf) the Abiezrite
locationsMap.description: Ophrah of the Abiezrites was [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s home in the territory of [Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe), where the angel appeared, Gideon built an altar, placed the ephod, was buried, and where [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c) killed Gideon's sons; its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Paran
locationsMap.title: wilderness region of Paran
locationsMap.description: Paran is the wilderness region where [Ishmael](name-id://056fd84a-3a55-4428-aef2-584809d7d7b1) lived and where Israel camped after leaving [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210); KJV references also place [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) and [Hadad](name-id://0d4b21d5-bf49-42aa-9dbf-f5ce42f7f6c4)'s route through Paran, but its exact extent is debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly associated with the southern Sinai around Wadi Feiran, with broader identifications extending toward northwestern Arabia

locationsMap.name: Parthia
locationsMap.title: historical region of Parthia in northeastern Iran
locationsMap.description: Parthia was a historical region of northeastern Greater Iran; Jews or proselytes from Parthia are listed among the Pentecost hearers in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) in [Acts 2](chapter-key://ACT 2).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Northeastern Iran and adjoining southern Turkmenistan, the historic Parthian region

locationsMap.name: Penuel
locationsMap.title: Transjordan site fortified by [Jeroboam](name-id://44442ff1-d137-4b0c-b117-4ccacc9df7f1)
