locationsMap.description: Penuel, also spelled Peniel, was east of [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) near the [Jabbok](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000111); [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) passed the place after wrestling at Peniel, [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455) punished the town, and [Jeroboam](name-id://44442ff1-d137-4b0c-b117-4ccacc9df7f1) later fortified it.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually proposed at Tell edh-Dhahab el-Sharqi in the Tulul adh-Dhahab complex on the Zarqa/Jabbok in Jordan

locationsMap.name: Perga
locationsMap.title: New Testament city of Perga in [Pamphylia](location-id://9647773e-8975-42cf-bb5a-703b4fa0e050)
locationsMap.description: Perga, or Perge, was an ancient city in [Pamphylia](location-id://9647773e-8975-42cf-bb5a-703b4fa0e050) where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13) arrived from [Cyprus](location-id://cddb5c4a-d659-447d-b7bd-cd2aee99dde2) and where Paul later preached on his return journey.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Perge archaeological site at Aksu, Antalya Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Persia
locationsMap.title: Persian imperial realm east of [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70)
locationsMap.description: Persia in the KJV usually denotes the Achaemenid Persian Empire, the eastern power that ruled [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70) and authorized the Jewish return and rebuilding after the exile.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Persian imperial heartland in Iran, especially Fars, and by extension the Achaemenid Empire

locationsMap.name: Philistia
locationsMap.title: coastal territory of the Philistines
locationsMap.description: Philistia was the southern coastal territory of the Philistine city-states, including [Gaza](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000084), [Ashkelon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000021), [Ashdod](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000020), [Ekron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000066), and [Gath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000082), repeatedly named in the KJV prophets and [Psalms](book-key://PSA).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The southern Levantine coastal plain around Gaza, Ashkelon, Ashdod, Ekron, and Gath

locationsMap.name: Phrygia
locationsMap.title: Roman-era region of west-central Anatolia
locationsMap.description: Phrygia was the west-central Anatolian region represented at Pentecost and crossed by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) during his missionary travel in [Acts](book-key://ACT).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: West-central Anatolia in modern Turkey, centered broadly around the ancient Phrygian highlands

locationsMap.name: Phut
locationsMap.title: KJV form of [Put](location-id://6e184c74-8d43-4e9f-b017-46eac9121940), a biblical people and region linked with [Libya](location-id://ace3b89b-2f6d-45d2-b334-bb9eac14a872)
locationsMap.description: Phut is the KJV form of [Put](location-id://6e184c74-8d43-4e9f-b017-46eac9121940) in the Table of Nations and [Ezekiel 27:10](verse-key://EZK 27:10); biblical and classical associations link Put/Phut with a North African people or region, most commonly Ancient [Libya](location-id://ace3b89b-2f6d-45d2-b334-bb9eac14a872), though some scholars connect it with Punt.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly associated with Ancient Libya or northwestern Africa; an alternate proposal identifies it with Punt

locationsMap.name: Pithom
locationsMap.title: Egyptian treasure city built by the Israelites
locationsMap.description: Pithom was one of Pharaoh's treasure cities in [Exodus 1:11](verse-key://EXO 1:11), often identified with Tell el-Maskhuta in the Wadi Tumilat, though Tell el-Retaba and other sites have also been proposed.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly identified with Tell el-Maskhuta in Egypt's Wadi Tumilat, though Tell el-Retaba is also proposed

locationsMap.name: Plain of Moreh
locationsMap.title: oak or plain near [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) where [Abram](name-id://bf42c58c-045a-4131-b8ee-55e7c707040a) first camped in [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)
locationsMap.description: The plain or oak of Moreh was near [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201), where [Abram](name-id://bf42c58c-045a-4131-b8ee-55e7c707040a) first came in [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) and where [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) later described the covenant mountains across from [Gilgal](location-id://5d536a42-83f6-4caf-8fb3-c11de63ca7de).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Near Shechem / Nablus in the central hill country

locationsMap.name: Plain of Tabor
locationsMap.title: place on [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)'s route after [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812) anointed him
locationsMap.description: Plain of Tabor is the KJV phrase in [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812)'s sign to [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb), where he would meet three men going up to God at [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) after passing [Rachel](name-id://84d78b89-880b-4333-a822-9c8449f77fd0)'s sepulchre. Many translations understand the phrase as the oak of Tabor, and the exact location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Patmos
locationsMap.title: Aegean island where [John](name-id://77f3c64d-52b7-4c86-ae7b-1fffa2079398) received [Revelation](book-key://REV)
locationsMap.description: Patmos is the Aegean island where [John](name-id://77f3c64d-52b7-4c86-ae7b-1fffa2079398) says he was exiled for the word of God and the testimony of [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) Christ in [Revelation 1:9](verse-key://REV 1:9).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Patmos in the Dodecanese, Greece

locationsMap.name: Pai
locationsMap.title: Chronicles form of [Pau](location-id://fac7bfea-1d84-45c0-8cf2-47b30ba00cde), city of an Edomite king
locationsMap.description: Pai is the place named in [1 Chronicles 1:50](verse-key://1CH 1:50) as the city of Hadad or [Hadar](name-id://ee1ab2e9-56d0-4175-b8be-144651eef0bb), one of the kings of [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064); it corresponds to [Pau](location-id://fac7bfea-1d84-45c0-8cf2-47b30ba00cde) in the [Genesis](book-key://GEN) king list, but its exact site is not known.

locationsMap.name: Pamphylia
locationsMap.title: Roman region on the southern coast of Asia Minor
locationsMap.description: Pamphylia was a coastal region in southern Asia Minor represented at Pentecost and crossed by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and his companions during missionary travel in [Acts](book-key://ACT).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Pamphylian coast of southern Turkey, broadly around modern Antalya Province

locationsMap.name: Paphos
locationsMap.title: Cypriot city visited by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13)
locationsMap.description: Paphos was the western Cypriot city where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13) met the deputy Sergius Paulus and [Elymas](name-id://065cd5ac-6ccd-41c3-b252-c75231a807c8) during the first missionary journey.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Paphos, Cyprus

locationsMap.name: Pasdammim
locationsMap.title: battlefield site near Shochoh and [Azekah](location-id://f345fc22-3282-4ad7-9817-3e2b38026e41)
locationsMap.description: Pasdammim, also called [Ephesdammim](location-id://0d029480-fd5b-4910-80e5-02c9577d307c) in the parallel Samuel account, was the place where Philistines were gathered near Shochoh and [Azekah](location-id://f345fc22-3282-4ad7-9817-3e2b38026e41) when [Eleazar](name-id://f3fa5d72-22aa-4d1d-b01a-9a2a5075b116) stood with [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) in a barley field.

locationsMap.name: Patara
locationsMap.title: Lycian port where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) changed ships
locationsMap.description: Patara was a harbor city of [Lycia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000135) where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and his companions found a ship sailing to Phenicia during the journey to [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) in [Acts 21](chapter-key://ACT 21).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Patara near Gelemis in Antalya Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Pathros
locationsMap.title: biblical region of Upper [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065)
locationsMap.description: Pathros was the region of Upper [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065) named by the prophets as part of Egypt and as a place where Judeans lived after the fall of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Upper Egypt, especially the Thebaid in southern Egypt

locationsMap.name: Pau
locationsMap.title: [Genesis](book-key://GEN) form of [Pai](location-id://2f63273d-655c-4491-9d1e-c24ed03f0e03), city of Edomite king [Hadar](name-id://ee1ab2e9-56d0-4175-b8be-144651eef0bb)
locationsMap.description: Pau is the [Genesis 36:39](verse-key://GEN 36:39) form of the city of [Hadar](name-id://ee1ab2e9-56d0-4175-b8be-144651eef0bb), a king of [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064); Chronicles gives the form [Pai](location-id://2f63273d-655c-4491-9d1e-c24ed03f0e03), and the exact site is not known.

locationsMap.name: Pekod
locationsMap.title: KJV form of the Puqudu region in Babylonia
locationsMap.description: Pekod is the KJV form of Puqudu, an Aramean or Chaldean tribal region in Babylonia named in Jeremiah's oracle against [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70) and Ezekiel's judgment speech against [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Southern or eastern Babylonia near Uruk and the lower Tigris, in modern Iraq

locationsMap.name: Peniel
locationsMap.title: [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9)'s name for Penuel by the [Jabbok](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000111)
locationsMap.description: Peniel is the name [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) gave the place where he wrestled through the night and said he had seen God face to face; the same site is elsewhere called Penuel.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually proposed at Tell edh-Dhahab el-Sharqi in the Tulul adh-Dhahab complex on the Zarqa/Jabbok in Jordan

locationsMap.name: Peor
locationsMap.title: Moabite height associated with [Baalpeor](location-id://ed08e529-bb95-4f61-b75e-5915911773ca)
locationsMap.description: Peor was a height or locality in [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) where [Balak](name-id://0cd1bb26-6e42-4461-ba13-77438e916c1f) brought [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c) to look toward Israel and where Israel's sin with [Baalpeor](location-id://ed08e529-bb95-4f61-b75e-5915911773ca) became a lasting biblical warning.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually placed in the Mount Nebo/Pisgah area east of the Jordan, though the exact point is uncertain

locationsMap.name: Perezuzzah
locationsMap.title: place named after [Uzzah](name-id://bcf1ecbf-fde2-441f-9b88-70b50e59de5e)'s death beside the ark
locationsMap.description: Perezuzzah was the name [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) gave the place where [Uzzah](name-id://bcf1ecbf-fde2-441f-9b88-70b50e59de5e) died after touching the ark of God during its transport from [Kirjath Jearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32) toward [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117); the exact location is not identified.

locationsMap.name: Perezuzza
locationsMap.title: Chronicles form of Perezuzzah
locationsMap.description: Perezuzza is the Chronicles spelling of the place where [Uzza](name-id://bcf1ecbf-fde2-441f-9b88-70b50e59de5e) died after touching the ark during [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s attempt to bring it from [Kirjath Jearim](location-id://c17c2d42-2618-4ff7-844d-247f21c0da32); the exact location is not identified.

locationsMap.name: Pethor
locationsMap.title: [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c)'s home city by the [Euphrates](location-id://0bdad9de-f6dc-4681-8a5a-54526382bc9f)
locationsMap.description: Pethor was [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c)'s home, described as being by the river in [Mesopotamia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000151); it is often identified with Pitru near the [Euphrates](location-id://0bdad9de-f6dc-4681-8a5a-54526382bc9f), but that identification remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often proposed at or near Pitru on the Sajur/Euphrates frontier in northern Syria or southeastern Turkey

locationsMap.name: Pharpar
locationsMap.title: river of [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) named by [Naaman](name-id://c1b2d0b5-e363-488d-a119-fcf0c74f3cfb)
locationsMap.description: Pharpar was one of the rivers of [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) that [Naaman](name-id://c1b2d0b5-e363-488d-a119-fcf0c74f3cfb) compared favorably with the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) before obeying [Elisha](name-id://6e9af9e4-8635-4289-826f-bf6d37611683)'s command to wash in Jordan.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually identified with the Nahr al-Awaj south of Damascus, Syria

locationsMap.name: Philadelphia
locationsMap.title: Lydian city addressed in [Revelation](book-key://REV)
locationsMap.description: Philadelphia was one of the seven churches of [Asia](location-id://5e94bf0f-3192-4e8f-96d0-8d7a6743a038) addressed in [Revelation](book-key://REV), an ancient Lydian city in western Asia Minor.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Alasehir in Manisa Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Philippi
locationsMap.title: Macedonian colony visited by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)
locationsMap.description: Philippi was a chief city or Roman colony of [Macedonia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000139) where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) preached, [Lydia](name-id://8a845768-70bf-4f96-9053-f13e635f3394) believed, and the Philippian jailer was converted; Paul later wrote to the church there.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The archaeological site of Philippi near Krinides, Greece

locationsMap.name: Pibeseth
locationsMap.title: Egyptian city of Bubastis in [Ezekiel](book-key://EZK)
locationsMap.description: Pibeseth was the Egyptian city of Bubastis named in Ezekiel's oracle against [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065), where the young men would fall by the sword.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell Basta at Zagazig in the eastern Nile Delta, Egypt

locationsMap.name: Pihahiroth
locationsMap.title: Exodus encampment before the sea crossing
locationsMap.description: Pihahiroth was the Exodus station where Israel encamped before the sea, between [Migdol](location-id://43907203-51a2-4b05-9d38-066b040b0084) and the sea and over against [Baalzephon](location-id://64c93283-c533-41dc-9963-84e43e0388a3); its exact location on [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065)'s eastern frontier is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Pirathon
locationsMap.title: home town of [Abdon](name-id://349c4856-c588-4d4f-8484-3d4e50ecaf95) and [Benaiah](name-id://91de54b2-96b2-4c6d-b7f7-a5527791dec4)
locationsMap.description: Pirathon was the Ephraimite town where the judge [Abdon](name-id://349c4856-c588-4d4f-8484-3d4e50ecaf95) was buried and from which [Benaiah](name-id://91de54b2-96b2-4c6d-b7f7-a5527791dec4), one of [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s mighty men, came; it is commonly but not certainly identified with modern Fara'ata west of [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Commonly proposed at Fara'ata in the West Bank, west-southwest of Shechem

locationsMap.name: Pisgah
locationsMap.title: summit ridge near [Nebo](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000157) overlooking [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)
locationsMap.description: Pisgah was the summit or ridge associated with [Mount Nebo](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000157) east of [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987), from which [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) viewed the promised land and where [Balak](name-id://0cd1bb26-6e42-4461-ba13-77438e916c1f) brought [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c) to view Israel.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jabal Siyagha and the Mount Nebo summit area in western Jordan

locationsMap.name: Pisidia
locationsMap.title: mountainous Anatolian region crossed by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)
locationsMap.description: Pisidia was an ancient region north of [Pamphylia](location-id://9647773e-8975-42cf-bb5a-703b4fa0e050) in Asia Minor; [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) visited [Antioch in Pisidia](location-id://a6f6c0ad-5e32-44fe-8fa5-d2c0b8e9c8d1) and later passed through Pisidia to Pamphylia.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Southwestern Anatolia in modern Turkey, broadly in the Taurus region around Antalya and Isparta

locationsMap.name: Place of a Skull
locationsMap.title: [Golgotha](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000090) or Calvary, the crucifixion site
locationsMap.description: Place of a Skull is the Gospel description of [Golgotha](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000090), called Calvary in [Luke](book-key://LUK), the site outside [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) was crucified; the traditional location is in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, though alternatives have been proposed.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally the Calvary chapel area in the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Plain
locationsMap.title: plain of the valley of [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116) seen from [Pisgah](location-id://2f1847ff-51c6-41d4-a74b-a9a1075e7cb0)
locationsMap.description: Plain in [Deuteronomy 34:3](verse-key://DEU 34:3) refers to the plain of the valley of [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116), the city of palm trees, viewed from [Pisgah](location-id://2f1847ff-51c6-41d4-a74b-a9a1075e7cb0) as far as [Zoar](location-id://5d01ba7a-9112-460b-aea8-d80ada45bdc0); it belongs to the broader [Arabah](location-id://bfd23a68-b7bd-4bd0-99fe-d1d16a0b2a71) or [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) Rift setting.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The lower Jordan Valley around Jericho and the northern Dead Sea

locationsMap.name: Pontus
locationsMap.title: Black Sea region of Asia Minor
locationsMap.description: Pontus was a region on the southern coast of the Black Sea in Asia Minor; people from Pontus were present at Pentecost, [Aquila](name-id://f158d69a-9f7b-452c-851e-fdb5680cf09b) was from Pontus, and [Peter](name-id://2bcada1c-b00a-4214-8a2d-5a7b991f6641) addressed believers there.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Pontic region of northern Turkey along the southern Black Sea coast

locationsMap.name: Ptolemais
locationsMap.title: Phoenician port city visited by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)
locationsMap.description: Ptolemais was the Greco-Roman name of Acre, the coastal city where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and his companions greeted the brethren for one day after sailing from [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Acre/Akko in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Pul
locationsMap.title: uncertain far-off nation in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA)
locationsMap.description: Pul is named among the distant nations in [Isaiah 66:19](verse-key://ISA 66:19); the Hebrew place-name may refer to [Put](location-id://6e184c74-8d43-4e9f-b017-46eac9121940) or [Phut](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000185), often associated with ancient [Libya](location-id://ace3b89b-2f6d-45d2-b334-bb9eac14a872), but the identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Punon
locationsMap.title: Exodus station in the [Arabah](location-id://bfd23a68-b7bd-4bd0-99fe-d1d16a0b2a71) copper district
locationsMap.description: Punon was an Israelite station between [Zalmonah](location-id://a59bfd63-ee3e-4499-baba-b7a5a1c02c79) and [Oboth](location-id://271e8026-3568-4da6-b6d3-ccf4b5c0fd74) in [Numbers 33](chapter-key://NUM 33), commonly identified with the Faynan copper-mining district in the [Arabah](location-id://bfd23a68-b7bd-4bd0-99fe-d1d16a0b2a71).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Khirbat Faynan in the Wadi Faynan copper district of southern Jordan

locationsMap.name: Put
locationsMap.title: biblical people and land often associated with [Libya](location-id://ace3b89b-2f6d-45d2-b334-bb9eac14a872)
locationsMap.description: Put, or [Phut](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000185), is used in prophetic texts for a foreign military people or land linked with [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065), [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226), and Gog; many sources associate it with ancient [Libya](location-id://ace3b89b-2f6d-45d2-b334-bb9eac14a872), though Punt has also been proposed.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually associated with ancient Libya or the Libyan region west of Egypt

locationsMap.name: Puteoli
locationsMap.title: Italian port where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) landed before [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b)
locationsMap.description: Puteoli was the Roman port in Campania where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and his companions landed after sailing from [Rhegium](location-id://9ee7d678-b412-4305-8f8a-7acba7c03e8c) and stayed seven days with brethren before going on to [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Pozzuoli near Naples in Campania, Italy

locationsMap.name: Padanaram
locationsMap.title: Mesopotamian plain around [Haran](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000097), homeland of [Rebekah](name-id://d9f63818-b074-4f13-86e7-63f1fcc88b53) and [Laban](name-id://02b09a01-9819-4182-895a-b0dda2395250)
locationsMap.description: Padanaram ("plain of [Aram](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000015)") is the district around [Haran](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000097) in [Mesopotamia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000151) where [Bethuel](name-id://f753a209-2de8-4fd5-93b6-a255a1a84b80), [Laban](name-id://02b09a01-9819-4182-895a-b0dda2395250), and [Rebekah](name-id://d9f63818-b074-4f13-86e7-63f1fcc88b53) lived, and to which [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) fled and returned.

locationsMap.name: Pergamos
locationsMap.title: Asian city addressed among the seven churches of [Revelation](book-key://REV)
locationsMap.description: Pergamos was a city of Roman [Asia](location-id://5e94bf0f-3192-4e8f-96d0-8d7a6743a038) addressed in [Revelation](book-key://REV), described as the place where Satan's seat was, where the Nicolaitanes' doctrine was condemned.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Bergama, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Pison
locationsMap.title: first of the four rivers parting out of [Eden](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000081)
locationsMap.description: Pison is the first of the four heads into which the river that went out of [Eden](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000081) to water the garden was parted, and it compassed the whole land of [Havilah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101), where there is gold, bdellium and the onyx stone ([Genesis 2:11-12](verse-key://GEN 2:11-12)). Unlike Hiddekel and [Euphrates](location-id://0bdad9de-f6dc-4681-8a5a-54526382bc9f) it has never been securely located, and the proposals advanced for it, from the Ganges and the Nile to the Wadi al-Batin channel in Arabia and the Uizhun near the Caspian, have won no scholarly consensus.

locationsMap.name: Ramathlehi
locationsMap.title: [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648)'s jawbone victory site near [Lehi](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000134)
locationsMap.description: Ramathlehi, meaning height of the jawbone, is the place [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648) named after killing Philistines with a donkey's jawbone at [Lehi](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000134). Its exact site is not certain, but it is usually placed in the Shephelah near [Zorah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000244), [Timnath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000223), and the [Sorek](location-id://c1d3e5f7-2b4a-4c6d-8e9f-3a5b7c9d1e2f) valley.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly in Wadi es-Sarar near Zorah and Timnath

locationsMap.name: Rephidim
locationsMap.title: wilderness encampment where Israel lacked water
locationsMap.description: Rephidim was an Israelite wilderness station between the wilderness of Sin and [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210), where water was supplied from the rock and Amalek fought Israel. It is commonly identified with the Wadi Feiran area, though the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often identified with Wadi Feiran in the Sinai Peninsula

locationsMap.name: Raamah
locationsMap.title: South Arabian trading region associated with [Sheba](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000200)
locationsMap.description: Raamah appears in [Ezekiel](book-key://EZK) as a trading partner of [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226) alongside [Sheba](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000200), supplying spices, precious stones, and gold. The biblical name likely refers to a South Arabian people or trading region, but the exact location is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Probably a South Arabian trading region, possibly in or near Yemen

locationsMap.name: Rabbah
locationsMap.title: Ammonite capital later known as Philadelphia and Amman
locationsMap.description: Rabbah was the chief city of the children of [Ammon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010), east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987). It was associated with [Og](name-id://4c740990-dad3-4d94-b039-f55ed02efa7b)'s iron bedstead, besieged and captured in [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s reign, and later named in prophetic judgments against Ammon.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Amman, Jordan

locationsMap.name: Rabbith
locationsMap.title: [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) town probably represented by Raba
locationsMap.description: Rabbith was a town in [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b)'s inheritance, listed between [Daberath](location-id://2ecd736a-4c48-4840-b03c-0f1ccb6482ea) and [Kishion](location-id://175e869e-0d23-44fe-853a-020cdf07a495). It is commonly connected with Raba on the southern part of the Gilboa range, though the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Probably Raba in the southern Gilboa range

locationsMap.name: Racal
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) place receiving [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s spoil
locationsMap.description: Racal, spelled Rachal in the KJV, was one of the places in southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) whose elders received a share of [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s spoil after the Amalekite raid. The Septuagint reading suggests [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029), so the exact site remains uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly Carmel in southern Judah

locationsMap.name: Rakkath
locationsMap.title: fortified city of [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) near [Chinnereth](location-id://d4a473b2-abb9-4856-bebe-fb0294b0e071)
locationsMap.description: Rakkath was a fortified city in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s inheritance, named with [Hammath](location-id://15138706-7da3-4893-8388-42f6a8876504) and [Chinnereth](location-id://d4a473b2-abb9-4856-bebe-fb0294b0e071). Later Jewish tradition associated it with the site of Tiberias on the western shore of the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly Tiberias, Israel

locationsMap.name: Rakkon
locationsMap.title: Danite border town near [Joppa](location-id://dd33c11c-6e8d-484a-8911-bb20e6126e7c)
locationsMap.description: Rakkon was a location in [Dan](name-id://3de74a0e-f0c6-4087-b902-c30a6d218cff)'s allotment, listed with [Mejarkon](location-id://96cd9f64-f29c-458e-aa3e-3d4ca9e10d3e) and the border over against [Joppa](location-id://dd33c11c-6e8d-484a-8911-bb20e6126e7c). Its precise site is not known, though it belonged to the coastal border zone of Dan.

locationsMap.name: Ramah
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite city near [Gibeah](location-id://41084ab0-6cbc-4232-a844-fb8b405d97c3) and [Geba](location-id://b070825c-868d-4992-a20c-b187b9380c70)
locationsMap.description: This Ramah was a city of [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) named in Joshua's allotment and in later narratives involving the road north of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117). It is commonly identified with er-Ram, north of Jerusalem, and is distinct from [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812)'s Ramah, Ramah of Asher, Ramah of Naphtali, and Ramah of the South.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: er-Ram, West Bank

locationsMap.name: Ramathmizpeh
locationsMap.title: Gadite boundary height of the watchtower
locationsMap.description: Ramathmizpeh was a place on [Gad](name-id://b68edd6a-6aea-4f9f-8c99-684d9a6f7a8b)'s boundary between [Heshbon](location-id://fcdae541-01d2-47f8-a663-45a2f056a250) and [Betonim](location-id://dbf214e2-7ef6-499d-b6fc-1d3af05a21be). It may be related to [Mizpah](location-id://88fe0c6e-193b-4471-afa0-7cc4052531db) or [Ramothgilead](location-id://4d0a970b-9d7f-4a11-a269-29c16c3cf242), but its precise site is not certain.

locationsMap.name: Ramathaimzophim
locationsMap.title: [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812)'s Ramah in [Mount Ephraim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000155)
locationsMap.description: Ramathaimzophim was [Elkanah](name-id://0d06d7a8-b1f7-49e8-b687-39160e77f333)'s home in [Mount Ephraim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000155) and is commonly identified with [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812)'s Ramah, where Samuel judged Israel, lived, received [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb), sheltered [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) at [Naioth](location-id://7997f452-30de-42e5-8db6-f958f2c424c3), and was buried. The exact site is disputed among several proposed locations.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly Ramallah or Beit Rima; exact site disputed

locationsMap.name: Rameses
locationsMap.title: Egyptian city or district in the eastern Delta
locationsMap.description: Rameses, also spelled Raamses in [Exodus 1:11](verse-key://EXO 1:11), was the land or city in [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065) associated with Israel's settlement and departure. It is often associated with Pi-Ramesses or the eastern Nile Delta, but the precise biblical site remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Eastern Nile Delta, often associated with Pi-Ramesses or the Tanis region

locationsMap.name: Ramothgilead
locationsMap.title: Gadite city of refuge and fortified [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089) city
locationsMap.description: Ramothgilead was a major city east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) in [Gad](name-id://b68edd6a-6aea-4f9f-8c99-684d9a6f7a8b), assigned as a city of refuge and Levitical city. It later became a contested fortress in Israel's wars with [Syria](location-id://f4fe75e3-4f92-4642-bf57-3d6a59931322), but its exact modern site is disputed.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Uncertain; proposed sites include Tell Ramith, er-Remtheh, and Beit Ras

locationsMap.name: Red Sea
locationsMap.title: sea crossed in the Exodus and bordering [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064)
locationsMap.description: The Red Sea is the biblical sea associated with Israel's Exodus deliverance and later travel and trade routes. In biblical usage it especially concerns the northern Red Sea region and its gulfs near [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065), [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210), and [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Red Sea, especially the Gulf of Suez and Gulf of Aqaba in biblical contexts

locationsMap.name: Rehob
locationsMap.title: northern Rehob near the entrance of [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62)
locationsMap.description: This Rehob was a northern place or district near the entrance of [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62), marking the northern reach of the spies' journey and associated with Aramean forces in [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s war with [Ammon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010). It is distinct from the Rehob towns in [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly near Banias or the upper Jordan region

locationsMap.name: Rehoboth
locationsMap.title: [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf)'s uncontested well in [Gerar](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000086)
locationsMap.description: Rehoboth was the well [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf) named after his servants dug where the herdsmen of [Gerar](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000086) no longer strove with them, saying that the LORD had made room for them. It is usually located near Ruheibeh southwest of [Beersheba](location-id://0643b4cb-a5f4-4af3-b469-ed061976d1f4).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Ruheibeh in the Negev, southwest of Beersheba

locationsMap.name: Rehoboth by the River
locationsMap.title: Edomite royal city of [Shaul](name-id://b8a5c2e7-4f11-4f3b-9c7c-5bfa66b4d3d2)
locationsMap.description: Rehoboth by the River was the city of [Shaul](name-id://b8a5c2e7-4f11-4f3b-9c7c-5bfa66b4d3d2), one of the rulers of [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064) in [Genesis](book-key://GEN) and Chronicles. The river is usually understood as the [Euphrates](location-id://0bdad9de-f6dc-4681-8a5a-54526382bc9f), but the city's precise location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Rekem
locationsMap.title: [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) town named with [Irpeel](location-id://e688c3bb-8e2f-4979-b3b3-54a17bcb2a4e) and [Taralah](location-id://6f104ab9-c0b1-44b7-b92b-d201be875ece)
locationsMap.description: Rekem was a town in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s allotment, named with [Irpeel](location-id://e688c3bb-8e2f-4979-b3b3-54a17bcb2a4e) and [Taralah](location-id://6f104ab9-c0b1-44b7-b92b-d201be875ece). Its exact site is unknown, and it should be distinguished from the Midianite prince named Rekem.

locationsMap.name: Remeth
locationsMap.title: [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) city probably identical with Ramoth and [Jarmuth](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000113)
locationsMap.description: Remeth was a city in [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) named with [En-gannim](location-id://12fb5582-4de7-4442-a032-771299bc8530), En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez. It is probably the same place as Ramoth in [1 Chronicles 6:73](verse-key://1CH 6:73) and [Jarmuth](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000113) in [Joshua 21:29](verse-key://JOS 21:29), represented by er-Rameh southwest of Jenin.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Probably er-Rameh southwest of Jenin

locationsMap.name: Resen
locationsMap.title: Assyrian city between [Nineveh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000169) and [Calah](location-id://1f4bd082-fbe8-479c-a99f-f769ec8440f0)
locationsMap.description: Resen was a city in [Assyria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000023), named in [Genesis](book-key://GEN) as lying between [Nineveh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000169) and [Calah](location-id://1f4bd082-fbe8-479c-a99f-f769ec8440f0) and called a great city in that cluster. It is often associated with ruins between Kuyunjik and Nimrud, but the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly Selamiyeh between Nineveh and Nimrud in northern Iraq

locationsMap.name: Rezeph
locationsMap.title: Assyrian-destroyed city likely Resafa
locationsMap.description: Rezeph was named by the Assyrian envoy among places whose gods had not delivered them. It is usually identified with Resafa or Rusafa in northern [Syria](location-id://f4fe75e3-4f92-4642-bf57-3d6a59931322), an important ancient trade center on the desert edge.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Resafa, Syria

locationsMap.name: Rhegium
locationsMap.title: Italian port where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ship stopped
locationsMap.description: Rhegium was a city on the Italian side of the Strait of Messina. [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s Alexandrian ship stopped there for one day before a south wind carried it north to [Puteoli](location-id://334d3057-cce0-4fa8-a605-434200c25b61).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Reggio Calabria, Italy

locationsMap.name: Rhodes
locationsMap.title: Aegean island on [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s voyage route
locationsMap.description: Rhodes is the island and city in the southeastern Aegean Sea where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s party stopped while sailing from [Coos](location-id://00d0d924-4e3e-4957-b866-f14045e4cd7b) toward [Patara](location-id://70b57c92-7fc3-4f02-817d-4f591dd41209) on the return journey to [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Rhodes, Greece

locationsMap.name: Riblah
locationsMap.title: [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62) headquarters of Egyptian and Babylonian kings
locationsMap.description: Riblah in the land of [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62) was the strategic Syrian headquarters where [Pharaoh-necho](name-id://b0ac46ce-6193-4c08-9b10-509553696ad5) deposed [Jehoahaz](name-id://03f94193-9262-4097-98e8-a3130b808064) and where [Nebuchadnezzar](name-id://4f085903-eda2-4736-9163-a6136ad71000) judged [Zedekiah](name-id://4e94f5c3-aaa2-410f-95f2-ba908aaeac16) and the leaders of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119). It is represented by modern Ribleh on the Orontes.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Ribleh, Syria

locationsMap.name: Rimmon
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite refuge rock near [Gibeah](location-id://41084ab0-6cbc-4232-a844-fb8b405d97c3)
locationsMap.description: This Rimmon is the rock of Rimmon, where six hundred surviving Benjamites fled and stayed after the civil war at [Gibeah](location-id://41084ab0-6cbc-4232-a844-fb8b405d97c3). It is commonly identified with the prominent hill and village of Rummon north-northeast of Jeba.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Rummon, West Bank

locationsMap.name: Rimmon of the Negeb
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081) town also called [Enrimmon](location-id://0f95fdfb-1c87-4619-9195-637da5ea9a76)
locationsMap.description: Rimmon of the Negeb was a town near [Ain](location-id://151ff600-5303-4b5c-a0ae-ab590176b956) on the southern border area, assigned to [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081) and later remembered as a southern point of Judah. It is distinct from the rock of Rimmon and from Rimmono in [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c).

locationsMap.name: Rimmon Perez
locationsMap.title: unidentified wilderness encampment after [Rithmah](location-id://1a795da1-950d-497a-a717-2a4d77ee7d4f)
locationsMap.description: Rimmon Perez, spelled Rimmon-parez in the KJV, was one of Israel's wilderness stations, between [Rithmah](location-id://1a795da1-950d-497a-a717-2a4d77ee7d4f) and [Libnah](location-id://70d91d4d-8075-4ffe-9d3b-0571ec07539c) in [Numbers 33](chapter-key://NUM 33). Its exact location is unidentified.

locationsMap.name: Rissah
locationsMap.title: unidentified wilderness encampment before [Kehelathah](location-id://93a8b0b7-b643-4614-b398-d87f16922acc)
locationsMap.description: Rissah was an Israelite wilderness station between [Libnah](location-id://70d91d4d-8075-4ffe-9d3b-0571ec07539c) and [Kehelathah](location-id://93a8b0b7-b643-4614-b398-d87f16922acc) in [Numbers 33](chapter-key://NUM 33). The name may mean dew, but the site has not been securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Rithmah
locationsMap.title: unidentified wilderness encampment after [Hazeroth](location-id://3445bd29-bbd4-4173-81af-0856a73129ec)
locationsMap.description: Rithmah was an Israelite wilderness station between [Hazeroth](location-id://3445bd29-bbd4-4173-81af-0856a73129ec) and [Rimmon Perez](location-id://1a0008df-2534-4a25-b005-3d8da9bf79dc) in [Numbers 33](chapter-key://NUM 33). Its name is associated with the broom shrub, but the site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Rock of Escape
locationsMap.title: rock near [Maon](location-id://5dc48c50-612b-40c8-87f0-9948dab2dc29) where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) escaped [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)
locationsMap.description: The Rock of Escape, or Sela Hammahlekoth, was the place near the wilderness of [Maon](location-id://5dc48c50-612b-40c8-87f0-9948dab2dc29) where [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) broke off pursuing [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) because of a Philistine raid. It is a remembered landmark rather than a securely identified settlement.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Near Maon in the southern Hebron hills; exact rock uncertain

locationsMap.name: Rogelim
locationsMap.title: Gileadite home of [Barzillai](name-id://aea9362a-f684-49bb-8a00-8ffb02fe8e6e)
locationsMap.description: Rogelim was the home of [Barzillai](name-id://aea9362a-f684-49bb-8a00-8ffb02fe8e6e) the Gileadite, who helped [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) at [Mahanaim](location-id://67203862-b8e5-482c-b736-3f4120ba8397) during [Absalom](name-id://0e94a17b-69b1-4148-b7de-72eab8eea4cc)'s revolt and later accompanied him toward the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987). The place was in [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089), but its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Rome
locationsMap.title: capital city of the Roman Empire
locationsMap.description: Rome was the capital of the Roman Empire and the city to which [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) traveled and where a Christian community already existed. It is named repeatedly in [Acts](book-key://ACT), [Romans](book-key://ROM), and [2 Timothy](book-key://2TI).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Rome, Italy

locationsMap.name: Rumah
locationsMap.title: home of [Pedaiah](name-id://4b301ff7-532e-4d65-b2a4-f4073216902a), father of [Zebudah](name-id://0ff132da-4d23-49cb-b2c9-6b246e6ef211)
locationsMap.description: Rumah was the home of [Pedaiah](name-id://4b301ff7-532e-4d65-b2a4-f4073216902a), whose daughter [Zebudah](name-id://0ff132da-4d23-49cb-b2c9-6b246e6ef211) was the mother of [Jehoiakim](name-id://de373743-d689-4ec5-a3c6-8e97633cf920). Several identifications have been proposed, including [Arumah](location-id://0de2d4eb-264e-4eb7-94d7-5f072426cc1c) near [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201), a Galilean Rumah, or a Judahite Dumah/Rumah, so the site remains uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly Arumah near Shechem or another site named Rumah/Dumah

locationsMap.name: Reuben
locationsMap.title: Transjordan tribal territory north of the [Arnon](location-id://255578cb-f276-46f2-b857-683990b50518)
locationsMap.description: Reuben was the tribal territory that [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73) gave east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) to the descendants of [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9)’s firstborn son [Reuben](name-id://93b5d553-bee9-4897-a61d-2a5878e1c10b), reaching from the [Arnon](location-id://255578cb-f276-46f2-b857-683990b50518) northward over the tableland of [Heshbon](location-id://fcdae541-01d2-47f8-a663-45a2f056a250) and holding [Aroer](location-id://7e8f3dee-29fd-4046-8dbf-60833db11548) and the refuge city of [Bezer](location-id://6db00554-a619-4be1-a5b8-2c9f2b4de43f). Its people kept to their sheepfolds when the northern tribes went to war, and [Deborah](name-id://3fec4843-1e2e-4781-a8e7-f7aa0d955f5e) remembered the great searchings of heart among them.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: the Madaba plateau of west-central Jordan, north of the Wadi Mujib

locationsMap.name: Samaria
locationsMap.title: central hill-country region and ancient capital of northern Israel
locationsMap.description: Samaria names both the central hill country between Judea and [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080) and the city [Omri](name-id://a7d80fbc-a063-4d1a-83a0-f1ee3b80d501) built on [Shemer](name-id://1b56cc3c-d372-4c3b-b1a0-3f89cd1cf50e)'s hill as the capital of the northern kingdom; KJV passages use it for the capital, the kingdom or region, and the New Testament district traversed by [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) and the apostles.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: central West Bank, with ancient Samaria-Sebaste at Sebastia near Nablus

locationsMap.name: Sardis
locationsMap.title: Lydian city in [Asia](location-id://5e94bf0f-3192-4e8f-96d0-8d7a6743a038) addressed in [Revelation](book-key://REV)
locationsMap.description: Sardis was the ancient capital of Lydia in western Anatolia, later a Roman city of the province of [Asia](location-id://5e94bf0f-3192-4e8f-96d0-8d7a6743a038) and one of the seven churches named in [Revelation](book-key://REV).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sart near Salihli in Manisa Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Scythia
locationsMap.title: Graeco-Roman name for the Pontic steppe of the Scythians
locationsMap.description: Scythia was the classical geographic name for the steppe north of the Black Sea inhabited by Scythian peoples; the KJV uses the related demonym "Scythian" in [Colossians](book-key://COL) rather than naming the region itself.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Pontic steppe north of the Black Sea, especially parts of modern Ukraine and southern Russia

locationsMap.name: Shalem
locationsMap.title: uncertain KJV place or adverb in [Genesis 33:18](verse-key://GEN 33:18) near [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201)
locationsMap.description: The KJV reads that [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) came to Shalem, a city of [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201), in [Genesis 33:18](verse-key://GEN 33:18); many interpreters understand the Hebrew as "safely" rather than as a separate town, so the geographic entry remains tied to the Shechem area but uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Sheba
locationsMap.title: South Arabian kingdom associated with the queen of Sheba and trade
locationsMap.description: Sheba was the Sabaean kingdom of South Arabia, remembered in KJV passages for the queen who visited [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f) and for caravans and merchants trading gold, spices, and precious stones; the separate Sheba listed in [Joshua 19:2](verse-key://JOS 19:2) is kept as a distinct southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)/[Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081) town variant.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sabaean kingdom centered around Marib and Sirwah in present-day Yemen

locationsMap.name: Sheba (Simeon)
locationsMap.title: town in [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081)'s allotment listed with [Beer-sheba](location-id://0643b4cb-a5f4-4af3-b469-ed061976d1f4)
locationsMap.description: Sheba appears in [Joshua 19:2](verse-key://JOS 19:2) among the towns assigned to [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081) within [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s southern territory; because it is listed next to [Beer-sheba](location-id://0643b4cb-a5f4-4af3-b469-ed061976d1f4) and has no secure independent site, it is often treated as textually or geographically linked with Beer-sheba.

locationsMap.name: Shechem
locationsMap.title: Canaanite and Israelite city at Tell Balata between [Mount Ebal](location-id://0e6bfe72-76f5-4dfe-9944-34847c25d94f) and [Mount Gerizim](location-id://53ef9727-3bdd-4e6e-828d-266a3f9500fd)
locationsMap.description: Shechem was a Canaanite city and major Israelite center in the hill country of [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c), associated with [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412), [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9), [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s covenant assembly, [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c), and the first capital of the northern kingdom before Tirzah and [Samaria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000196).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell Balata near Nablus in the West Bank

locationsMap.name: Shiloh
locationsMap.title: Israelite sanctuary site north of [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) at Khirbet Seilun
locationsMap.description: Shiloh was the Ephraimite sanctuary where the tabernacle and ark stood after Israel entered [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045), where tribal allotments were made, and whose later desolation became a prophetic warning to [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Khirbet Seilun / Tel Shiloh in the West Bank

locationsMap.name: Shinar
locationsMap.title: Mesopotamian plain associated with [Babel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000025) and [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70)
locationsMap.description: Shinar is the KJV name for the Mesopotamian land where [Babel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000025), [Erech](location-id://fd3eb4d6-60d7-4fab-a8ab-b5d19906430b), [Accad](location-id://ff4ceff5-ebb4-43fe-930c-fce1681f08bd), and Calneh are placed, later associated with [Babylon](location-id://8939f721-e16f-4837-84f0-ec3dcc65ea70) and the exile imagery of Daniel and Zechariah.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: southern Mesopotamia in present-day Iraq

locationsMap.name: Shur
locationsMap.title: wilderness on [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065)'s eastern frontier toward [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)
locationsMap.description: Shur was the wilderness or frontier region east of [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065) and west of [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045), appearing in the stories of [Hagar](name-id://f90c700d-22eb-4853-88d7-7faca41ee81c), [Abraham](name-id://4ce14dfc-b652-45d9-ac05-5f0cf716c412), [Ishmael](name-id://056fd84a-3a55-4428-aef2-584809d7d7b1)'s descendants, Israel after the [Red Sea](location-id://26deae24-2471-47c1-8280-28e380224f20), [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb), and [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s raids.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: northwestern Sinai or the northeastern Egyptian frontier region

locationsMap.name: Sidon
locationsMap.title: Phoenician port city north of [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226)
locationsMap.description: Sidon was an ancient Phoenician coastal city, used in the KJV for the city and its people, associated with Canaanite borders, [Zarephath](location-id://c543d49a-89db-4846-a144-35954ff9bb61), prophetic oracles against Phoenicia, [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab)' ministry region, and [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s voyage to [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sidon / Saida, Lebanon

locationsMap.name: Sinai
locationsMap.title: mountain and wilderness of Israel's covenant at Sinai
locationsMap.description: Sinai is the KJV name for the wilderness and mountain where Israel camped after the exodus, received the law, and was numbered before leaving for the wilderness of [Paran](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000177); the traditional mountain is Jebel Musa, though the exact identification is disputed.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: traditionally Jebel Musa in the southern Sinai Peninsula, Egypt

locationsMap.name: Smyrna
locationsMap.title: Ionian city in [Asia](location-id://5e94bf0f-3192-4e8f-96d0-8d7a6743a038) addressed in [Revelation](book-key://REV)
locationsMap.description: Smyrna was an ancient Aegean city of Roman [Asia](location-id://5e94bf0f-3192-4e8f-96d0-8d7a6743a038), named among the seven churches in [Revelation](book-key://REV) and addressed as the church that would face tribulation and remain faithful.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Izmir, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Sodom
locationsMap.title: destroyed city of the plain near the Dead Sea
locationsMap.description: Sodom was one of the cities of the plain in [Genesis](book-key://GEN), destroyed with [Gomorrah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000091) and later used throughout the KJV as an image of judgment, corruption, and ruin; proposed sites near the Dead Sea remain disputed.

locationsMap.name: Spain
locationsMap.title: western Roman destination [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) hoped to visit
locationsMap.description: Spain is named in [Romans](book-key://ROM) as [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s intended western mission destination after visiting [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b), corresponding to Roman Hispania on the Iberian Peninsula.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Spain on the Iberian Peninsula

locationsMap.name: Salamis
locationsMap.title: Cypriot port where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13) preached
locationsMap.description: Salamis was a city on the east coast of [Cyprus](location-id://cddb5c4a-d659-447d-b7bd-cd2aee99dde2) where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223), [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13), and [John Mark](name-id://3dbf09ef-0086-4536-8235-765f4214342c) first preached in the synagogues during the first missionary journey.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: ancient Salamis near Famagusta, Cyprus

locationsMap.name: Salem
locationsMap.title: city of [Melchizedek](name-id://827a6b81-3dff-43a9-b386-5f27643f19bd) commonly identified with [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: Salem is the city of [Melchizedek](name-id://827a6b81-3dff-43a9-b386-5f27643f19bd) in [Genesis](book-key://GEN) and [Hebrews](book-key://HEB) and is poetically paired with [Zion](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000245) in [Psalm 76](chapter-key://PSA 76); it is traditionally identified with [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), though the identification is not explicit in [Genesis](book-key://GEN).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: usually identified with Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Salim
locationsMap.title: place near [Aenon](location-id://093c003e-aa6a-4201-9991-aacb3f40ebe0) where [John](name-id://0def26d5-2ca4-4b89-95c1-f8d964d0c6e9) baptized
locationsMap.description: Salim appears in [John 3:23](verse-key://JHN 3:23) as the place near [Aenon](location-id://093c003e-aa6a-4201-9991-aacb3f40ebe0) where [John](name-id://0def26d5-2ca4-4b89-95c1-f8d964d0c6e9) baptized because there was much water there; proposed identifications include sites in [Samaria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000196) and the Jordan Valley, but no single location is secure.

locationsMap.name: Salmone
locationsMap.title: eastern promontory of [Crete](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000055) passed by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ship
locationsMap.description: Salmone was the eastern cape of [Crete](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000055) passed with difficulty by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s Alexandrian grain ship on the voyage toward [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b) in [Acts 27](chapter-key://ACT 27).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Cape Sideros on eastern Crete, Greece

locationsMap.name: Salt Sea
locationsMap.title: KJV name for the Dead Sea at Israel's eastern border
locationsMap.description: The Salt Sea is the Dead Sea, used in the KJV for the southern and eastern boundary waters of [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) and the [Arabah](location-id://bfd23a68-b7bd-4bd0-99fe-d1d16a0b2a71) and for the basin connected with the cities of the plain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Dead Sea between Israel, the West Bank, and Jordan

locationsMap.name: Samos
locationsMap.title: Aegean island passed by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) after Chios
locationsMap.description: Samos was the Aegean island near the coast of Asia Minor where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ship touched or passed after Chios and before Trogyllium and [Miletus](location-id://2a3d81b9-2d80-47f4-ac15-1aae05193c1a) on the return to [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Samos, Greece

locationsMap.name: Sansannah
locationsMap.title: town in the Negeb of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Sansannah was a town listed in the southern allotment of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15), apparently in the Negeb group near [Ziklag](location-id://7c601d7a-d65c-457d-adea-6ed6d233078f) and [Madmannah](location-id://9b274173-4606-48d7-a466-3ce846aed349); its precise modern site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Sarid
locationsMap.title: border point in [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c)'s allotment
locationsMap.description: Sarid marked part of the boundary of [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) in [Joshua 19](chapter-key://JOS 19), lying in the Jezreel Valley region; it is commonly proposed near Tell Shadud, but the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly Tell Shadud in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Sea of Chinnereth
locationsMap.title: older KJV name for the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b)
locationsMap.description: The Sea of Chinnereth is the lake later called the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b) or [Sea of Tiberias](location-id://5ab781b5-d13b-40d5-9842-0fd0acb8d78d), used in [Numbers](book-key://NUM) and [Joshua](book-key://JOS) as a landmark on Israel's northeastern boundaries.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sea of Galilee / Lake Kinneret, Israel

locationsMap.name: Sea of Chinneroth
locationsMap.title: variant KJV name for the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b)
locationsMap.description: The Sea of Chinneroth is a plural form of Chinnereth in [Joshua 12:3](verse-key://JOS 12:3), referring to the same freshwater lake later known as the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b) and [Sea of Tiberias](location-id://5ab781b5-d13b-40d5-9842-0fd0acb8d78d).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sea of Galilee / Lake Kinneret, Israel

locationsMap.name: Sea of Galilee
locationsMap.title: freshwater lake central to [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab)' Galilean ministry
locationsMap.description: The Sea of Galilee is the freshwater lake in northern Israel where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) called fishermen disciples, taught, healed, and traveled by boat; John also identifies it with the [Sea of Tiberias](location-id://5ab781b5-d13b-40d5-9842-0fd0acb8d78d).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sea of Galilee / Lake Kinneret, Israel

locationsMap.name: Sea of Jazer
locationsMap.title: waters near [Jazer](location-id://cc0e71e3-343f-4ccf-9bee-9a134d1322fb) in Jeremiah's oracle over [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)
locationsMap.description: The Sea of Jazer appears in [Jeremiah 48:32](verse-key://JER 48:32) in a lament over [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153)'s vine country; it likely refers to pools, waters, or a local basin near [Jazer](location-id://cc0e71e3-343f-4ccf-9bee-9a134d1322fb) rather than a major sea, and the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Sea of Tiberias
locationsMap.title: John's Roman-period name for the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b)
locationsMap.description: The Sea of Tiberias is John's name for the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b), reflecting the lakeside city of Tiberias and identifying the same freshwater lake where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) fed the multitude and appeared after the resurrection.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sea of Galilee / Lake Kinneret, Israel

locationsMap.name: Sea of the Philistines
locationsMap.title: Mediterranean Sea along the Philistine coast
locationsMap.description: The Sea of the Philistines is the western boundary sea in [Exodus 23:31](verse-key://EXO 23:31), referring to the Mediterranean along the Philistine coastal plain opposite Israel's landward borders.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: eastern Mediterranean Sea along the southern Levant coast

locationsMap.name: Seba
locationsMap.title: distant Cushite or southern people-land paired with [Sheba](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000200)
locationsMap.description: Seba is named with [Sheba](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000200) in royal tribute imagery and with [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065) and [Ethiopia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000077) in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA); it appears to denote a distant people or region connected with [Cush](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000059), but its exact geographic identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Secacah
locationsMap.title: wilderness town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s eastern district
locationsMap.description: Secacah was listed among the wilderness towns of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15), near [Nibshan](location-id://b1da2bba-59be-4cd7-890e-3befcc56d6a5) and the [city of Salt](location-id://f4b61774-6a7a-4b44-a58e-d4bf2986a8c9); no secure modern identification is known.

locationsMap.name: Seir
locationsMap.title: mountain region of [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064) associated with [Esau](name-id://c4d0e1b7-7cba-49cb-80b6-e5068cfb4e2f)
locationsMap.description: Seir is the mountain country south and southeast of the Dead Sea, first associated with the Horites and then with [Esau](name-id://c4d0e1b7-7cba-49cb-80b6-e5068cfb4e2f) and [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064); KJV passages also use it in poetic descriptions of the LORD's march from the south.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Edomite highlands of southern Jordan

locationsMap.name: Sela
locationsMap.title: Edomite rock stronghold associated with [Amaziah](name-id://ec8132b1-83a8-4852-a89e-c02e67fbf9b6)'s victory
locationsMap.description: Sela, meaning rock, was an Edomite stronghold taken by [Amaziah](name-id://ec8132b1-83a8-4852-a89e-c02e67fbf9b6) and also appears in prophetic oracles over [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) and the desert; it is often linked with Petra or another rock site in [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064), but the exact identification is debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly Petra or another Edomite rock site in southern Jordan

locationsMap.name: Seleucia
locationsMap.title: port of [Antioch](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012) from which [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) sailed to [Cyprus](location-id://cddb5c4a-d659-447d-b7bd-cd2aee99dde2)
locationsMap.description: Seleucia was the Mediterranean port serving [Antioch](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012) in [Syria](location-id://f4fe75e3-4f92-4642-bf57-3d6a59931322); [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) and [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13) went down there before sailing to [Cyprus](location-id://cddb5c4a-d659-447d-b7bd-cd2aee99dde2) on the first missionary journey.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Seleucia Pieria near Samandag, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Seneh
locationsMap.title: rocky crag at the [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd) pass opposite Bozez
locationsMap.description: Seneh was one of the two sharp rocks flanking the pass where [Jonathan](name-id://0654ad89-fc99-484a-8771-b277e9225953) and his armourbearer crossed toward the Philistine garrison at [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd); it stood opposite Bozez.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: cliffs of Wadi Suweinit near Michmash, exact rock uncertain

locationsMap.name: Senir
locationsMap.title: Amorite name for [Mount Hermon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000156)
locationsMap.description: Senir is the Amorite name for [Mount Hermon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000156) in [Deuteronomy](book-key://DEU) and a poetic source of mountain timber and beauty in [Song of Solomon](book-key://SNG) and [Ezekiel](book-key://EZK).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Hermon on the Lebanon-Syria-Golan border region

locationsMap.name: Sephar
locationsMap.title: eastern mountain landmark in the Joktanite settlement list
locationsMap.description: Sephar is named in [Genesis 10:30](verse-key://GEN 10:30) as an eastern mountain boundary of the sons of [Joktan](name-id://a787d465-281f-4826-be1e-4239728217bc); it is commonly sought in South [Arabia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014), but the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Sepharad
locationsMap.title: exile location in [Obadiah](book-key://OBA) later associated with [Spain](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000213)
locationsMap.description: Sepharad is named in [Obadiah](book-key://OBA) as a place of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s captivity; ancient proposals often connect it with [Sardis](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000197) in Lydia, while later Jewish usage made Sepharad a name for [Spain](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000213), so the original identification remains uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly Sardis in Lydia; later Jewish usage refers to Spain

locationsMap.name: Sepharvaim
locationsMap.title: Assyrian deportee city possibly identified with Sippar
locationsMap.description: Sepharvaim was one of the cities from which [Assyria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000023) brought settlers into [Samaria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000196) and whose gods are mocked in Assyrian-threat texts; it is often identified with Sippar in Babylonia, but the identification remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Shaalabbin
locationsMap.title: Danite town variant of [Shaalbim](location-id://4413d56c-bdd0-455a-8cbc-9f64e00baae6) near [Aijalon](location-id://6d63bb71-0ada-4fc1-bfdd-fe6948d7cfd4)
locationsMap.description: Shaalabbin was a town in [Dan](name-id://3de74a0e-f0c6-4087-b902-c30a6d218cff)'s allotment and is generally treated as the same place as [Shaalbim](location-id://4413d56c-bdd0-455a-8cbc-9f64e00baae6), near [Aijalon](location-id://6d63bb71-0ada-4fc1-bfdd-fe6948d7cfd4) on the edge of the Shephelah.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: near Shaalvim / Salbit in Israel

locationsMap.name: Shaalbim
locationsMap.title: Danite town near [Aijalon](location-id://6d63bb71-0ada-4fc1-bfdd-fe6948d7cfd4) under Amorite pressure
locationsMap.description: Shaalbim was a Danite town where Amorites persisted and later a Solomonic district location, generally identified with the [Shaalabbin](location-id://3b26854d-3b3e-46e7-80c8-0f61076d7b5c)/Shaalvim area near [Aijalon](location-id://6d63bb71-0ada-4fc1-bfdd-fe6948d7cfd4).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: near Shaalvim / Salbit in Israel

locationsMap.name: Shaaraim
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081) town or gate-place near the Elah route
locationsMap.description: Shaaraim appears in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s Shephelah list, in [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081)'s towns, and on the Philistine flight route after [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) killed [Goliath](name-id://69bffebc-acde-4cc2-83a4-cc0533c60424); Khirbet Qeiyafa has been proposed, but the biblical references may not all require one secure site.

locationsMap.name: Shallecheth
locationsMap.title: western gate of the temple precinct by the causeway
locationsMap.description: Shallecheth was a gate assigned to the porters in [1 Chronicles 26](chapter-key://1CH 26), located by the causeway of the going up on the west side of the [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) temple complex.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: western side of the ancient Jerusalem temple precinct, exact gate location uncertain

locationsMap.name: Shamir
locationsMap.title: hill-country town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s allotment
locationsMap.description: This Shamir was a town in the hill country of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed with [Jattir](location-id://bb79e534-b816-4afc-89d6-7dacf78ea24d) and [Socoh](location-id://9b32cc6e-9ecb-4a60-966f-c015601c6974) in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15); it is distinct from the Ephraimite Shamir associated with the judge [Tola](name-id://be43e574-ba7e-4641-b5d7-0437e3068858).

locationsMap.name: Shamir (Ephraim)
locationsMap.title: Ephraimite town where the judge [Tola](name-id://be43e574-ba7e-4641-b5d7-0437e3068858) lived and was buried
locationsMap.description: This Shamir was in [Mount Ephraim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000155) and is named as the residence and burial place of [Tola](name-id://be43e574-ba7e-4641-b5d7-0437e3068858), the judge who arose after [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c); its modern site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Sharon
locationsMap.title: fertile coastal plain between [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029) and [Joppa](location-id://dd33c11c-6e8d-484a-8911-bb20e6126e7c)
locationsMap.description: Sharon is the fertile Mediterranean coastal plain of Israel, known for pastures, flowers, judgment imagery, and the towns around [Lydda](location-id://8d32e0bd-538e-497c-a459-c4425bcc3a7d) that turned to the Lord in [Acts](book-key://ACT).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sharon plain along the central coast of Israel

locationsMap.name: Sharon (Gad)
locationsMap.title: Gadite district east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987)
locationsMap.description: This Sharon is the district named with [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089) and [Bashan](location-id://af0d12bf-aa1c-494c-9f89-8288fd65ef3d) where Gadites lived in [1 Chronicles 5:16](verse-key://1CH 5:16), distinct from the better-known coastal plain of Sharon.

locationsMap.name: Sharuhen
locationsMap.title: southern town in [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081)'s allotment, known from Egyptian sources
locationsMap.description: Sharuhen was a town in the south assigned within [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081)'s inheritance and is often connected with the Late Bronze Age city of Sharuhen known from Egyptian campaigns; proposed sites in the western Negeb remain debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly Tell el-Farah South or Tel Haror in the northern Negeb

locationsMap.name: Shaveh Kiriathaim
locationsMap.title: plain of [Kiriathaim](location-id://a89d6985-ae99-48d3-81d2-f8dd68557e30) where [Chedorlaomer](name-id://ed428395-dc41-4ed2-9229-bd7abfaa930f) struck the Emims
locationsMap.description: Shaveh Kiriathaim was the plain or valley near [Kiriathaim](location-id://a89d6985-ae99-48d3-81d2-f8dd68557e30) in Transjordan where the Emims were defeated in [Genesis 14](chapter-key://GEN 14); its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Shebarim
locationsMap.title: place near [Ai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004) where Israel fled after Achan's sin
locationsMap.description: Shebarim was the place to which the men of [Ai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004) chased Israel after the failed first attack on Ai; the name may mean quarries or stone-breakings and the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Sheep Gate
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) gate near the temple and [Bethesda](location-id://aea96c61-bfce-4bad-b68c-d105e4c3dc9b)
locationsMap.description: The Sheep Gate was a gate of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) repaired by the priests in [Nehemiah](book-key://NEH) and associated in [John 5](chapter-key://JHN 5) with the pool called [Bethesda](location-id://aea96c61-bfce-4bad-b68c-d105e4c3dc9b) near the sheep market or gate.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: northern or northeastern side of ancient Jerusalem near the temple area

locationsMap.name: Shema
locationsMap.title: southern town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s Negeb list
locationsMap.description: Shema was a town in the southern allotment of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) named in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15); it may be related textually to Sheba or Shema in parallel lists, and its site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Shen
locationsMap.title: landmark near Mizpeh where [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812) set [Ebenezer](location-id://a349ee5a-4e02-4215-8dd3-d8fa2646f702)
locationsMap.description: Shen was the landmark named with Mizpeh when [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812) set up the [Ebenezer](location-id://a349ee5a-4e02-4215-8dd3-d8fa2646f702) stone after Israel's victory over the Philistines; its precise location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Shepham
locationsMap.title: northeastern boundary point of [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045)
locationsMap.description: Shepham was a boundary point on the northeastern border of [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) in [Numbers 34](chapter-key://NUM 34), between Hazar-enan and Riblah in the descent toward the [Sea of Chinnereth](location-id://30d68225-3355-4ec2-9d41-8ba27a817d53); the site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Shihorlibnath
locationsMap.title: [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797) boundary watercourse near [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029)
locationsMap.description: Shihorlibnath marked part of [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797)'s boundary in [Joshua 19](chapter-key://JOS 19), probably a stream or coastal watercourse near [Carmel](location-id://bd09f548-2fa1-4b25-8f6b-d00dc545d029), but its exact identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Shicron
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) boundary point near [Ekron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000066) and [Jabneel](location-id://0e5abfc2-66d6-4464-ae8c-cb6e6f3d5571)
locationsMap.description: Shicron was a point on [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s northern border between Mount Baalah and [Jabneel](location-id://0e5abfc2-66d6-4464-ae8c-cb6e6f3d5571) near [Ekron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000066); its precise site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Shilhim
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town in the Negeb list
locationsMap.description: Shilhim was a town in the southern allotment of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), listed near [Ain](location-id://151ff600-5303-4b5c-a0ae-ab590176b956) and Rimmon; it may overlap with later Simeonite variants, but its site is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly in the northern Negeb near Sharuhen, exact site uncertain

locationsMap.name: Shiloah
locationsMap.title: gentle waters of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) associated with [Siloam](location-id://bb3b1b0e-e5ac-4f2f-854e-fdf517340d09)
locationsMap.description: Shiloah in [Isaiah 8:6](verse-key://ISA 8:6) refers to the gently flowing waters of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), generally associated with the [Siloam](location-id://bb3b1b0e-e5ac-4f2f-854e-fdf517340d09) water system fed from the [Gihon](location-id://8e570c09-3758-434a-8d3e-49c7a11b131d) spring.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Siloam water system in Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Shimron
locationsMap.title: Canaanite and [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) town also called [Shimron-meron](location-id://7a321533-70c2-4d12-bfef-1b3fceb0ef2b)
locationsMap.description: Shimron was a Canaanite city whose king joined Jabin's northern coalition and a town in [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c)'s inheritance; it is commonly identified with Tell es-Samuniyeh near modern Nahalal, though the identification is not certain.
