locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly Tell es-Samuniyeh near Nahalal, Israel

locationsMap.name: Shimronmeron
locationsMap.title: alternate royal name for [Shimron](location-id://69a1e60f-4863-4751-bebd-2ff732216eb8) in the conquered kings list
locationsMap.description: Shimronmeron appears in Joshua's list of defeated kings and is generally treated as the same northern city as [Shimron](location-id://69a1e60f-4863-4751-bebd-2ff732216eb8), though the compound form preserves a distinct biblical spelling.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly Tell es-Samuniyeh near Nahalal, Israel

locationsMap.name: Shittim
locationsMap.title: Israelite camp in the plains of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) before crossing [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987)
locationsMap.description: Shittim, also called Abel-shittim, was Israel's camp in the plains of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153) where the [Baalpeor](location-id://ed08e529-bb95-4f61-b75e-5915911773ca) episode occurred and from which [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816) sent spies and then moved toward the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell el-Hammam / Abel-shittim area east of the Jordan, identification debated

locationsMap.name: Shual
locationsMap.title: land raided from the Philistine camp at [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd)
locationsMap.description: The land of Shual was one of the directions taken by Philistine spoilers from [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd) in [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)'s day, probably a district north or northeast of Michmash; its exact extent is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Shunem
locationsMap.title: [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) town of the Shunammite woman near [Jezreel](location-id://01fb54a8-39da-4de4-9ba9-6c91d7efff5b)
locationsMap.description: Shunem was an [Issachar](name-id://380b2749-91f8-4a15-bcc2-0da2476c025b) town in the [Jezreel](location-id://01fb54a8-39da-4de4-9ba9-6c91d7efff5b) Valley region, where the Philistines camped before [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) visited Endor and where [Elisha](name-id://6e9af9e4-8635-4289-826f-bf6d37611683) lodged with the Shunammite woman.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sulam, Israel

locationsMap.name: Sibmah
locationsMap.title: Reubenite and Moabite vineyard town near [Heshbon](location-id://fcdae541-01d2-47f8-a663-45a2f056a250)
locationsMap.description: Sibmah was a town rebuilt by [Reuben](name-id://93b5d553-bee9-4897-a61d-2a5878e1c10b) and later lamented by Isaiah and Jeremiah as a Moabite vineyard center whose vines reached toward [Jazer](location-id://cc0e71e3-343f-4ccf-9bee-9a134d1322fb) and the sea; its site near [Heshbon](location-id://fcdae541-01d2-47f8-a663-45a2f056a250) is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly near Heshbon in Jordan, exact site uncertain

locationsMap.name: Sibraim
locationsMap.title: northern boundary place between [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) and [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62)
locationsMap.description: Sibraim was named in Ezekiel's ideal northern boundary between [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) and [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62), but its exact historical location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Silla
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) landmark on the descent to [Millo](location-id://d26a3a0d-facc-4cac-ad5b-e6e8ac3a2076)
locationsMap.description: Silla was the place on the way down to [Millo](location-id://d26a3a0d-facc-4cac-ad5b-e6e8ac3a2076) where servants killed King [Joash](name-id://5b36b473-4fab-405e-9776-716f92f0b62f); it was somewhere in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), but the precise feature is unknown.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: somewhere in ancient Jerusalem near Millo, exact site unknown

locationsMap.name: Siloam
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) pool and tower associated with [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab)' ministry
locationsMap.description: Siloam was the [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) pool where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) sent the man born blind to wash, and the nearby tower of Siloam was remembered in [Luke](book-key://LUK) as the place where eighteen people died when it fell.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Pool of Siloam in Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Sin
locationsMap.title: wilderness between [Elim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000068) and [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210) on Israel's exodus route
locationsMap.description: The wilderness of Sin was the desert stage between [Elim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000068) and [Sinai](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000210) where Israel murmured for food and received manna; the exact route and location in Sinai remain debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: somewhere in the Sinai Peninsula, exact route uncertain

locationsMap.name: Siphmoth
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town that received spoil from [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) at [Ziklag](location-id://7c601d7a-d65c-457d-adea-6ed6d233078f)
locationsMap.description: Siphmoth was one of the towns of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s elders to which [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) sent spoil after defeating the Amalekites, likely in the southern hill country or Negeb but not securely located.

locationsMap.name: Sirah
locationsMap.title: well near [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103) from which [Joab](name-id://12ff519a-1af6-4374-bf58-09dbfb159d43) recalled [Abner](name-id://3ce44295-3e16-47da-9037-8888f703aae7)
locationsMap.description: Sirah was a well near [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103); [Joab](name-id://12ff519a-1af6-4374-bf58-09dbfb159d43) sent messengers from the well of Sirah to bring [Abner](name-id://3ce44295-3e16-47da-9037-8888f703aae7) back before murdering him at Hebron.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: near Hebron, exact well uncertain

locationsMap.name: Sirion
locationsMap.title: Sidonian name for [Mount Hermon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000156)
locationsMap.description: Sirion is the Sidonian name for [Mount Hermon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000156) in [Deuteronomy](book-key://DEU) and is poetically paired with [Lebanon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000133) in [Psalm 29](chapter-key://PSA 29).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Hermon on the Lebanon-Syria-Israel border region

locationsMap.name: Sitnah
locationsMap.title: well of contention dug by [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf)'s servants near [Gerar](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000086)
locationsMap.description: Sitnah was the second disputed well named by [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf) after the herdmen of [Gerar](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000086) strove with him; its exact location in the Gerar region is unknown.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Gerar region in the northern Negeb, exact well unknown

locationsMap.name: Socoh (Shephelah)
locationsMap.title: fortified Shephelah town near the [Valley of Elah](location-id://29f276d2-7c8e-4f2d-b8fc-1e42a5d2d893)
locationsMap.description: This Socoh was a lowland town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) near [Azekah](location-id://f345fc22-3282-4ad7-9817-3e2b38026e41) and the [Valley of Elah](location-id://29f276d2-7c8e-4f2d-b8fc-1e42a5d2d893), fortified by Rehoboam and later taken by the Philistines; it is distinct from the hill-country [Socoh](location-id://9b32cc6e-9ecb-4a60-966f-c015601c6974) in [Joshua 15:48](verse-key://JOS 15:48).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Khirbet Shuweikeh / Sokho near the Valley of Elah, Israel

locationsMap.name: Socoh (hill country)
locationsMap.title: hill-country town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) near [Shamir](location-id://566e5abb-f7e6-4341-a79f-c53d6cf5c7f3) and [Jattir](location-id://bb79e534-b816-4afc-89d6-7dacf78ea24d)
locationsMap.description: This Socoh was a town in the hill country of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) listed with [Shamir](location-id://566e5abb-f7e6-4341-a79f-c53d6cf5c7f3) and [Jattir](location-id://bb79e534-b816-4afc-89d6-7dacf78ea24d), separate from the better-known Shephelah town near the [Valley of Elah](location-id://29f276d2-7c8e-4f2d-b8fc-1e42a5d2d893).

locationsMap.name: Straight
locationsMap.title: street in [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) where [Saul](name-id://cd6d7c95-6dcb-4f1e-b0f2-1be11d3d4a6e) was sent after his vision
locationsMap.description: Straight was the east-west street in [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) where [Ananias](name-id://25444bbc-1f68-4066-a692-2da5962df8fe) was told to find [Saul](name-id://cd6d7c95-6dcb-4f1e-b0f2-1be11d3d4a6e) of Tarsus in the house of Judas; it corresponds to the ancient decumanus of Damascus, still remembered as Straight Street.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Straight Street / Midhat Pasha Street and Bab Sharqi Street in Damascus, Syria

locationsMap.name: Succoth (Egypt)
locationsMap.title: first named Israelite camp after [Rameses](location-id://ba59e20a-1630-41b8-a91c-4a0a1dbf5b21) in the exodus
locationsMap.description: This Succoth was the first named station after [Rameses](location-id://ba59e20a-1630-41b8-a91c-4a0a1dbf5b21) on Israel's departure from [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065), before [Etham](location-id://864b6fae-f516-45b9-9493-b6a8e0ccd6eb) at the edge of the wilderness; its exact site in the eastern Nile Delta is debated.

locationsMap.name: Succoth (Transjordan)
locationsMap.title: Jordan Valley town where [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) built booths
locationsMap.description: This Succoth was the Transjordan town in the Jordan Valley where [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) built booths, later allotted near [Gad](name-id://b68edd6a-6aea-4f9f-8c99-684d9a6f7a8b), involved in [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s pursuit of [Midian](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000152), and named with Zarthan near the clay ground used for [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s temple furnishings.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: possibly Tell Deir Alla in the Jordan Valley, exact identification debated

locationsMap.name: Sur
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) gate guarded during [Joash](name-id://5b36b473-4fab-405e-9776-716f92f0b62f)'s coronation coup
locationsMap.description: Sur was a gate in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) assigned to one third of the guard when [Jehoiada](name-id://f9531643-dfa4-4c2e-a5cc-cd2ddad755e7) protected young [Joash](name-id://5b36b473-4fab-405e-9776-716f92f0b62f) and overthrew [Athaliah](name-id://8cf0e51d-659d-42b1-a0ca-3c5fae8a9720); its precise location in the temple or palace complex is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: somewhere in the Jerusalem temple or palace precinct, exact location unknown

locationsMap.name: Sychar
locationsMap.title: Samaritan town near [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9)'s well where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) spoke with the woman
locationsMap.description: Sychar was a city of [Samaria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000196) near the parcel [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9) gave [Joseph](name-id://207b40a3-2f5b-44bb-b90a-334cc21398b3), where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) rested at Jacob's well; it is usually connected with [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) or a nearby village such as Askar, so the exact identification is debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: near Shechem/Tell Balata or Askar by Nablus, West Bank, exact identification debated

locationsMap.name: Syene
locationsMap.title: southern Egyptian frontier city now Aswan
locationsMap.description: Syene was [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065)'s southern frontier city on the Nile, named in Ezekiel's judgments as marking the southern reach of Egypt; it corresponds to ancient Swenett and modern Aswan.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Aswan, Egypt

locationsMap.name: Syracuse
locationsMap.title: Sicilian port where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ship stayed three days
locationsMap.description: Syracuse was the ancient Greek city and Sicilian port where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s Alexandrian ship tarried three days on the voyage from Malta toward [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Syracuse / Siracusa, Sicily, Italy

locationsMap.name: Syria
locationsMap.title: biblical [Aram](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000015) and Roman Syrian region centered on the northern Levant
locationsMap.description: Syria in the KJV covers the Aramean kingdoms and the later Hellenistic and Roman Syrian region, often centered on [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061) in Old Testament narratives and including the wider northern Levant in New Testament travel notices.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: historical Syria / Greater Syria region of the Levant, not identical to modern national borders

locationsMap.name: Sorek
locationsMap.title: valley west of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) associated with [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648) and [Delilah](name-id://33a2e44d-45d6-4f0e-b566-59f10933d96d)
locationsMap.description: The valley of Sorek is where [Delilah](name-id://33a2e44d-45d6-4f0e-b566-59f10933d96d) lived and where [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648)'s betrayal to the Philistines took place.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Wadi es-Sarar, west of Jerusalem toward the Philistine plain

locationsMap.name: Simeon
locationsMap.title: southern tribal territory taken out of the portion of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Simeon was the tribal territory allotted to the descendants of [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9)’s son [Simeon](name-id://cca9437f-0046-4dd6-a7eb-45ac460a161a), drawn as the second lot out of the portion of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) because that portion was too large for its tribe, and holding [Beersheba](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000027), [Ziklag](location-id://7c601d7a-d65c-457d-adea-6ed6d233078f), [Hormah](location-id://b9e20e05-0a77-4056-84c9-260cbdfe75f0), and [Sheba (Simeon)](location-id://6de66ed4-c371-4bcd-9e6a-5118d4b46b86) in the dry south. Lying inside Judah, Simeon never became a separate country, yet it is still counted a portion by the border of Benjamin in the vision of the divided land.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: the northern Negev around Beersheba in southern Israel

locationsMap.name: Tarshish
locationsMap.title: distant maritime place associated with Tyrian trade and ships
locationsMap.description: Tarshish is a biblical place or trading region repeatedly linked with long-distance ships, metals, [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226)'s commerce, and [Jonah](name-id://ca68bc73-d617-4010-8c81-4cfff8cc650c)'s attempted flight from [Joppa](location-id://dd33c11c-6e8d-484a-8911-bb20e6126e7c). Its exact location is disputed, with proposals including Tartessos in Spain, Sardinia, Carthage, and [Tarsus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000218) in [Cilicia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000054).

locationsMap.name: Tarsus
locationsMap.title: Cilician city where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) was born and later returned
locationsMap.description: Tarsus was the chief city of [Cilicia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000054) in the Roman period and is named in [Acts](book-key://ACT) as [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s birthplace and as a city of Roman citizenship; after his conversion Paul was sent there and later brought from Tarsus to [Antioch](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000012) by [Barnabas](name-id://ba3667d2-9c64-4e6e-8836-beb53828cb13).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tarsus, Mersin Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Timnathserah
locationsMap.title: variant spelling of [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s inheritance city Timnathserah
locationsMap.description: Timnathserah is a modern hyphenated form of KJV Timnathserah, the city in [Mount Ephraim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000155) that Israel gave to [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816) and where he was buried. The site is traditionally connected with Kifl Haris, though the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally Kifl Haris in the central West Bank

locationsMap.name: Timnath
locationsMap.title: Philistine border town associated with [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648) and [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)
locationsMap.description: Timnath is the KJV form used for the lowland town connected with [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648)'s marriage journey and with the Philistine-held [Timnah](location-id://023d7831-a16e-417f-b7b2-ddaa748aa2b9) on the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)-[Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd) frontier; it is commonly associated with the Sorek Valley site of Tel Batash, though some Timnah references may reflect more than one site.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often identified with Tel Batash in the Sorek Valley, Israel

locationsMap.name: Trachonitis
locationsMap.title: Roman district governed by [Philip](name-id://f1b777fe-2c06-4f23-b0fb-af692e2c8594) in the days of [John the Baptist](name-id://0def26d5-2ca4-4b89-95c1-f8d964d0c6e9)
locationsMap.description: Trachonitis was a rough basalt district east and northeast of [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080); Luke names it as part of the tetrarchy of [Philip](name-id://f1b777fe-2c06-4f23-b0fb-af692e2c8594) during the ministry of [John the Baptist](name-id://0def26d5-2ca4-4b89-95c1-f8d964d0c6e9).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Lejah / Trachon region of southern Syria

locationsMap.name: Tyre
locationsMap.title: Phoenician port city repeatedly addressed by prophets and visited by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)
locationsMap.description: Tyre was the major Phoenician coastal and island city north of [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108), famous for trade, seafaring, alliance with [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) and [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f), prophetic oracles against its pride, and New Testament contacts in the region of Tyre and [Sidon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000208).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tyre / Sour on the Mediterranean coast of Lebanon

locationsMap.name: Taanach
locationsMap.title: Canaanite city in [Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe) near [Megiddo](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000148)
locationsMap.description: Taanach was a Canaanite city allotted in [Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe) and later assigned to the Kohathite Levites; Israel did not fully drive out its inhabitants, and [Judges](book-key://JDG) locates the battle with [Sisera](name-id://23741267-e00a-4bad-9d7f-f66e9d398d4f) by the waters of [Megiddo](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000148) at Taanach.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell Ta'anakh in the northern West Bank near Jenin

locationsMap.name: Taanathshiloh
locationsMap.title: border place on the eastern side of [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c)
locationsMap.description: Taanathshiloh, written Taanathshiloh in the KJV, appears once as a landmark on the border of [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) east of [Shiloh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000203); its precise modern site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Tabbath
locationsMap.title: place near [Abel-meholah](location-id://d655b227-bc54-4c54-a3d9-a78f621a925d) in [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s pursuit of [Midian](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000152)
locationsMap.description: Tabbath is named once in [Judges](book-key://JDG) as a place near which the Midianites fled after [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s surprise attack; it lay in the Jordan Valley region near [Abel-meholah](location-id://d655b227-bc54-4c54-a3d9-a78f621a925d), but its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Taberah
locationsMap.title: wilderness encampment named for the burning at Israel's complaint
locationsMap.description: Taberah was the wilderness place where fire from the Lord burned among Israel after the people complained; [Deuteronomy](book-key://DEU) recalls it among the wilderness provocations, but its exact location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Tabor
locationsMap.title: short biblical form for [Mount Tabor](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000160) in Lower [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080)
locationsMap.description: Tabor is the short biblical form for [Mount Tabor](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000160) in Lower [Galilee](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000080), used in boundary, narrative, poetic, and prophetic references. The separate Levitical town in Chronicles and the KJV plain of Tabor in [1 Samuel](book-key://1SA) are kept as distinct variant records.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Mount Tabor in Lower Galilee, Israel

locationsMap.name: Tadmor
locationsMap.title: Solomonic desert city identified with Palmyra
locationsMap.description: Tadmor was a wilderness city built or fortified by [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f) according to [2 Chronicles](book-key://2CH); it is traditionally identified with Palmyra in the Syrian Desert, though the KJV parallel in [1 Kings](book-key://1KI) also reads Tadmor while some textual traditions read [Tamar](location-id://dea608db-f4f5-4e37-b081-7ad46ce90eb6).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Palmyra / Tadmur in Homs Governorate, Syria

locationsMap.name: Tahath
locationsMap.title: Israelite wilderness station between [Makheloth](location-id://35485ec0-45b6-4ec7-8a52-6578a3a292f1) and Tarah
locationsMap.description: Tahath was one of Israel's wilderness journey stations listed in [Numbers 33](chapter-key://NUM 33) between [Makheloth](location-id://35485ec0-45b6-4ec7-8a52-6578a3a292f1) and Tarah. Its precise modern location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Tahpanhes
locationsMap.title: Egyptian frontier city where [Jeremiah](name-id://3a62ca29-870f-4a9b-844b-887f828a0cd5) confronted the remnant
locationsMap.description: Tahpanhes was an Egyptian city in the eastern Nile Delta where Judean refugees went after [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s fall and where [Jeremiah](name-id://3a62ca29-870f-4a9b-844b-887f828a0cd5) enacted a sign of [Nebuchadnezzar](name-id://4f085903-eda2-4736-9163-a6136ad71000)'s coming judgment; it is commonly identified with Daphnae at Tell Defenneh.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell Defenneh / Daphnae in the eastern Nile Delta of Egypt

locationsMap.name: Tamar
locationsMap.title: southern border place in [Ezekiel](name-id://064f216a-deee-458d-9e0c-7e8ec7f38946)'s land vision
locationsMap.description: Tamar marks part of the southern border in [Ezekiel](name-id://064f216a-deee-458d-9e0c-7e8ec7f38946)'s vision of the land. Its exact site is disputed, and the KJV parallel to [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s desert city reads [Tadmor](location-id://2f15cd3b-3d9a-4364-866e-8a0dfebe2d30) rather than Tamar, so the [1 Kings](book-key://1KI) reference has been left to the Tadmor/Palmyra records.

locationsMap.name: Tappuah
locationsMap.title: Canaanite city and border place near [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c) and [Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe)
locationsMap.description: Tappuah was a royal Canaanite city later associated with the [Ephraim](location-id://0e95bdcb-42ff-4f2a-80d7-00c32ac05b2c)-[Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe) border; Joshua distinguishes the city from nearby [En-tappuah](location-id://e4acf710-34a0-4888-ba06-0f6904b383a7), while a separate [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town of the same name is kept as its own variant record.

locationsMap.name: Taralah
locationsMap.title: [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) town listed near [Rekem](location-id://4a070cb3-8391-4285-aefd-6e124d110d21) and [Irpeel](location-id://e688c3bb-8e2f-4979-b3b3-54a17bcb2a4e)
locationsMap.description: Taralah appears once in the allotment of [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef) among towns listed with [Rekem](location-id://4a070cb3-8391-4285-aefd-6e124d110d21), [Irpeel](location-id://e688c3bb-8e2f-4979-b3b3-54a17bcb2a4e), and [Zelah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000239); its precise modern location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Tehaphnehes
locationsMap.title: Ezekiel spelling of the Egyptian city [Tahpanhes](location-id://022dcfd1-4480-4317-bc2e-8f577ddda619)
locationsMap.description: Tehaphnehes is Ezekiel's spelling of [Tahpanhes](location-id://022dcfd1-4480-4317-bc2e-8f577ddda619), the Egyptian eastern Delta city where judgment on [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065) is announced; it is commonly identified with Daphnae at Tell Defenneh.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell Defenneh / Daphnae in the eastern Nile Delta of Egypt

locationsMap.name: Tekoa
locationsMap.title: Judean town near the wilderness south of [Bethlehem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000034)
locationsMap.description: Tekoa was a town of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) southeast of [Bethlehem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000034), known for the wise woman whom [Joab](name-id://12ff519a-1af6-4374-bf58-09dbfb159d43) used, [Rehoboam](name-id://68d5eac0-52b9-4b0b-b484-8c7b5c3b8971)'s fortification program, [Jehoshaphat](name-id://3a573bf3-3bda-458d-b7ac-5b2e4f3205f6)'s wilderness assembly, [Jeremiah](name-id://3a62ca29-870f-4a9b-844b-887f828a0cd5)'s warning trumpet, and [Amos](name-id://9e47ac42-242b-4fcc-9977-9bc195ad5a10)'s home region.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tuqu' / Teqoa southeast of Bethlehem in the West Bank

locationsMap.name: Telabib
locationsMap.title: exilic settlement by the river [Chebar](location-id://83b8059b-8635-453f-98b1-2026a294e6b5) where [Ezekiel](name-id://064f216a-deee-458d-9e0c-7e8ec7f38946) sat
locationsMap.description: Telabib, written Telabib in the KJV, was the settlement by the river [Chebar](location-id://83b8059b-8635-453f-98b1-2026a294e6b5) where [Ezekiel](name-id://064f216a-deee-458d-9e0c-7e8ec7f38946) came to the captives of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and sat astonished seven days. Its exact Babylonian location is uncertain, though it is tied to the Chebar canal region.

locationsMap.name: Telharsa
locationsMap.title: Babylonian settlement of returnees with uncertain genealogy
locationsMap.description: Telharsa, rendered Tel-harsa in [Ezra](book-key://EZR) and Tel-haresha in [Nehemiah](book-key://NEH), was one of the Babylonian places from which returnees came who could not prove their Israelite descent. Its exact location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Telmelah
locationsMap.title: Babylonian settlement named among uncertain returnee origins
locationsMap.description: Telmelah was one of the Babylonian places named with [Telharsa](location-id://0e86d6a2-d791-4485-b99b-a6df10de8a76) and [Cherub](location-id://372bae98-4731-4f99-b3df-77a35c48cbbf) among returnees who could not prove their ancestral house after the exile. Its precise location is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Telaim
locationsMap.title: southern muster place where [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) numbered Israel against Amalek
locationsMap.description: Telaim is named as the place where [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) numbered the people before attacking Amalek. It may be related to [Telem](location-id://a91b54ef-50dc-4e9f-b3bc-c4c329af200d) in southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), but the identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Telassar
locationsMap.title: city of the children of Eden cited in Assyrian taunts
locationsMap.description: Telassar, called Thelasar in the KJV, is named by Assyrian messengers as a place of the children of Eden whose gods failed to deliver them. Its exact Mesopotamian or Syrian location remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Telem
locationsMap.title: southern [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) town possibly related to [Telaim](location-id://6f339f84-10e3-4d33-b9e2-cabcbe85c405)
locationsMap.description: Telem is listed among towns in the far south of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119). It may be related to the muster place [Telaim](location-id://6f339f84-10e3-4d33-b9e2-cabcbe85c405), but its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Tema
locationsMap.title: north Arabian oasis associated with caravans and judgment oracles
locationsMap.description: Tema was a north Arabian oasis and tribal region named in [Job](book-key://JOB) with caravan routes and in prophetic passages with [Dedan](location-id://ed08e1a2-e6c2-4ed4-9609-603535fd949c) and [Arabia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000014); it is identified with the oasis of Tayma in northwestern Saudi Arabia.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tayma oasis in Tabuk Province, Saudi Arabia

locationsMap.name: Teman
locationsMap.title: Edomite district known for wisdom and prophetic judgment
locationsMap.description: Teman was an Edomite region or chief town associated with [Esau](name-id://c4d0e1b7-7cba-49cb-80b6-e5068cfb4e2f)'s descendants, Edomite wisdom, and oracles against [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064). Its exact site is uncertain, though it is usually placed in southern Edom.

locationsMap.name: The Lord Is There
locationsMap.title: prophetic name of [Ezekiel](name-id://064f216a-deee-458d-9e0c-7e8ec7f38946)'s restored city
locationsMap.description: The Lord Is There is the KJV rendering of the name given to the city at the end of [Ezekiel](name-id://064f216a-deee-458d-9e0c-7e8ec7f38946)'s temple and land vision, often transliterated Jehovah-shammah. It names a prophetic restored city rather than a separately identified modern site.

locationsMap.name: The Place of a Skull
locationsMap.title: English phrase for [Golgotha](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000090) in [John](book-key://JHN)
locationsMap.description: The Place of a Skull is John's explanatory phrase for [Golgotha](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000090), the place where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) was crucified outside [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117). Its traditional and proposed exact sites remain debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jerusalem, with the Church of the Holy Sepulchre and Garden Tomb among proposed identifications

locationsMap.name: Thebez
locationsMap.title: city where [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c) was mortally wounded
locationsMap.description: Thebez was a city near [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) that [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c) attacked after taking Shechem; a woman at its tower threw a millstone on him, leading to his death. It is often identified with Tubas, but the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often identified with Tubas in the northern West Bank

locationsMap.name: Thessalonica
locationsMap.title: Macedonian city where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) preached and later addressed a church
locationsMap.description: Thessalonica was the chief city of Roman [Macedonia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000139) on the Via Egnatia; [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) preached there after passing through [Amphipolis](location-id://c9a6278a-643c-431c-922b-c6d416db8497) and [Apollonia](location-id://82b0f8cf-aec7-4d2d-9288-5878477cfad0), and the city became the home of the Thessalonian church.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Thessaloniki, Greece

locationsMap.name: Three Taverns
locationsMap.title: Roman road station south of [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b) where believers met [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)
locationsMap.description: Three Taverns was a stopping place on the Appian Way south of [Rome](location-id://ff427d76-a9e7-4a50-bc2d-61b6b459e87b) where Christians from Rome came to meet [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) as he approached the city under guard.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Near modern Cisterna di Latina on the Appian Way in Italy

locationsMap.name: Thyatira
locationsMap.title: Lydian city named among the seven churches of [Revelation](book-key://REV)
locationsMap.description: Thyatira was a city of Lydia in western Asia Minor, known in [Acts](book-key://ACT) as [Lydia](name-id://8a845768-70bf-4f96-9053-f13e635f3394)'s home city and in [Revelation](book-key://REV) as one of the seven churches addressed by John.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Akhisar in Manisa Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Tiberias
locationsMap.title: Galilean city on the western shore of the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b)
locationsMap.description: Tiberias was a city on the [Sea of Galilee](location-id://44329b87-3c5b-4d27-9fcf-e386f2aebc5b), named for the emperor Tiberius; John's Gospel mentions boats from Tiberias near the place where [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) fed the multitude.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tiberias, Israel

locationsMap.name: Tibhath
locationsMap.title: city of [Hadarezer](name-id://efa8c76a-4d8a-4b15-af7f-079ee3c25957) from which [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) took bronze
locationsMap.description: Tibhath was a city of [Hadarezer](name-id://efa8c76a-4d8a-4b15-af7f-079ee3c25957) or [Hadadezer](name-id://2d9ff281-73b3-4bd8-b94b-b414b234bce7)'s realm from which [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) took much bronze according to Chronicles. Its relation to the parallel names [Betah](location-id://868d4fce-c914-487a-90e8-6dc81785893f) and [Berothai](location-id://e7ead3d6-fa5b-4940-bf66-9cb98999f550) is debated, and its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Timnah
locationsMap.title: [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) hill-country town distinct from lowland [Timnath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000223)
locationsMap.description: Timnah is kept here for the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) hill-country town listed with [Halhul](location-id://3a42aa99-ef7e-463a-a875-da51a48b6ceb), [Bethzur](location-id://f6a8b0c2-5e7d-4f9a-b13c-6d8e0f2a4b5c), and [Gedor](location-id://12785454-38f5-42d6-ba3c-aae15b5174ff) in [Joshua 15](chapter-key://JOS 15). Other Timnah or [Timnath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000223) references connected with [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648), the Judah-[Dan](location-id://dadc79b1-e84f-40e0-ab31-2fa96b6ed4bd) border, and the Philistine lowland are handled in the Timnath record.

locationsMap.name: Timnathheres
locationsMap.title: [Judges](book-key://JDG) spelling of [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s burial city in [Mount Ephraim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000155)
locationsMap.description: Timnathheres, written Timnathheres in the KJV, is the Judges form of [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s burial place in [Mount Ephraim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000155). It is usually treated as the same place as [Timnathserah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000222), with a traditional identification at Kifl Haris.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally Kifl Haris in the central West Bank

locationsMap.name: Timnathserah
locationsMap.title: [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s inheritance and burial city in [Mount Ephraim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000155)
locationsMap.description: Timnathserah, written Timnathserah in the KJV, was the city in [Mount Ephraim](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000155) that Israel gave to [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816) and where he was buried. It is traditionally identified with Kifl Haris, though the exact site remains debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally Kifl Haris in the central West Bank

locationsMap.name: Tiphsah
locationsMap.title: [Euphrates](location-id://0bdad9de-f6dc-4681-8a5a-54526382bc9f) frontier place at the edge of [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s dominion
locationsMap.description: Tiphsah in [1 Kings](book-key://1KI) marks the northern or northeastern limit of [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s dominion beyond the river, commonly compared with the [Euphrates](location-id://0bdad9de-f6dc-4681-8a5a-54526382bc9f) crossing known as Thapsacus. The separate [2 Kings](book-key://2KI) reference near [Tirzah](location-id://62c6ef14-e7bb-4a26-ab86-20f931e735dd) is kept as its own uncertain variant.

locationsMap.name: Tirzah
locationsMap.title: former royal city of the northern kingdom of [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108)
locationsMap.description: Tirzah was a Canaanite royal city later used as a residence and capital by early kings of northern [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108) before [Omri](name-id://a7d80fbc-a063-4d1a-83a0-f1ee3b80d501) built [Samaria](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000196); [Song of Solomon](book-key://SNG) also uses it as an image of beauty.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell el-Farah North in the northern West Bank

locationsMap.name: Tishbe
locationsMap.title: uncertain hometown or district of [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652) the Tishbite
locationsMap.description: Tishbe is associated with [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652), called the Tishbite of the inhabitants of [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089). The exact place is disputed, and the KJV verse may point more to Elijah's origin than to a securely located town.

locationsMap.name: Tob
locationsMap.title: land east of [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) where [Jephthah](name-id://a0e52599-bd88-4cc9-bf3c-5c0127087f95) lived in exile
locationsMap.description: Tob was a land or district east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) where [Jephthah](name-id://a0e52599-bd88-4cc9-bf3c-5c0127087f95) fled before the elders of [Gilead](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000089) called him back; men of Tob also appear among allies hired by the Ammonites against [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c). Its precise limits are uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Tochen
locationsMap.title: Simeonite town named in the Chronicler's settlement list
locationsMap.description: Tochen is listed once among towns associated with Simeonite settlement in the days before [Hezekiah](name-id://9854b257-50aa-4284-8f7b-84351d2b226f). Its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Tolad
locationsMap.title: Simeonite town and shortened form of [Eltolad](location-id://b35aaeb9-e206-4fe1-82a6-31b7886f31e0)
locationsMap.description: Tolad is listed among Simeonite towns in Chronicles and is usually treated as the same place as [Eltolad](location-id://b35aaeb9-e206-4fe1-82a6-31b7886f31e0) from Joshua's [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081) lists. Its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Tophel
locationsMap.title: place named in [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73)' opening setting east of [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987)
locationsMap.description: Tophel appears in [Deuteronomy](book-key://DEU)'s opening location formula with [Paran](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000177), [Laban](location-id://fceb856c-541d-44ed-95e1-b8bba3e4427a), [Hazeroth](location-id://3445bd29-bbd4-4173-81af-0856a73129ec), and [Dizahab](location-id://712b4d1b-6ffc-42a4-9930-08314adc53a7), on the [Arabah](location-id://bfd23a68-b7bd-4bd0-99fe-d1d16a0b2a71) side of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987). Its precise identification remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Topheth
locationsMap.title: cultic site in the [Valley of Hinnom](location-id://a1d1ba7a-4860-43ea-8b07-7ed384708492) condemned by the prophets
locationsMap.description: Topheth was the place in the [Valley of the Son of Hinnom](location-id://f69cd294-aafb-43fe-b1e9-d31041bc1dcb) where child sacrifice was practiced and later defiled by [Josiah](name-id://60cb7338-d759-439a-8ad6-ecccf0f9d30a); [Jeremiah](name-id://3a62ca29-870f-4a9b-844b-887f828a0cd5) prophesied that it would become the valley of slaughter.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Valley of Hinnom south and west of Jerusalem's Old City

locationsMap.name: Tower of Shechem
locationsMap.title: stronghold at [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) burned by [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c)
locationsMap.description: The Tower of Shechem was a fortified stronghold connected with [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) whose people took refuge in the hold of the house of Berith before [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c) burned it.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Shechem area near Tell Balata, exact tower location unknown

locationsMap.name: Troas
locationsMap.title: Aegean port of northwest Asia Minor visited by [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)
locationsMap.description: Troas, the region and port city of Alexandria Troas, was where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223) received the Macedonian vision, embarked for [Macedonia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000139), spent a week on his return journey, and later left a cloak with [Carpus](name-id://1b60f150-c1db-42d9-a76c-0867de5c04ee).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Alexandria Troas near Dalyan in Çanakkale Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Tubal
locationsMap.title: northern nation or region often paired with [Meshech](location-id://0ebbc823-a519-4e26-942a-35f08b94a977)
locationsMap.description: Tubal is a biblical people or region named with [Javan](location-id://22543209-92c0-46db-8042-356facffbb19) and [Meshech](location-id://0ebbc823-a519-4e26-942a-35f08b94a977) in prophetic lists of distant nations and traders. Its precise historical and geographic identification is debated, often being associated with Anatolia or the wider Caucasus-Anatolian north.

locationsMap.name: Trogyllium
locationsMap.title: anchorage on the Aegean coast where [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s ship tarried
locationsMap.description: Trogyllium is the promontory in which Mount Mycale terminates on the coast of Asia Minor, running out into the sea opposite the island of [Samos](location-id://71fa3174-3a52-434b-a200-b589ed26c552) across a channel less than a mile wide and lying about midway between [Ephesus](location-id://d0d9344d-8013-4dee-a125-bf3ca8d6810f) and [Miletus](location-id://2a3d81b9-2d80-47f4-ac15-1aae05193c1a). The KJV records that [Paul](name-id://f5a4422f-ceeb-4400-a563-ea126def1223)'s company, having sailed over against [Chios](location-id://dd862927-34e4-4cba-9f93-c65e47701bc7) and arrived at Samos, tarried at Trogyllium and came the next day to Miletus ([Acts 20:15](verse-key://ACT 20:15)) as the apostle hastened toward [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) for the day of Pentecost ([Acts 20:16](verse-key://ACT 20:16)). The clause naming the anchorage is absent from several early manuscripts and is omitted by many modern versions, so the stop is attested in the KJV textual tradition rather than in all witnesses.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Promontory at the western end of Mount Mycale, the Dilek Peninsula in Aydin Province, Turkey

locationsMap.name: Togarmah
locationsMap.title: house of [Togarmah](name-id://c38c2f4d-6efb-4282-aaf9-359c56142729), a northern land known for horses and mules
locationsMap.description: The KJV names this land only in the phrase the house of [Togarmah](name-id://c38c2f4d-6efb-4282-aaf9-359c56142729), the far northern land named in [Ezekiel](book-key://EZK) for its trade in horses and mules and later as part of [Gog](name-id://6f1c4382-5c28-4ac9-9866-6a570ec5e97b)'s confederation; it is usually associated with ancient Tegarama in Anatolia.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually associated with ancient Tegarama or Til-garimmu in east-central Turkey or the surrounding Anatolian highlands

locationsMap.name: Ur
locationsMap.title: ancient Mesopotamian city traditionally identified with Ur of the [Chaldees](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000051)
locationsMap.description: Ur was a major Sumerian city in southern [Mesopotamia](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000151); it is traditionally identified with the Ur of the [Chaldees](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000051) from which God called [Abram](name-id://bf42c58c-045a-4131-b8ee-55e7c707040a), though other identifications have been proposed.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tell el-Muqayyar in Dhi Qar Governorate, Iraq, traditionally identified with biblical Ur of the Chaldees

locationsMap.name: Ulai
locationsMap.title: river or canal near Susa in [Daniel](name-id://2694d04f-5604-41a4-a5f6-31f3a7ef2d99)'s vision
locationsMap.description: Ulai was the river or canal in [Elam](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000067) near Shushan where [Daniel](name-id://2694d04f-5604-41a4-a5f6-31f3a7ef2d99) saw the vision of the ram and goat; it is usually connected with the Eulaeus and the Kerkhah system near Susa.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: The Kerkhah/Eulaeus river system near Susa in Khuzestan, Iran

locationsMap.name: Ummah
locationsMap.title: uncertain city allotted to [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797)
locationsMap.description: Ummah was listed among the cities of [Asher](name-id://7999131a-6b35-4c3c-96f5-7f71d4d7c797) in [Joshua 19:30](verse-key://JOS 19:30); some scholars conjecturally emend the name to Acco, but no secure identification of the Masoretic place-name is known.

locationsMap.name: Uphaz
locationsMap.title: uncertain gold-bearing region named in [Jeremiah](book-key://JER) and [Daniel](book-key://DAN)
locationsMap.description: Uphaz is named in connection with fine gold in [Jeremiah](book-key://JER) and [Daniel](book-key://DAN), but its location is otherwise unknown and some scholars regard the reading as a variant or corruption of [Ophir](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000173).

locationsMap.name: Uz
locationsMap.title: uncertain biblical land associated with [Job](name-id://396a0c53-5fe3-44f1-b74c-a0f509d5df1a) and [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064)
locationsMap.description: Uz was the land in which [Job](name-id://396a0c53-5fe3-44f1-b74c-a0f509d5df1a) lived and is also named in prophetic texts; its location has been variously placed in [Aram](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000015), [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064), or the northeastern desert lands, and the evidence does not support a single secure identification.

locationsMap.name: Uzza
locationsMap.title: burial garden in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) for [Manasseh](name-id://cb3e0962-0140-4360-8730-0cc3c09a21da) and [Amon](name-id://d46db4a4-b3c7-491c-af01-87a8b0fffb0e)
locationsMap.description: Uzza in this location record is the garden of Uzza, a burial place connected with the royal house in [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) where [Manasseh](name-id://cb3e0962-0140-4360-8730-0cc3c09a21da) and [Amon](name-id://d46db4a4-b3c7-491c-af01-87a8b0fffb0e) were buried; its exact site is not known.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: A royal burial garden in Jerusalem, exact site unknown

locationsMap.name: Uzzensherah
locationsMap.title: unidentified town associated with [Sheerah](name-id://8143b8ae-e067-4331-86f1-6fc2d8ac277d)
locationsMap.description: Uzzensherah is named in [1 Chronicles 7:24](verse-key://1CH 7:24) as a town built by [Sheerah](name-id://8143b8ae-e067-4331-86f1-6fc2d8ac277d) along with Lower and Upper Bethhoron, but no satisfactory modern identification has been proposed.

locationsMap.name: Valley Gate
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) gate opening toward the western valley
locationsMap.description: The Valley Gate was a [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) gate repaired by [Nehemiah](name-id://46c4c07f-dde8-4466-a278-6e40a8d3e7f1) and associated with the wall section toward the valley; [Uzziah](name-id://a463bd46-3fbc-418b-9809-a0f157b942ea) also built towers at this gate, though its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Achor
locationsMap.title: valley of [Achan](name-id://e2c34261-d80e-4050-a2df-89e81d8e4655)'s judgment near [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Achor was the place where [Achan](name-id://e2c34261-d80e-4050-a2df-89e81d8e4655) was judged after [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116) and later became a boundary landmark of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and a prophetic image of restored hope.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Baca
locationsMap.title: pilgrim valley of weeping in [Psalm 84](chapter-key://PSA 84)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Baca is named in [Psalm 84](chapter-key://PSA 84) as a valley made into a well by pilgrims going up to [Zion](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000245); whether it denotes a specific valley or a poetic valley of weeping is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Elah
locationsMap.title: Shephelah valley where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) fought [Goliath](name-id://69bffebc-acde-4cc2-83a4-cc0533c60424)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Elah was the [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) lowland valley where the Philistines camped between Shochoh and [Azekah](location-id://f345fc22-3282-4ad7-9817-3e2b38026e41) and [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) defeated [Goliath](name-id://69bffebc-acde-4cc2-83a4-cc0533c60424).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Elah Valley / Wadi es-Sunt in the Shephelah of Israel

locationsMap.name: Valley of Eshcol
locationsMap.title: [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) valley where the spies cut grapes
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Eshcol was the place where the spies cut the cluster of grapes before returning from [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045), and it is associated with the [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103) region though its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Gerar
locationsMap.title: wadi of [Gerar](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000086) where [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf) dwelt
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Gerar was the wadi or valley where [Isaac](name-id://a5b2f874-2008-4b28-9698-6357fe71c3bf) dwelt after leaving [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c) and where his servants dug wells in the [Gerar](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000086) region.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with Nahal Gerar / Wadi esh-Shari'a near Tell Haror

locationsMap.name: Valley of Gibeon
locationsMap.title: valley near [Gibeon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000088) recalled in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Gibeon is named in [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b)'s comparison of the LORD's strange work with the ancient victory near [Gibeon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000088).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Area around Gibeon / el-Jib north of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Valley of Hinnom
locationsMap.title: [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) valley later associated with Gehenna
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Hinnom lay by [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s boundary and later became associated with [Tophet](location-id://1ea44150-016b-40db-b17e-609501d56075) and Gehenna imagery; it is the same valley named more fully as the [valley of the son of Hinnom](location-id://f69cd294-aafb-43fe-b1e9-d31041bc1dcb).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Wadi er-Rababi / Ge Hinnom south and west of Jerusalem's Old City

locationsMap.name: Valley of Jehoshaphat
locationsMap.title: [Joel](name-id://9051c42b-3a52-4cf3-b325-793dc3758188)'s valley of divine judgment
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Jehoshaphat is the place in [Joel](book-key://JOL) where the nations are gathered for judgment; later tradition identifies it with the [Kidron](location-id://1b95372c-c14a-4b30-a247-cad60acefe7c) Valley, but the prophetic location is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally identified with the Kidron Valley east of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Valley of Jericho
locationsMap.title: [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) plain around [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Jericho is the plain of the valley of [Jericho](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000116), the city of palm trees, visible from [Pisgah](location-id://2f1847ff-51c6-41d4-a74b-a9a1075e7cb0) in [Moses](name-id://fff825ad-31e8-4843-a7dc-cd82e9878d73)' view of the land.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jordan Valley plain around Jericho

locationsMap.name: Valley of Jezreel
locationsMap.title: northern valley where armies gathered near [Jezreel](location-id://01fb54a8-39da-4de4-9ba9-6c91d7efff5b)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Jezreel was the broad northern valley associated with [Manasseh](name-id://6d826bc2-ac80-4c27-af89-258a50f37dfe)'s territory, [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s conflict with [Midian](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000152), and [Hosea](name-id://685d5d0f-a306-419e-8c7d-b6bf1b1db7a0)'s sign of judgment on [Jehu](name-id://f3fdd9d6-b20c-4fd4-80a5-63258fba4c9f)'s house.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jezreel Valley in northern Israel

locationsMap.name: Valley of Lebanon
locationsMap.title: northern valley under [Mount Hermon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000156)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Lebanon was the northern valley under [Mount Hermon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000156) near [Baal-gad](location-id://b140e0e2-3111-4244-b0b4-3d8580d0e980) that marked the reach of [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s conquests; it is often associated with the [Lebanon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000133) or Beqaa region, but the exact identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Mizpeh
locationsMap.title: northern valley reached after [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s pursuit
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Mizpeh was an eastern valley reached in [Joshua](name-id://28e270de-d886-42b6-918b-665be906a816)'s pursuit of the northern coalition after the battle at the waters of [Merom](location-id://875481d4-2003-46a2-b1de-ba1e43d6654b); its exact location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Rephaim
locationsMap.title: broad valley southwest of [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Rephaim was a valley by [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s boundary where the Philistines spread themselves against [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) and where [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b) pictures gleaning after harvest.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Emek Refa'im / Rephaim Valley southwest of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Valley of Salt
locationsMap.title: battle valley near [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064) and the Dead Sea
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Salt was the battlefield where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s men and later [Amaziah](name-id://ec8132b1-83a8-4852-a89e-c02e67fbf9b6) defeated [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064); it is commonly sought in the salt flats south of the Dead Sea, though the exact site is uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Often associated with the salt flats south of the Dead Sea

locationsMap.name: Valley of Shaveh
locationsMap.title: King's dale where [Abram](name-id://bf42c58c-045a-4131-b8ee-55e7c707040a) met [Melchizedek](name-id://827a6b81-3dff-43a9-b386-5f27643f19bd)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Shaveh, also called the king's dale, was where the king of [Sodom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000212) and [Melchizedek](name-id://827a6b81-3dff-43a9-b386-5f27643f19bd) met [Abram](name-id://bf42c58c-045a-4131-b8ee-55e7c707040a) after Abram's victory; its location near [Salem](location-id://0afc514e-e996-48ea-aa1c-bd358edfdb6c) or [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Shittim
locationsMap.title: [Joel](name-id://9051c42b-3a52-4cf3-b325-793dc3758188)'s future valley watered from the LORD's house
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Shittim is named in [Joel](name-id://9051c42b-3a52-4cf3-b325-793dc3758188)'s oracle as a valley watered by a fountain from the house of the LORD; whether it refers to the [Shittim](location-id://6bdcf892-9c79-4cce-b479-66ff40e31758) area east of [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) or a symbolic acacia valley is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Slaughter
locationsMap.title: judgment name for the [valley of Hinnom](location-id://a1d1ba7a-4860-43ea-8b07-7ed384708492)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Slaughter is [Jeremiah](name-id://3a62ca29-870f-4a9b-844b-887f828a0cd5)'s judgment name for [Tophet](location-id://1ea44150-016b-40db-b17e-609501d56075) and the [valley of the son of Hinnom](location-id://f69cd294-aafb-43fe-b1e9-d31041bc1dcb), where [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s idolatrous rites would become a place of death.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Valley of Hinnom / Ge Hinnom south and west of Jerusalem's Old City

locationsMap.name: Valley of Sorek
locationsMap.title: valley where [Delilah](name-id://33a2e44d-45d6-4f0e-b566-59f10933d96d) lived near Philistine territory
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Sorek was the valley where [Delilah](name-id://33a2e44d-45d6-4f0e-b566-59f10933d96d) lived in the [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648) narrative, near the border country between Israelite and Philistine territory.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Nahal Sorek / Wadi Surar west of Jerusalem

locationsMap.name: Valley of Succoth
locationsMap.title: valley or plain of Succoth in the [Psalms](book-key://PSA)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Succoth is the lowland associated with Succoth in the Jordan Valley and is named in [Psalm 108](chapter-key://PSA 108) as territory measured out by God.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jordan Valley near the traditional Succoth area east of the Jordan

locationsMap.name: Valley of Zeboim
locationsMap.title: ravine on a Philistine raiding route toward the wilderness
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Zeboim was on one of the routes taken by Philistine spoilers from [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd) toward the wilderness, but its precise identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Valley of Zephathah
locationsMap.title: valley near [Mareshah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000146) where [Asa](name-id://f5d139c3-aaad-4422-87a8-6b31e0fbc485) met [Zerah](name-id://5a52b3ea-ca2b-4221-8273-db2b558771af)
locationsMap.description: The Valley of Zephathah at [Mareshah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000146) was the battlefield where [Asa](name-id://f5d139c3-aaad-4422-87a8-6b31e0fbc485) of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) went out against [Zerah](name-id://5a52b3ea-ca2b-4221-8273-db2b558771af) the Ethiopian; its exact valley is uncertain though Mareshah is identified.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Near Tel Maresha in the Shephelah of Israel

locationsMap.name: Valley of the Son of Hinnom
locationsMap.title: full KJV name for [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s Hinnom valley
locationsMap.description: The Valley of the Son of Hinnom was a boundary valley beside [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) and the site of [Tophet](location-id://1ea44150-016b-40db-b17e-609501d56075), condemned for child sacrifice and later associated with judgment imagery.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Valley of Hinnom / Ge Hinnom south and west of Jerusalem's Old City

locationsMap.name: Washer's Field
locationsMap.title: KJV Fuller's Field near [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s upper pool
locationsMap.description: Washer's Field is the field called the fuller's field in the KJV, located by the highway and the conduit of the upper pool outside [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117); [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b) met [Ahaz](name-id://6c49dd1b-6675-4393-9df4-46e7ab71be60) there, and [Rabshakeh](name-id://bbf7cb8f-c367-432c-9d40-b377bdd1da86) later stood there during [Sennacherib](name-id://ba936e10-4238-4f16-bed8-eb31811cc5e5)'s campaign.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Approximate western or southwestern approach to ancient Jerusalem near the upper pool and Valley of Hinnom

locationsMap.name: Water Gate
locationsMap.title: eastern [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) gate by [Ophel](location-id://df3d1ba2-d20e-416a-baaa-d256ea292b7e) and the public square
locationsMap.description: The Water Gate was a [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117) gate toward the east, near [Ophel](location-id://df3d1ba2-d20e-416a-baaa-d256ea292b7e) and the projecting tower, with a public street or square before it where [Ezra](name-id://1608b225-d488-4910-a6d6-5ac8db7c90cd) read the law and where the dedication procession passed from the [Fountain Gate](location-id://f3c892b9-92d5-4ff9-a176-52202a7286f4) toward the east.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Approximate eastern sector of ancient Jerusalem near Ophel and the City of David

locationsMap.name: Way of Holiness
locationsMap.title: prophetic highway called the way of holiness in [Isaiah](book-key://ISA)
locationsMap.description: The Way of Holiness is [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b)'s prophetic highway for the redeemed, named in the KJV as the way of holiness; it is a road image in the restoration oracle rather than a securely identifiable physical route.

locationsMap.name: Wildgoats' Rocks
locationsMap.title: rocky [Engedi](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000070) cliffs where [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) searched for [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)
locationsMap.description: Wildgoats' Rocks, called the rocks of the wild goats in the KJV, describes the rocky cliffs and caves in the wilderness of [Engedi](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000070) where [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) went to seek [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) and his men.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Cliffs and caves around Ein Gedi on the western shore of the Dead Sea in Israel

locationsMap.name: Wood of Ephraim
locationsMap.title: forest east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) where [Absalom](name-id://0e94a17b-69b1-4148-b7de-72eab8eea4cc) died in battle
locationsMap.description: The wood of Ephraim was the forest where the battle between the forces of [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) and [Absalom](name-id://0e94a17b-69b1-4148-b7de-72eab8eea4cc) was fought; Absalom was caught in an oak there and slain, and the wood is said to have devoured more people than the sword that day.

locationsMap.name: Yiron
locationsMap.title: [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) city called Iron in the KJV
locationsMap.description: Yiron is the Hebrew form behind the KJV Iron, a city listed in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s inheritance with [Horem](location-id://e7bbda61-7b8d-464a-bc06-86db9d4a31ed), [Bethanath](location-id://baf670bc-6ce3-47e6-8c5e-67fded0d7e75), and [Bethshemesh](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000037) in [Joshua 19:38](verse-key://JOS 19:38); it is commonly identified with Yaroun in southern Lebanon.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Yaroun, Lebanon

locationsMap.name: Zanoah of the Shephelah
locationsMap.title: Judahite lowland town rebuilt in [Nehemiah](name-id://46c4c07f-dde8-4466-a278-6e40a8d3e7f1)'s day
locationsMap.description: Zanoah of the Shephelah was a town in the lowland district of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119), later associated with returnees who repaired [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)'s [Valley Gate](location-id://a1142449-1aa9-4dcd-ae43-388e5e0925d1) and resettled towns in Judah; it is commonly identified with Khirbet Zanu near the modern moshav Zanoah.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Khirbet Zanu / Zanoah near Beit Shemesh, Israel

locationsMap.name: Zanoah of the hill country
locationsMap.title: Judahite hill-country town listed near [Jattir](location-id://bb79e534-b816-4afc-89d6-7dacf78ea24d) and Jezreel
locationsMap.description: Zanoah of the hill country was a separate Judahite town in Joshua's hill-country list, distinct from the lowland Zanoah; Khirbet Zanuta in the southern [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103) hills has been proposed, but the identification remains uncertain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly Khirbet Zanuta in the southern Hebron hills

locationsMap.name: Zelah
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite town associated with [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)'s family tomb
locationsMap.description: Zelah was a town in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s allotment and the place where [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) and [Jonathan](name-id://0654ad89-fc99-484a-8771-b277e9225953)'s bones were buried in the sepulchre of [Kish](name-id://f856b172-6576-409a-87c3-75bf389f60ec); its exact site is not securely identified.

locationsMap.name: Zelzah
locationsMap.title: landmark by [Rachel](name-id://84d78b89-880b-4333-a822-9c8449f77fd0)'s sepulchre on [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s border
locationsMap.description: Zelzah was the landmark named in [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812)'s sign to [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb), beside [Rachel](name-id://84d78b89-880b-4333-a822-9c8449f77fd0)'s sepulchre in the border of [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef); the exact spot is uncertain and is tied to the debated ancient location of Rachel's tomb.

locationsMap.name: Zemaraim
locationsMap.title: town in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s allotment near [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032) and Avim
locationsMap.description: Zemaraim was a town listed in [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s allotment with [Bethel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032), Avim, and [Ophrah](location-id://8eb0b645-ab96-48af-8a4c-89960a0c43a3); its exact site is uncertain and should be distinguished from the mount of the same name in [Ephraim](name-id://4ad1140c-2b95-4513-bd55-ed594805df5f).

locationsMap.name: Zorah
locationsMap.title: Danite and Judahite town overlooking the [Sorek](location-id://c1d3e5f7-2b4a-4c6d-8e9f-3a5b7c9d1e2f) valley
locationsMap.description: Zorah was a town on the borderland of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Dan](name-id://3de74a0e-f0c6-4087-b902-c30a6d218cff), known as [Samson](name-id://cc81f251-0c5e-452d-9ae8-5b96db780648)'s home region and later fortified by [Rehoboam](name-id://68d5eac0-52b9-4b0b-b484-8c7b5c3b8971); it is commonly identified with Tel Tzora near modern Tzora in Israel.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tel Tzora near modern Tzora, Israel

locationsMap.name: Zion
locationsMap.title: [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s fortress and poetic name for [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117)
locationsMap.description: Zion first names the Jebusite stronghold captured by [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c), then broadens in biblical usage to [Jerusalem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000117), the temple hill, and the covenant community associated with the city.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Jerusalem, especially the City of David and temple/Jerusalem traditions later associated with Mount Zion

locationsMap.name: Zobah
locationsMap.title: Aramean kingdom or region north of [Israel](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000108)
locationsMap.description: Zobah was an Aramean kingdom or region whose kings fought [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb), [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c), and David's commanders; biblical notices associate it with [Hadadezer](name-id://2d9ff281-73b3-4bd8-b94b-b414b234bce7), [Damascus](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000061), [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62), and the wider Syrian-Aramean sphere, but its exact extent is debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Region in Syria, often placed north or northeast of Damascus toward Hamath

locationsMap.name: Zaanannim
locationsMap.title: oak or plain near [Kedesh](location-id://1f447b5c-761c-4a77-bd5c-309916278396) in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)
locationsMap.description: Zaanannim was the oak or plain by [Kedesh](location-id://1f447b5c-761c-4a77-bd5c-309916278396) where [Heber](name-id://385cbe63-d322-4256-9a78-f5cb2bf43102) the Kenite pitched his tent; it is connected with [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s northern border and [Deborah](name-id://3fec4843-1e2e-4781-a8e7-f7aa0d955f5e)'s battle narrative, but its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zenan
locationsMap.title: Judahite town also named in Micah's oracle
locationsMap.description: Zenan was a town in the lowland list of [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119); Micah's Zaanan is commonly treated as the same or a closely related form in his wordplay on towns of the Shephelah, so the identification remains somewhat uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zair
locationsMap.title: place on [Joram](name-id://f4c9db4d-bedc-4314-8821-69b001fa4620)'s Edomite campaign route
locationsMap.description: Zair is named only in the KJV account of [Joram](name-id://f4c9db4d-bedc-4314-8821-69b001fa4620)'s campaign against [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064); many interpreters suspect it may be a textual or place-name variant connected with [Seir](location-id://3fc9393f-3978-40df-9a42-b7bc33401f98), so no secure modern site can be assigned.

locationsMap.name: Zalmon
locationsMap.title: wooded mountain associated with [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201) and [Psalm 68](chapter-key://PSA 68)
locationsMap.description: Zalmon was the mountain from which [Abimelech](name-id://eba375fa-1ab3-473b-85e6-f85f0771669c) cut branches during his attack on [Shechem](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000201); [Psalm 68](chapter-key://PSA 68) uses the related KJV form Salmon in a poetic comparison, and the exact mountain identification remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zalmonah
locationsMap.title: wilderness encampment after [Mount Hor](location-id://1068536f-2890-4ffd-9e99-38bd48b5c857)
locationsMap.description: Zalmonah was an Israelite encampment in the wilderness itinerary after [Mount Hor](location-id://1068536f-2890-4ffd-9e99-38bd48b5c857) and before [Punon](location-id://b6fb6c58-a2f1-4844-bdac-b536a8a37044), probably somewhere along the route near [Edom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000064), but its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Zaphon
locationsMap.title: Gadite town in the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) valley allotment
locationsMap.description: Zaphon was a town in [Gad](name-id://0b987f5d-4e64-4b73-a3e2-7f6b47dd7f46)'s inheritance, listed with [Succoth](location-id://f577cd82-77ac-4216-8c7d-86b5dd1bb0b3) and the rest of the kingdom of [Sihon](name-id://7aefa340-c02e-4e80-9ce5-24d4215f6341) in the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) valley; its precise site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zarephath
locationsMap.title: Phoenician coastal town between [Tyre](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000226) and [Sidon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000208)
locationsMap.description: Zarephath was the Phoenician town near [Sidon](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000208) where [Elijah](name-id://f8f9a290-0e18-4c0f-8f4c-bb8201e8c652) stayed with the widow, later recalled by [Jesus](name-id://354b61f9-94df-4810-9b87-065b029810ab) in [Luke](book-key://LUK); it is identified with ancient Sarepta at Sarafand on the Lebanese coast.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Sarafand, Lebanon

locationsMap.name: Zarethan
locationsMap.title: [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) valley place also rendered Zaretan, Zarthan, and Zeredathah
locationsMap.description: Zarethan was a place in the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) valley near [Adam](location-id://53580466-6123-4acf-8ac5-5357a2e6a567) and [Succoth](location-id://f577cd82-77ac-4216-8c7d-86b5dd1bb0b3), associated with Israel's Jordan crossing and with the clay ground where [Solomon](name-id://509b7c2f-b8bf-4a4d-a393-550a7a4b259f)'s bronze vessels were cast; the related KJV forms Zaretan, Zartanah, Zarthan, and Zeredathah likely point to the same area, whose exact site remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zeboiim
locationsMap.title: city of the plain destroyed with [Sodom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000212) and [Gomorrah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000091)
locationsMap.description: Zeboiim was one of the cities of the plain grouped with [Sodom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000212), [Gomorrah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000091), [Admah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003), and [Bela](location-id://6684b9dd-e756-4c52-bace-16acfd1cb1d6)/[Zoar](location-id://5d01ba7a-9112-460b-aea8-d80ada45bdc0); its location near the Dead Sea remains uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zeboim
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite town resettled after the exile
locationsMap.description: Zeboim was a Benjaminite town listed with [Hadid](location-id://a07fe9de-9b82-4d64-b173-cfcbd396b3f3) and [Neballat](location-id://aa32abb1-84e4-40f0-a1fc-f1f1c1aebb88) among settlements occupied after the exile; it is distinct from the destroyed city of [Zeboiim](location-id://64ca2dba-3916-4ccb-b5fe-7cea31cd2590) and from the valley of Zeboim.

locationsMap.name: Zeboim Valley
locationsMap.title: Benjaminite valley on a Philistine raiding route
locationsMap.description: The valley of Zeboim was one of the directions taken by Philistine spoilers from [Michmash](location-id://ee19b0f3-9647-4ed1-9f48-d9bef91d04fd) in [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb)'s day, toward the wilderness on [Benjamin](location-id://80f2867e-4e7c-43b6-aa11-7fd42550d4ef)'s eastern side; the exact valley is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zedad
locationsMap.title: northern boundary point of the promised land
locationsMap.description: Zedad was a landmark on the northern boundary line described in [Numbers](book-key://NUM) and [Ezekiel](book-key://EZK), after the entrance of [Hamath](location-id://e88700f4-7b74-49f1-bf22-d4a4a6992b62); it is commonly connected with Sadad in [Syria](location-id://f4fe75e3-4f92-4642-bf57-3d6a59931322), though the boundary route is still debated.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually identified with Sadad, Syria

locationsMap.name: Zephath
locationsMap.title: Canaanite city later called [Hormah](location-id://b9e20e05-0a77-4056-84c9-260cbdfe75f0)
locationsMap.description: Zephath was a Canaanite city attacked by [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081) and then renamed [Hormah](location-id://b9e20e05-0a77-4056-84c9-260cbdfe75f0); its precise site in the southern hill country or Negev border region is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zered
locationsMap.title: brook crossed by Israel near the end of the wilderness years
locationsMap.description: Zered was the brook or wadi Israel crossed after leaving Ije-abarim, marking a stage near the end of the wilderness generation; it is commonly identified with Wadi al-Hasa, though the precise crossing point is unknown.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually identified with Wadi al-Hasa in Jordan

locationsMap.name: Zereda
locationsMap.title: Ephraimite home town of [Jeroboam](name-id://44442ff1-d137-4b0c-b117-4ccacc9df7f1)
