locationsMap.description: Zereda was the Ephraimite town associated with [Nebat](name-id://93b79192-6cde-4207-bad3-f9f756750082) and his son [Jeroboam](name-id://44442ff1-d137-4b0c-b117-4ccacc9df7f1); it is separate from the Jordan-valley [Zarethan](location-id://4a49e23c-67ec-494f-96bf-f421751af5c2)/Zeredathah group, and its exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zererath
locationsMap.title: place near [Beth-shittah](location-id://2692c7f7-a110-434a-bd76-a9fcf77e901b) in [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s pursuit route
locationsMap.description: Zererath was on the route by which the Midianite host fled from [Gideon](name-id://c639ae62-acde-4142-a3f5-fd40204fc455)'s men, near [Beth-shittah](location-id://2692c7f7-a110-434a-bd76-a9fcf77e901b) and toward [Abel-meholah](location-id://d655b227-bc54-4c54-a3d9-a78f621a925d) and [Tabbath](location-id://ba9b10c2-b832-4c35-8ed6-c6ea44fb71f2); its exact identification is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zarethshahar
locationsMap.title: Reubenite town on a height by the valley
locationsMap.description: Zarethshahar was a town in [Reuben](name-id://93b5d553-bee9-4897-a61d-2a5878e1c10b)'s allotment, described as on the mount of the valley; it was east of the [Jordan](location-id://ac7e67b8-98a6-49fa-a8fd-6437b333b987) in the Moabite plateau region, but the exact site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zer
locationsMap.title: fortified city in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s allotment
locationsMap.description: Zer was one of the fenced cities listed in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s inheritance with [Ziddim](location-id://8fe4be71-278d-45f0-96f0-40397c5ddbaf), [Hammath](location-id://15138706-7da3-4893-8388-42f6a8876504), [Rakkath](location-id://92898e6d-f499-40e5-ab46-914a3851a411), and [Chinnereth](location-id://d4a473b2-abb9-4856-bebe-fb0294b0e071); its exact location is not known.

locationsMap.name: Ziddim
locationsMap.title: fortified city in [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a) near [Hammath](location-id://15138706-7da3-4893-8388-42f6a8876504) and [Chinnereth](location-id://d4a473b2-abb9-4856-bebe-fb0294b0e071)
locationsMap.description: Ziddim was one of [Naphtali](name-id://e8c79c45-33b0-4b1e-9265-368c54b9604a)'s fortified cities, named with [Zer](location-id://024fa987-1f8e-42b8-8a37-a0e516b6c6dd), [Hammath](location-id://15138706-7da3-4893-8388-42f6a8876504), [Rakkath](location-id://92898e6d-f499-40e5-ab46-914a3851a411), and [Chinnereth](location-id://d4a473b2-abb9-4856-bebe-fb0294b0e071); its precise site is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Ziklag
locationsMap.title: Philistine border town given to [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)
locationsMap.description: Ziklag was a town assigned to [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) and [Simeon](name-id://8023a792-fa1b-4465-89b5-09f437ac5081), later held by [Achish](name-id://cdba8edc-48d4-4a2c-af2a-138d3a881b0a) of [Gath](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000082) and given to [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c); many modern sites have been proposed, including Tel Halif, Tel Sera, Tell el-Farah South, and Khirbet al-Ra'i, so no single identification is secure.

locationsMap.name: Zimri
locationsMap.title: uncertain kingdom or people group named among distant nations
locationsMap.description: Zimri appears in [Jeremiah](book-key://JER) among kingdoms that must drink the cup of judgment; whether it names a land, people, or textual form of another nation is uncertain, so no modern location can be assigned.

locationsMap.name: Zin
locationsMap.title: southern wilderness around [Kadesh](location-id://501d3b61-a4e6-4e1e-82b1-f8799fb77131) on [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s border
locationsMap.description: Zin was the wilderness region associated with [Kadesh](location-id://501d3b61-a4e6-4e1e-82b1-f8799fb77131), [Meribah-kadesh](location-id://ede02011-b03d-4721-9ea9-0e5d376a9a55), and the southern boundary of [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) and [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119); it is generally placed in the Negev-Arabah borderlands south of Judah.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Wilderness of Zin in the Negev south of Judah, often associated with the Kadesh Barnea region

locationsMap.name: Zior
locationsMap.title: Judahite hill-country town near [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103)
locationsMap.description: Zior was a town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s hill-country list, near [Halhul](location-id://3a42aa99-ef7e-463a-a875-da51a48b6ceb) and [Maon](location-id://5dc48c50-612b-40c8-87f0-9948dab2dc29); it is often associated with Sa'ir northeast of [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103), though the identification is not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Possibly Sa'ir northeast of Hebron

locationsMap.name: Ziph of the hill country
locationsMap.title: Judahite hill-country town near [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s wilderness refuge
locationsMap.description: Ziph of the hill country was a Judahite town near [Maon](location-id://5dc48c50-612b-40c8-87f0-9948dab2dc29) and Carmel, fortified by [Rehoboam](name-id://68d5eac0-52b9-4b0b-b484-8c7b5c3b8971) and associated with the wilderness where [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c) hid from [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb); it is usually identified with Tell Zif southeast of [Hebron](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000103).
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Usually identified with Tell Zif southeast of Hebron

locationsMap.name: Ziph of the Negeb
locationsMap.title: southern Judahite town in the Negeb district
locationsMap.description: Ziph of the Negeb was a separate town in [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119)'s southern list with [Telem](location-id://a91b54ef-50dc-4e9f-b3bc-c4c329af200d) and [Bealoth](location-id://411f8b7a-8f8c-4d57-91c0-6ae3e249a163), distinct from the better-known hill-country Ziph near [David](name-id://0e06ff0e-0ca5-4f9f-9a3b-874f91497f7c)'s wilderness refuge; its exact site is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Ziphron
locationsMap.title: northern boundary point before [Hazar-enan](location-id://e28354a3-33d9-41c9-b160-e91406c183cf)
locationsMap.description: Ziphron was a point on the northern border of [Canaan](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000045) in [Numbers](book-key://NUM), between [Zedad](location-id://04ea07ad-63fa-4f49-8c4d-fa36cd9c4744) and [Hazar-enan](location-id://e28354a3-33d9-41c9-b160-e91406c183cf); its location is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Ziz
locationsMap.title: ascent from the wilderness toward Jeruel
locationsMap.description: Ziz was the ascent by which the Moabite, Ammonite, and Mount [Seir](location-id://3fc9393f-3978-40df-9a42-b7bc33401f98) coalition approached [Judah](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000119) in [Jehoshaphat](name-id://3a573bf3-3bda-458d-b7ac-5b2e4f3205f6)'s day, near the wilderness of Jeruel; its exact route is uncertain.

locationsMap.name: Zoan
locationsMap.title: Egyptian city of Tanis in the Nile Delta
locationsMap.description: Zoan was the KJV name for Tanis in [Egypt](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000065)'s Nile Delta, remembered as an ancient city where Egypt's princes sat and where biblical poetry locates signs done in the field of Zoan.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Tanis / San el-Hagar in Egypt

locationsMap.name: Zoar
locationsMap.title: small city of the plain also called [Bela](location-id://6684b9dd-e756-4c52-bace-16acfd1cb1d6)
locationsMap.description: Zoar was the small city of the plain, earlier called [Bela](location-id://6684b9dd-e756-4c52-bace-16acfd1cb1d6), to which [Lot](name-id://6100a889-934d-48cf-9f71-f36e524c7766) fled after [Sodom](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000212); later prophets use it as a Moabite landmark, and the traditional Zoara/Ghor es-Safi area south of the Dead Sea is plausible but not certain.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: Traditionally the Zoara / Ghor es-Safi area southeast of the Dead Sea

locationsMap.name: Zophim
locationsMap.title: field on the top of [Pisgah](location-id://2f1847ff-51c6-41d4-a74b-a9a1075e7cb0) where [Balak](name-id://0cd1bb26-6e42-4461-ba13-77438e916c1f) brought [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c)
locationsMap.description: Zophim was the field on the top of [Pisgah](location-id://2f1847ff-51c6-41d4-a74b-a9a1075e7cb0) where [Balak](name-id://0cd1bb26-6e42-4461-ba13-77438e916c1f) brought [Balaam](name-id://2ecfa424-737f-466b-bd11-6fea8af1447c) to view part of Israel's camp; the exact lookout is uncertain within the Pisgah/[Nebo](location-id://edeacd63-c299-4442-bafb-d2f9e5a47ff1) region of [Moab](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000153).

locationsMap.name: Zuph
locationsMap.title: Ephraimite district where [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) searched for the asses
locationsMap.description: Zuph was the land or district reached by [Saul](name-id://7dbe7bce-7888-4b8f-8804-c9910bb04fcb) and his servant while searching for [Kish](name-id://f856b172-6576-409a-87c3-75bf389f60ec)'s asses, associated with [Samuel](name-id://1f1722fd-38b9-474c-9c94-fcbeb1d47812)'s country in the hill country of [Ephraim](name-id://4ad1140c-2b95-4513-bd55-ed594805df5f); the exact extent is unknown.

locationsMap.name: Zebulun
locationsMap.title: northern tribal territory between [Mount Tabor](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000160) and the [Valley of Jezreel](location-id://d6d31048-592b-4c0c-93fb-ead8077b750b)
locationsMap.description: Zebulun was the tribal territory allotted to the descendants of [Jacob](name-id://23ed64d8-8458-49af-9b51-f578ab3262d9)’s son [Zebulun](name-id://beeaa67f-e08b-4c67-a3b8-a5296e09981c) as the third lot, lying in lower Galilee between [Mount Tabor](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000160) and the [Valley of Jezreel](location-id://d6d31048-592b-4c0c-93fb-ead8077b750b) and containing [Nazareth](location-id://00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000167). [Isaiah](name-id://6efb3ddf-1670-4b48-b526-fadabe55474b) foretold that the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, lightly afflicted at the first, would afterward be made glorious.
locationsMap.modernIdentification: lower Galilee around Nazareth in northern Israel
